jobs.description:
Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
About the Role:
You will work closely with our enterprise customers and engineers to resolve the most complex issues. You will also help build out systems and processes to manage tasks from report to completion. You will problem solve with our technical teams and work to resolve as much as you can while scaling our systems and support processes.
What You'll Achieve:
Resolve customer issues leveraging your technical expertise and act as the primary point of escalation for our external support teams.
Reproduce customer issues, perform initial triage and file software defects and feedback with Engineering
Work cross-functionally across engineering and product to build processes and manage issues.
Develop deep product and platform expertise, diagnose and prevent recurring issues while contributing to feedback loops that improve both product quality and existing workflows.
Manage to key performance metrics defined within the CX Team.
Create and maintain internal knowledge libraries and contribute to the creation of user-facing content.
Should be open to 24/5 shift model and participate in an on-call rotation to assist customers outside of normal working hours.
Skills You'll Need to Bring:
3-5 years in a support capacity focusing on escalated issue and/or technical troubleshooting. A track record of contributing to performance metrics like customer satisfaction and response time.
Exceptional problem-solving skills capable of diagnosing complex technical issues, querying data, and review product logs. You can drive problems to resolution efficiently and effectively.
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners (i.e. Engineering, Product, and Operations) to drive long-term solutions and ensure customer feedback informs product improvements.
Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.
Experience contributing or owning projects to optimizing processes, workflows, and support operations that drive performance improvements. You have strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills**.** You are capable of distilling complex, technical material to non-technical audiences.
Ability to balance user expectations with policies and compliance boundaries. Ability to work under pressure while remaining focused and professional.
Nice to Haves:
Strong analytical skills with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making and outcomes.
Experience with tools and technologies like Zendesk, SQL databases, APIs, AI tools.

Build AI-powered developer experience that makes engineers enabled.
You’ll join our Developer Experience team, united by the mission of “Engineers can do their work quickly, easily, comfortably, and safely.” You’ll be part of a team spanning the US and India that turns ambiguous goals into shippable projects that meaningfully improve developer throughput and reliability.
Your team owns AI experiences, remote and local dev environments, builds and CI, deploys, testing, and verification. You’ll work on a relatively broad scope within a well-resourced team.

Over 10 years of experience with strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of turning ambiguous goals into well-scoped, shippable milestones.
Leadership: Can create technical roadmap and has a strong ability to plan and execute very large projects. Motivate the team for the goal.
Enjoys learning new technologies and has demonstrated innovation through past work.
Thrive in ambiguity and can solve business problems through technology.
Ownership: Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for the success of the project and the team.
Collaboration: Demonstrates strong communication and collaboration skills. Able to partner with cross-functional teams and engineering teams across time zones.
Experience building or operating developer tooling (CI/CD, infrastructure workflows, internal platforms) with a focus on reliability, observability, and developer trust.
Comfortable with creating with AI agents and hardening them: defining guardrails, adding evaluation/testing, and iterating based on real workflow feedback.
Comfortable with creating with agentic workflows: pros-cons of code based orchestration; cost analysis; scalability issues; very long running workflows; verification/ralph loops.
Systems-level debugging and performance thinking; you can identify bottlenecks, choose pragmatic fixes, and avoid accidental complexity.
Ability to multiply the team: clear written communication, high-quality reviews, and coaching/mentoring that helps others ship faster and better.
Some knowledge about building AI harness would be additive - tool building; context harness.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
About the Role:
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
What You'll Achieve:
Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.
Skills You'll Need to Bring:
3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.
Nice to Haves:
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.
What success looks like:
In your first 90 days, you will:
Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.
Within your first six months, you will:
Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.
Location:
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers
Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.
Your role at a glance
The Senior Electrical Solutions Engineer is a core Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Global Solutions Engineering, providing advanced electrical engineering expertise and technical leadership to the broader Solutions Engineering organization. Based in India, the role will primarily support India while also providing cross-regional support to EMEA, APAC, the Americas, and other regions as required. The role translates complex hyperscale and neocloud/enterprise customer requirements into practical, scalable, resilient, and commercially viable data center electrical solutions, with particular emphasis on high-density compute environments and increasingly complex power distribution architectures.
This individual contributor will develop electrical solutions from initial customer requirements through approximately 30% schematic design, producing the drawings, single-line diagrams, calculations, equipment selections, technical narratives, basis-of-design documentation, and scope definition required for Design Management, Procurement, and Construction teams to price, develop, and execute customer fit-out projects. The engineer will evaluate and develop solutions involving medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, generators, transformers, switchgear, PDUs/RPPs, busway, rack power distribution, protection and coordination, grounding, metering, power quality, and resilient electrical topologies supporting mission-critical data center environments.
Based in India, the engineer will operate as a global technical resource, with primary support responsibility for EMEA and additional support for other regions as business needs require. The engineer may occasionally participate in customer and internal meetings across multiple time zones.
The engineer will serve as a senior electrical technical authority during customer discussions, technical workshops, site assessments, due diligence activities, RFIs/RFPs, and solution-development efforts.
What we are looking for
Salary Range: INR 16,37,209 to INR 23,38,870
Who we are
As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.
NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Scheduler
jobs.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers
Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.
Your role at a glance
The Sr. Construction Scheduler is responsible for reviewing and analyzing General Contractors’ schedules and reporting on schedule health to the Project Team and other key stakeholders. This role involves working closely with NTT’s Construction Team and General Contractors to drive consistency, accountability, and adherence to established scheduling standards across all projects.
The Construction Scheduler will also support the analysis of schedule delays by reviewing, summarizing, and comparing General Contractors’ Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) against other available project data. This position plays an integral role in providing data-driven insights to enhance project predictability. Additionally, the Construction Scheduler will be responsible for collecting as-built data.
What we are looking for
KEY RESPONSIBLITIES
Lead baseline schedule development by partnering with NTT’s General Contractors to establish accurate, fully logic-driven project baselines.
Review General Contractors’ project schedules to identify potential risks, constraints, and sequencing issues, with a proactive focus on mitigation and recovery strategies.
Develop periodic schedule reports and proactively communicate schedule risks and performance trends to the Project stakeholders.
Ensure client-specific scheduling requirements are met, including compliance with contractual obligations, reporting standards, and project specific deliverables.
Develop schedule what-if scenarios and perform comparative schedule assessments to inform and drive data-based decision making.
Champion and support the implementation of scheduling best practices across GID, driving standardization of processes, templates, coding structures, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency, data integrity, and alignment with portfolio-level controls and governance standards.
Develop meaningful scheduling key performance indicators (KPIs) that accurately reflect project progress at any given point in time, enabling clear visibility into performance against baseline.
Review Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and provide structured feedback to the Construction Team and General Contractors.
Partner with project stakeholders to support planning efforts and maintain schedule control throughout the project lifecycle by developing and managing internal schedules that accurately reflect current progress across all phases.
Lead schedule progress meetings with the Construction Team and General Contractors to review status, validate updates, and address variances.
Perform any other related tasks as required.
KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES
Fully versed in Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling requirements for construction projects, including development and maintenance of logic-driven schedules, critical path analysis, risk assessment, and adherence to contractual scheduling specifications.
Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and the ability to apply its principles in internal schedule and performance reporting.
Proficient in Primavera (P6) and Microsoft Project (MSP) scheduling software.
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications to analyze and evaluate contractor-produced schedules.
Excellent analytical skills, creative thinking ability, and strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience reviewing Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and recovery schedules to assess schedule impacts and proposed mitigation strategies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to clearly set and lead meetings to develop strong project control systems
Ability to be highly confidential.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to manage stress effectively in a fast-paced work environment.
ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certification such as PSP is preferred.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
8 - 12 years of experience in construction scheduling, including baseline schedule development, critical path and variance analysis, earned value management (EVM), and forensic schedule analysis.
Experience with Data Center construction projects is preferred.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Primarily sitting with some walking, standing, and bending.
Able to hear and speak into a telephone.
Close visual work on a computer terminal.
Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate any required computer keyboard, mouse, and other technical instruments.
Able to lift and carry up to 20 lbs.
Work conditions & other requirements
Standard office; Data Center environment with varying temperatures and loud noises; extensive daily usage of workstation or computer.
This role is expected to be remote with an occasional need to be on-site and/or construction jobsite.
Ability to travel up to 25%.
Who we are
As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

jobs.description:

Your role at a glance
The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.
What we are looking for
Key Responsibilities:
Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.

The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Partner with hiring managers and business unit leader to understand hiring requirements, products and services while providing consultative expertise in recruitment.

Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
Collaborates regularly with peers and/or internal partners

Drive projects that advance the Command Center's operational capabilities

Drive site resilience projects to enhance system reliability and uptime

Conduct regular disaster recovery drills and readiness tests before major events (Thanksgiving, Cyber 5, peak shopping seasons)

Drive site resilience projects to enhance system reliability and uptime

Job Summary:
What you need to know about the role:
We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the analytical engine behind our payments economics. You'll own the data, reporting and dashboards that explain how our Total Processing Volume (TPV), revenue and transaction expenses (interchange, scheme fees and processing fees) turn into transaction margin. Most of our pricing is Interchange++ (IC+), so cost changes flow through to revenue.
Meet our team:
You'll join the Payments Finance team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager. The team owns revenue and transaction expense performance for the business. We work closely with Accounting on month-end close and reconciliation, with Corporate Finance on forecasting and planning, and with Product on pricing and margin initiatives. We're a small, hands-on team that values curiosity, ownership and clear answers to messy questions.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Facilitate collaborative engagement with business to cultivate strong partnership and unlock incremental value for the enterprise
Ensure in-depth understanding of the business to proactively identify key business drivers
Effectively communicate financial results & key drivers through concise & effective storytelling
Streamline, improve, & automate designated workstreams and processes to drive efficiency
Manage business case modeling, run deep dive analysis, and other ad-hoc financial analysis
Monitor expense and headcount plan vs actual and provide analysis/recommendation for business partners and Finance team
Work autonomously but in collaboration with teammates and business partners supporting a global business
Guide the business through various finance-related tasks
Own budgeting, forecasting, month-end close, variance analysis, and reporting
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Controllership, Corporate FP&A, Legal, and a broad group of business stakeholders
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Your way to impact:
Turn transaction-level data into clear insight on what is driving take rate, TE rate and margin: mix, card type, region, merchant segment, scheme fee changes and more.
Build the dashboards leadership uses to monitor payments performance, replacing manual spreadsheets with scalable, automated reporting.
Find margin opportunities, such as interchange optimization, scheme fee leakage, IC+ pass-through gaps and pricing outliers, and size them for Product and leadership.
Improve the accuracy of forecasts by giving Corporate Finance reliable volume and rate drivers.
Strengthen the link between operational data and the general ledger so our numbers tie out.
In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:
Writing and maintaining SQL queries to pull and transform transaction, revenue and cost data.
Building and maintaining dashboards in [Tableau / Looker / Power BI] tracking TPV, revenue, transaction expenses, take rate, TE rate and margin.
Running monthly and quarterly variance analysis (actual vs. forecast vs. prior period) and explaining the drivers in plain language.
Supporting month-end close by reconciling revenue and transaction expenses with Accounting.
Monitoring scheme fee and interchange changes and quantifying their impact on cost and pass-through.
Doing ad hoc deep dives for leadership and Product, for example merchant profitability or pricing scenarios.
Documenting data definitions and metric logic so everyone uses one version of the truth.
What do you need to bring:
4+ years in FP&A, revenue analytics, business intelligence or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL skills: joins, window functions, CTEs, and working with large transaction-level datasets.
Hands-on dashboarding experience in Tableau, Looker, Power BI or similar.
Strong Excel/Sheets and financial modeling skills.
A solid grasp of P&L concepts and variance analysis.
The ability to explain complex numbers simply to non-finance partners.
Payments experience is a strong plus: interchange, scheme fees, IC+ vs. blended pricing, acquiring and processing.
Nice to have: Python, or data modeling experience; exposure to multi-currency or cross-border payments.

Job Summary:
PayPal Payments Private Limited (PPPL) is the India subsidiary of PayPal Holdings, Inc. and a regulated payments entity supervised by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). As the entity-level Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role is accountable for ensuring cybersecurity, information technology (IT) and information & communication technology (ICT) risk, and operational resilience capabilities are effectively implemented, governed, and evidenced within the regulated entity, while leveraging PayPal’s global technology and cybersecurity services.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Recognized as a security governance, risk, and compliance expert, independently addressing the most complex security risks and providing strategic direction on risk mitigation and governance practices across the security domain.
Define methods and procedures for new or special assignments, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive security risk and governance initiatives that align with business needs and objectives.
Lead complex, high-impact security governance and risk management initiatives, leveraging a deep understanding of business trends and security challenges to develop innovative risk mitigation strategies and solutions.
Possess a keen awareness of the broader impact of decisions, with initiatives driving enterprise-wide improvements in risk management and security governance, enhancing overall security practices and operational efficiency.
Lead a security risk and governance team; set clear priorities and define actionable plans, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Guide team members through complex challenges, fostering their growth and development while maintaining a focus on high-impact results.
Minimum Qualifications:
8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
This Senior Manager serves as the entity-level Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and First Line of Defense lead for information security, cyber resilience, and ICT risk management. The role provides local lead of technology services delivered by PayPal's global organisation, ensuring compliance with Reserve Bank of India (RBI) cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
The CISO is accountable for the local governance and assurance of enterprise security capabilities, ensuring they are effectively implemented, monitored, evidenced, and reported. Working closely with global engineering, infrastructure, cloud, security, SLOD & enterprise risk teams and business teams, the role requires strong technical expertise, sound risk judgement, regulatory interpretation, and excellent communication skills.
Information Security & Cyber Resilience
Serve as the entity-level CISO, leading local information security, cyber resilience, and ICT/IT risk management activities
Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of cyber and digital operational resilience capabilities across the regulated entity
Partner with global Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Site Reliability Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to strengthen the resilience of critical ICT services and business processes supporting the entity.
Ensure enterprise cybersecurity policies, standards, and control requirements are effectively implemented, monitored, and evidenced within the entity, and mapped to applicable RBI requirements.
Oversee operational resilience activities, including disaster recovery exercises, cyber simulations, failover testing, tabletop exercises, and resilience validation, and maintain evidence for regulatory and audit review.
Oversee adherence to payment data storage and localisation requirements applicable to the entity, coordinating with global teams on data residency, retention, and evidencing.
ICT Risk & Secure Technology Delivery
Act as the First Line ICT/IT Risk lead for major technology changes, cloud migrations, new product launches, and transformation initiatives affecting the regulated entity.
Lead ICT and cybersecurity risk assessments across infrastructure, applications, cloud services, third-party providers, and operational processes.
Ensure security, resilience, data protection, and regulatory requirements are embedded throughout technology delivery and operational processes.
Partner with engineering and product teams to drive practical, measurable, and risk-based remediation of identified control gaps, including time-bound closure of vulnerabilities identified through VA/PT.
Oversee cybersecurity and operational resilience risks associated with third-party technology providers and cloud services supporting the regulated entity, Incident Management & Regulatory Engagement
Lead the First Line coordination of cybersecurity incidents and ICT disruption events in partnership with global Cybersecurity and Technology teams.
Lead the entity’s coordination of cyber incidents and ICT disruption events, including assessment, escalation, root cause analysis, recovery, and remediation tracking.
Drive post-incident reviews and resilience improvements to strengthen operational readiness and reduce future risk.
Act as the primary local point of contact for the RBI, CERT-In, external auditors, and internal assurance on cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, and data protection matters, maintaining a current view of the entity’s regulatory obligations and compliance posture and ensuring control design and evidence remain adequate to demonstrate compliance.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Monitor the effectiveness of cybersecurity and resilience controls, ensuring timely remediation of identified risks and control deficiencies.
Develop and report cybersecurity, operational resilience, and ICT risk metrics, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and management reporting to support informed decision-making, including inputs to the Board and IT Steering Committee.
Ensure the entity maintains compliance with applicable cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection, and technology governance requirements under the RBI and other Indian regulatory frameworks, while aligning with PayPal’s global security standards.
Advise senior management on cyber risk, technology risk, regulatory developments, resilience readiness, and emerging threats, escalating material risks where appropriate.
Partner with global Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to align enterprise security capabilities with local regulatory expectations and business priorities.
Experience
10-12 years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, ICT/IT risk, technology operations, or cyber resilience within financial services, payments, fintech, or other highly regulated technology environments.
Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity, ICT risk, or operational resilience initiatives while partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and technology teams.
Experience operating within a First Line of Defense function or in a technology leadership role with accountability for security, resilience, or operational risk outcomes.
Strong understanding of modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity operations, and secure technology delivery.
Sufficient technical proficiency to provide credible oversight, assessment, and challenge across areas such as cyber and operational resilience, disaster recovery and resilience testing, incident management and response, ICT risk assessment, secure technology change, and vulnerability management.
Experience engaging with regulators, external auditors, and internal assurance functions within regulated financial services environments — engagement with the RBI, CERT-In, or other Indian authorities is highly desirable.
Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape applicable to non-bank Payment System Operators / payment aggregators, including the RBI (Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices) Directions, 2023; the RBI Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank PSOs, 2024; the RBI Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways; CERT-In Directions (2022); and the DPDP Act, 2023.
Familiarity with recognised security and resilience standards (PCI DSS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework) is expected; exposure to international frameworks such as DORA, PSD2, GDPR, or NIS2 is beneficial given the global, matrixed operating model.
Experience influencing technical and business stakeholders and driving cross-functional initiatives in complex, matrixed organisations.
Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, infrastructure resilience, security tooling, automation, and modern engineering operating models.
Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, operational risk tooling, and executive risk reporting is beneficial.
Core Competencies
Strong leadership skills with a collaborative and hands-on approach to driving cybersecurity and resilience outcomes.
Strong regulatory interpretation — a key skill for the role: the ability to read and apply RBI, CERT-In, and DPDP requirements, translate principle-based or ambiguous guidance into practical control and evidence expectations, and form and defend a reasoned position with regulators, auditors, and internal stakeholders.
Ability to make sound, risk-based decisions during cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and rapidly evolving situations — including under compressed regulatory reporting timelines.
Strong technical understanding and proficiency across cybersecurity, cloud technologies, infrastructure, and ICT architectures in modern enterprise environments — sufficient to interpret technical detail, assess risk, and constructively challenge global delivery teams, without performing the technical work directly.
Deep knowledge of cyber resilience, operational resilience, technology risk management, and security controls in regulated financial services.
Credible technical partner for engineering, infrastructure, product, and security teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication — a key skill for the role: the ability to produce clear regulatory correspondence, control narratives, root-cause and incident reports, and executive- and Board-level summaries, and to represent the entity credibly and articulately with regulators, auditors, senior management, and cross-functional technical teams.
Ability to assess complex cyber and technology risks and translate them into practical, risk-based business and engineering decisions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on practical implementation, measurable risk reduction, and continuous improvement.
Ability to balance regulatory expectations, business priorities, and engineering realities to deliver pragmatic and effective cybersecurity outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within a global, matrixed organisation, balancing enterprise standards with local Indian regulatory obligations.
High standards of governance, documentation, and execution, with strong attention to regulatory expectations and operational excellence.
Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning, with an interest in emerging technologies, cloud security, AI-related cyber risks, threat intelligence, and evolving resilience practices.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
As a Staff Product Security Engineer, AI Security at PayPal, you’ll help protect 439M active accounts and $1.8T in annual total payment volume by providing technical leadership across three areas: securing AI-assisted software development, protecting AI-enabled products and agentic systems, and applying AI to improve vulnerability detection and remediation. You’ll partner with Security Architecture, engineering, product, and platform teams to translate AI security requirements into scalable controls, testing, and enforcement across PayPal’s products and business units. Through hands-on technical leadership and mentorship, you’ll turn emerging risks into durable capabilities and measurable risk reduction.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex security issues, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities
Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company’s context.
Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices.
Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into security processes.
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Roles and Responsibilities:
Lead the development and execution of Product Security’s technical roadmap for AI security controls and assurance, partnering with Security Architecture to translate requirements into scalable engineering capabilities.
Design, implement, and operate controls for AI-assisted software development, including security review of AI-generated code, security context and constraints for coding agents, automated testing, and risk-based enforcement.
Conduct and lead security reviews of AI-enabled applications and their models, agents, retrieval systems, data flows, and external tool integrations.
Create controls for agent identity, least privilege, tool access, execution isolation, human approval, and interruption of unsafe behavior.
Design and help implement security controls for AI models, agents, toolsets, datasets, and pipelines.
Develop runtime monitoring, auditability, detection, containment, and incident-response requirements for AI systems, including visibility into agent actions, tool calls, and sensitive-data access.
Build and scale AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability discovery, validation, prioritization, and remediation across teams and engineering workflows.
Partner with AI platform and cloud engineering teams to integrate security across AI infrastructure, platforms, and workloads.
Help establish security criteria for evaluating, onboarding, integrating, and periodically reassessing third-party models, AI services, APIs, and developer tools.
Develop methods and metrics for evaluating AI security risk, control effectiveness, remediation performance, and adoption across teams.
Serve as a technical escalation point for complex AI security issues and lead architectural reviews following significant incidents or control failures.
Mentor security and engineering professionals, deliver targeted technical guidance, and help teams apply AI security controls across diverse technology stacks.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience in software engineering, application security, product security, or cybersecurity, including leadership of complex security initiatives spanning multiple teams or technology platforms.
Deep knowledge of application security vulnerabilities, secure software development practices, and technical controls used to identify, prevent, and remediate software risk.
Hands-on experience securing AI systems.
Strong software-engineering experience building and operating production security tooling, automation, platform services, or developer-facing capabilities.
Track record of partnering with developers to implement robust security controls.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and senior stakeholder audiences.
Experience designing and operating security controls across cloud environments, CI/CD systems, and diverse application and infrastructure stacks.
Experience mentoring and developing engineers.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on familiarity with application security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, WAF, Burp Suite).
Strong programming experience in at least one language such as Ruby, Java, Python, JavaScript, or Swift.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control systems such as Git.
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
What you need to know about the role
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with cross-organizational scope. You will help set technical direction, lead delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining directly involved in architecture reviews, control design, implementation, and technical problem-solving.
Meet our team
Our mission is to embed security into every phase of the product development lifecycle, recognizing that security promotes quality engineering. We strive to create a culture of security by empowering teams to take responsibility for securing their own code and environments. We do this by providing leaders and engineers with the visibility, tools, guidance, training, and support needed to create secure products and systems. We prevent, identify, and respond to critical vulnerabilities within our ecosystem, driving response to limit potential impact to the business.
Your way to impact
Your work will reduce the likelihood that AI-assisted development introduces exploitable vulnerabilities and that AI-enabled systems misuse sensitive data, tools, or business actions. You will also improve PayPal’s ability to detect, validate, and remediate software vulnerabilities at scale.
Your day-to-day
Your work will vary across hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and cross-functional program delivery. Typical activities may include:
Reviewing an AI architecture, threat model, or agent workflow and identifying material security risks.
Designing, prototyping, or integrating an AI security control into a product, shared platform, or engineering workflow.
Evaluating results from AI security scanners, adversarial tests, and runtime monitoring to determine required engineering action.
Partnering with developers and platform teams to resolve complex design or implementation issues.
Analyzing control coverage, effectiveness, adoption, and incident findings to determine program priorities.
Mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions that span multiple teams or organizational boundaries.

Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that's continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, mobile computing and communications.
Who are we and what do we do?
The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra-small form factors that enable TI’s best-in-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market.
In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions!
By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path.
About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you! Senior Analog Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore, India
Experience: 5+ Years
What will you be doing in this role?
Analog Chip/Sub-section/IP architect and design with complete ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing.
Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical design function responsible for designing, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications.
Providing design guidance to team members as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project.
Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives.
Work with and provide guidance to physical designers and monitors the progress of IC layout.
Collaborate with Design Verification teams during the pre-PG phase of a project to ensure completion of all technical tasks before PG.
Work with systems engineers, application engineers and assisting in the definition of the product to meet customer needs.
Collaborate with validation, product engineering and test engineering teams to enable successful transfer to production.
Interface and lead discussions with the customer and/or TI field sales/field applications teams to understand customer designs, problems and support as required.
Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating personnel to ensure efficient operation of the organization and growth of the individuals into leader.

Basic Requirements (Must-Haves)
Bachelor’s & Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field of study
5+ years of analog circuit design.
Preferred Skills & "Good to Have"
Active involvement with a customer. Candidate would be expected to interact and collaborate with a sense of ownership with customers and all product development team members including design, layout, systems, verification, validation, test and program management
IC system partitioning and architectural tradeoff analysis
Block level topology selection, hand analysis, and IC transistor level implementation
Schematic generation and simulation on modern CAD tools (Cadence tool set)
Worst case identification, top level simulation, Monte Carlo analysis, and simulation data analysis
Expertise in tools e.g. Spectre, Simplis, Matlab and AMS
System level understanding and analysis; and the ability to translate requirements to an IC spec level
Physical layout management, signal grounding and routing tradeoffs, die area optimization
Post layout parasitic extraction and simulation, verification of all IC level performance metrics
Top level verification, block level modelling, top level simulation
Knowledge of device physics and process technologies tradeoffs that are applicable to Power IC design
Must budget time, manage schedule and complete complex IC design tasks on time
Must have depth of experience and meticulous approach to assure high quality results
Must account for limitations of system level specifications, testability, debug, characterization, production and yield targets in the IC design phase.
Must work well with colleagues and customers to foster a highly creative, interesting, productive and fun working environment.
Organizational Skills: Ability to work well with internal cross functional teams. Must successfully and appropriately interface with external customers. Project management, time management, multi-tasking, problem solving and communication (written and oral) are important skills in this role. Must be able to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision.
Team and People Skills: Candidate must be team oriented and must be able to work with TI-internal and external groups (systems, test, sales, marketing, customers, etc.) to resolve issues and generate business success. The ability to work well with others and to perform in a team environment is essential.
Projects and Deliverables: The main deliverable is the timely release of meticulously analysed and simulated IC designs or sub-sections of designs for custom designs with tight schedules. These designs should lead to cost-effective, high quality, bug-free products that fully meet our customer’s end-system requirements.

jobs.title: Integration Architect
jobs.description:
About TI
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job!
About the Job
Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a detailed and results-oriented leader to become a part of our global Information Technology team as Integration Architect.
Sales, Marketing & Workforce Solutions (SMWS) is critical to the success and growth of TI as a company. Our mission in SMWS is to deliver a best-in-class and technically credible digital experience at all stages of the customer lifecycle, scale digital selling to the mass market, and accelerate sales and marketing through digitization and personalization.
As an Integration Architect within the Digital Experience Solutions (DES) group, you will be technical leader, responsible for architecting end‑to‑end digital‑experience platforms within Texas Instruments’ IT Solutions organization in India. This is a hands-on architecture leadership role and will ensure architecture issecure, scalable, well-modeled, interoperable, and fit for both operational and analytical use, while enabling domain teams to deliver independently.
The Integration Architect influences through technical authority, standards, and partnership, working closely with domain engineering teams, platform teams, analytics, and security.
The ideal candidate will bring in well-rounded expertise around software development, including industry awareness of web technologies, frameworks, secure and scalable architecture, and back-end services. Sharp focus on execution, organization, and efficiency is critical for this role, including decision making around strategic staffing, cost, and skills. The ability to develop and drive technical strategy and lead effectively cross-functionally is critical.
Responsibilities include:
Define Solution Architecture – Design, develop and deployment diagrams for all new digital‑experience initiatives
Technology Strategy & Roadmap – Evaluate emerging technologies (AI/ML services, edge, serverless)
Standards & Governance – Establish coding standards, security baselines, CI/CD and observability best practices
Proof‑of‑Concept (PoC) Leadership – Lead rapid PoCs to validate architectural choices and capture performance metrics.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Management – Partner with product owners, UX designers, data engineers, security, and SRE teams across global TI to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Mentorship & Knowledge Transfer – Conduct architecture workshops, design‑review sessions, and code‑review guidance for development
Risk & Compliance Management – Identify architectural risks (security, performance, vendor lock‑in) and ensure designs meet internal audit requirements.
Documentation & Communication – Produce high‑quality architecture artifacts, runbooks, and executive‑level presentations for business partners.
Continuous Improvement – Track key metrics (lead time, MTTR, MTTD, defect density) and drive process enhancements within the digital‑experience delivery pipeline.
Build a positive and inclusive work environment with transparency, collaboration, and accountability
Effectively partner with org and cross-org leaders to strategically drive successful results
Identify and resolve problems with urgency and proactively solve issues ahead of time
Ensure ongoing compliance with IT Security policies and procedures and leverage data-driven decision-making

Minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
6 + years of software development, with at least 4 years in Integration/Enterprise architecture.
Strong experience working with Web technologies (like Spring, Angular, React, NodeJS), Microservices, Kubernetes, NoSQL DB like Mongo and, authentication methods like OAuth and SAML.
Excellent written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder‑management, proven mentorship/leadership, analytical mindset, ability to thrive in an agile environment.
Preferred qualifications:
Certification on public cloud platforms and/or architectural frameworks like TOGAF
Experience in institutionalizing best practices around performance tuning, accessibility, Observability and SEO at enterprise scale.
Technical acumen on CI/CD pipelines and blue/green deployment strategies on-prem and/or in public cloud environment.
Working experience with building integrated and automated solution leveraging Gen AII with RAG and/or MCP offering contextual, personalized experiences and outcomes to achieve business outcome.
Strong track record of implementing best practices and modern technologies to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable digital solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
Ability to manage and prioritize a high number of concurrent tasks, while mentoring team members and partnering cross-functionally
Demonstrated success in building and scaling high-performing, engaged engineering teams.
Ability to take initiative, drive for results, and be adaptable to change
Strong time management and prioritization skills to drive strong execution
Ability to work effectively in an interrupt-driven, fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships and manage multiple business partner expectations
Proven experience influencing opinions and gaining consensus
Possess curiosity, high energy, and helpful attitude to develop a positive team culture
Ability to present and get buy-in with technical and non-technical audiences alike

About the Team
Workday is expanding its Professional Services Consulting team in India across a broad range of experience levels and skills. Our consultants deliver high-quality services to customers in close partnership with regional consulting teams, helping them successfully implement Workday’s best-in-class cloud solutions.
We are committed to innovation and continuously improving the quality, efficiency, and impact of our delivery. Our team brings together diverse experiences and backgrounds across multiple locations, connected by a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive culture. We are equally passionate about customer success and creating an Employees First experience for our workmates.
About the Role
As a Manager, Workday Extend Consulting Management, you will lead and grow a team of consultants and developers who build custom Extend applications for customers on the Workday platform. You will be accountable for building technical depth on your team, ensuring app quality and security, supporting customer satisfaction, and growing the Extend practice within Workday's global delivery model.
You will partner closely with Resource Management, regional consulting teams, Engagement Managers, and project leaders to align staffing, skills, and delivery capacity with customer needs. You will also stay close to customer engagements, keep deep expertise in Extend architecture and delivery methodology, and help shape the direction of the Global Services and Professional Services organization.
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, develop, and retain a diverse, high-performing team of Extend consultants and developers.
Foster a collaborative, challenging, innovative, and inclusive team environment.
Own and continuously improve onboarding, performance management, talent development, and career-growth processes for your team.
Partner with Resource Management, regional teams, and Engagement Managers to staff customer engagements and build Extend capability across the consulting organization.
Drive customer satisfaction, references, utilization, and delivery performance against quarterly objectives.
Guide your team's use of Workday's implementation methodology and Extend delivery standards, including app promotion, security design, and code review processes.
Guide the design and delivery of custom Extend micro-apps (for example, awards programs, asset management, tuition reimbursement, and region-specific compliance workflows) using App Builder, Custom Business Objects, Page Builder, and Orchestrate.
Oversee integration and orchestration flows that connect Extend apps with third-party platforms and services, using WQL, REST APIs, and Workday Web Services.
Manage app migration pipelines across Development, Implementation, Sandbox, and Production tenants, and maintain governance frameworks for app promotion, security, and Extend credit and capacity usage.
Run agile delivery for your team, including sprint planning, translating business needs into technical specifications, and managing backlogs.
Help assess customer needs, shape solution proposals, and oversee end-to-end implementation of Extend solutions.
Collaborate across regions, teams, and time zones as part of a global delivery model.
Maintain and strengthen expertise in Workday Extend, the Business Process Framework, Domain Security Policies, and native HCM and Financials object models.
Contribute to the direction of the Global Services and Professional Services organization by leading and participating in internal initiatives.
Build strong working relationships with customers, technical teams, developers, and operational partners.
About You
About You
Basic Qualifications
12+ years of experience implementing cloud-based enterprise systems, including hands-on work with the Workday platform.
5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing consulting or technical teams.
Workday Extend Certification.
Other Qualifications
Deep technical knowledge of Workday Extend Platform Architecture, including App Builder, Custom Business Objects (CBOs), Extend UI components, Page Builder, and Workday Orchestrate.
Strong skills in integrations and data engineering, including Workday Query Language (WQL), REST APIs, JSON/XML data formats, SQL coding, Workday Web Services, and third-party API configuration.
Expert knowledge of Workday Platform Fundamentals, including the Business Process Framework (BPF), Domain Security Policies, and native object models across HCM and Financials.
Hands-on experience with tenant governance, including managing app migration pipelines across Development, Implementation, Sandbox, and Production tenants.
AI Skills - Shaping the strategic direction of the practice — leading the organisation's pivot toward AI, ensuring consultants are upskilled on AI capabilities and aligned with Workday's broader company mission
Leading the AI upskilling initiative — championing the development of AI advisory skills across the team so they can guide customers on how to take advantage of Workday's AI-powered solutions
Familiarity with AI concepts and a passion for driving AI adoption within a consulting organisation
Experience with agile product and delivery management, including sprint planning, translating business needs into technical specifications, managing backlogs, and leading developer teams.
Strong understanding of security and compliance, with the ability to enforce security alignment, protect data privacy, and maintain Workday's unified security model.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; a Master's degree in a related discipline is a plus.
Strong consulting, organizational, and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities across time zones.
Strong networking, mentoring, coaching, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with customers, consultants, developers, and cross-functional partners.
Success Measures
High customer satisfaction and strong customer-reference outcomes.
Achievement of utilisation, staffing, delivery quality, and customer satisfaction objectives.
Growth, retention, engagement, and career progression of your consulting and development team.
Consistent adherence to Extend delivery methodology, governance frameworks, and security standards.
Improved Extend delivery capability, scalability, and operational efficiency within the global delivery model.
Meaningful contribution to strategic Professional Services initiatives.
AI Adoption by the larger team and successful implementation of the Workday's AI-powered solutions with the customers.

Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.

Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
