jobs.title: Knowledge Management - AI & Content Strategy Engineer
jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
The Knowledge Manager is responsible for shaping how ECS captures, creates, organizes, validates, presents, and sustains knowledge. The role combines knowledge and content strategy, information architecture, learning enablement, SharePoint fluency, and AI knowledge readiness. The objective is not simply to administer repositories, but to make trusted knowledge easy for employees, clients, and AI solutions to understand, access, and use.
This manager-level individual contributor will establish the frameworks and operating practices needed to turn fragmented documentation and institutional expertise into current, authoritative, audience-appropriate knowledge assets. The role will support internal ECS needs and reusable approaches that may be applied to client knowledge-management engagements, support experiences, and AI knowledge assistants.
The successful candidate will bring deep knowledge-management and content-creation expertise, strong information-organization instincts, and enough hands-on SharePoint experience to contribute immediately. Experience in learning and development is important because ECS needs to effectively connect knowledge capture with training, upskilling, workshops, and knowledge transfer. The role will work with technical teams on platform decisions, while retaining accountability for the knowledge framework, content quality, governance, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Knowledge Strategy, Architecture and Governance | 30%
· Design and maintain an ECS knowledge-management framework aligned to Endurance program principles, business priorities, and user needs.
· Define repository hierarchies, taxonomies, metadata, naming and smart-titling conventions, content types, source-authority rules, and audience segmentation.
· Establish governance for content creation, human validation, approval, publishing, access, periodic review, retention, archival, and disposition.
· Clarify decision rights and responsibilities for content owners, authors, reviewers, approvers, repository managers, and technical platform teams.
· Create scalable patterns that separate and appropriately connect shared Unisys knowledge, product-specific knowledge, client-owned content, and tailored client experiences.
· Serve as a hands-on SharePoint practitioner for knowledge design, while partnering with platform specialists for complex administration, engineering, integration, and security decisions.
2. Content Creation, Knowledge Capture and Curation | 25%
· Develop structured templates, toolkits, and guidance that enable subject matter experts and designated contributors to conduct interviews, workshops, documentation reviews, lessons learned, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
· Create and maintain templates, editorial standards, and authoring guidance that help content owners develop consistent playbooks, guides, reference materials, standard operating procedures, training content, and other reusable knowledge artifacts.
· Organize content so employees and clients can quickly understand it, navigate it, and apply it to their work.
· Operate staged content workflows that support intake, assessment, cleanup, smart titling, tagging, categorization, validation, publishing, and maintenance.
· Identify and remediate duplicate, obsolete, redundant, conflicting, orphaned, or poorly structured content.
· Improve the quality and consistency of how ECS presents technical and business knowledge internally and to clients.
3. AI Knowledge Readiness and Managed Knowledge Services | 25%
· Prepare trusted knowledge sources for Microsoft Copilot, AI knowledge assistants, RAG solutions, intelligent search, and multi-agent experiences.
· Establish AI-ready content standards covering structure, completeness, metadata, permissions, source authority, currency, validation, and intended audience.
· Partner with AI, engineering, UX, platform, security, and services teams to translate knowledge requirements into feasible solution designs without owning technical architecture decisions outside the role.
· Support knowledge assessments that determine whether source content is suitable for AI ingestion and identify cleanup or remediation required before implementation.
· Design reusable managed-knowledge practices covering content creation, validation, governance, maintenance, and service metrics.
· Create feedback loops that connect user experience and AI response quality to source-content remediation and knowledge-gap closure.
4. Learning Enablement and Adoption | 15%
· Help apply learning-and-development principles to convert captured knowledge into role-based learning paths, workshops, job aids, and onboarding materials.
· Partner with Endurance program leads, practice teams, and learning resources to support concurrent training and knowledge-transfer activities.
· Build repeatable enablement patterns that can be piloted in one product or practice and adapted for subsequent areas.
· Develop guidance and communications that help contributors create better content and help users find and apply authoritative knowledge.
· Promote sustainable knowledge-sharing behaviors and support practices in taking operational ownership of their knowledge.
5. Metrics, Reporting and Continuous Improvement | 5%
· Define indicators for content quality, validation status, freshness, coverage, discoverability, reuse, adoption, learning effectiveness, and AI readiness.
· Provide concise reporting on repository health, knowledge gaps, governance compliance, risks, remediation priorities, and business outcomes.
· Use analytics, search behavior, feedback, and AI-quality observations to maintain a prioritized improvement backlog.
#LI-ND1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
Required Skills:
· Bachelor's degree in Knowledge Management, Library or Information Science, Instructional Design, Information Systems, Communications, Business, or a related field.
· Min 2 years of experience across knowledge management, content strategy, information architecture, content operations, organizational learning, or a related discipline.
· Demonstrated ability to design taxonomies, metadata models, repository hierarchies, content standards, and lifecycle-governance practices.
· Hands-on experience with SharePoint, including hubs, sites, libraries, content types, metadata, permissions, navigation, and search.
· Experience capturing expert knowledge and converting it into accessible, reusable content for different audiences.
· Experience leading cross-functional work with business, technical, learning, and governance stakeholders in a globally distributed environment.
· Strong writing, editing, facilitation, synthesis, and visual-communication skills.
· Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on manager-level individual contributor, set frameworks, and influence without direct authority.
· Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, AI knowledge assistants, enterprise search, agentic solutions, or RAG-based implementations.
Preferred Qualifications
· Background in learning and development, instructional design, curriculum development, technical training, or workforce enablement.
· Familiarity with content ingestion, semantic retrieval, vector search, knowledge graphs, web crawling, automated tagging, or content-quality automation.
· Experience assessing and organizing technical product, support, engineering, or client documentation.
· Experience shaping managed knowledge services or professional-services offerings.
· Relevant certification in knowledge management, library science, learning, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, records management, or information governance.

We are seeking a highly experienced Firmware Architect to join our dynamic team developing next-generation memory and storage solutions. This role requires an individual with a deep understanding of firmware and embedded software development for ARM-based multi-core and multi-processor memory or storage devices. Knowledge of CXL and DRAM is optional, but PCIe expertise is a significant advantage coupled with strong technical expertise in embedded systems. Documentation & Standards: Create high-quality design documents, adhere to industry standards, and follow robust documentation practices.
Cross-Team Interaction: Collaborate closely with hardware and software teams to align development efforts.
Process Adherence: Champion software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including Agile methodologies, to deliver quality products on time.
Debugging & Optimization: Utilize tools such as JTAG debuggers, logic analyzers, and exercisers to debug and optimize firmware.

Essential:
8 –14 years of firmware development experience for CXL, PCIe, or storage/memory devices.
Proficiency in C and C++ programming.
Hands-on experience with FPGA/ASIC-based products.
Expertise in any Embedded RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
Strong knowledge of Operating system programming concepts.
In-depth understanding of ARM architecture for embedded devices.
Hands on experience in developing secure firmware/bootloaders for ARM or RISC-V based systems.
Proficiency with debugging tools and techniques (e.g., JTAG, logic analyzers).
Ability to comprehend and implement specifications, standards, and datasheets.
Proven track record of architecting firmware with a modular design approach, leveraging abstraction layers to ensure scalability, maintainability, and reusability.
Preferred:
Knowledge of Linux Kernel internals/programming, memory management, NUMA subsystem, device drivers and interaction with ACPI/UEFI tables.

Role and Responsibilities
Design & maintain UVM‑based verification environments for high‑speed serial IP blocks (e.g.,56G/112G/224G Gbps SERDES, PCIe Gen4/5, Ethernet MAC/PHY,) and security IP (AES/SHA engines, ECC, secure‑boot, root‑of‑trust).
Develop comprehensive test plans and coverage models that capture protocol corner cases, timing jitter, eye‑diagram constraints, and security threat scenarios.
Create reusable UVM components (agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and protocol checkers) that can be shared across multiple serial and security projects.
Implement constrained‑random traffic generators with data‑pattern, error‑injection, and latency‑stress capabilities to validate link reliability and security robustness.
Integrate formal verification and assertion‑based checking (SVA) to capture protocol violations, key‑exchange errors, and timing violations early in the flow.
Run and maintain regression suites on industry‑standard simulators (VCS, Xcelium, Questa) and CI pipelines; monitor functional coverage, protocol coverage, and security‑feature coverage.
Collaborate closely with design, architecture, and security teams to refine specifications, resolve bugs, and drive design for testability (DfT) and low‑power considerations.
Mentor junior verification engineers, enforce coding standards, and contribute to the IPD verification methodology library.
Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and compliance verification (e.g., PCI‑SIG, IEEE Ethernet, NIST crypto standards).
Required Skills & Experience
System Verilog & UVM, Formal Verification expertise – 5–6 years of hands‑on verification on complex IP, with strong understanding of class‑based verification, randomization, coverage, and SVA.
High‑speed serial protocol knowledge – Practical experience verifying PCIe, Ethernet SERDES, or similar high‑throughput interfaces.
Security IP verification – Familiarity with cryptographic engines, secure‑boot flows, authentication protocols, side‑channel analysis, and related test strategies.
Simulation & automation tools – Proficient with VCS, Xcelium, or Questa; scripting in Tcl/Python for test bench generation and regression management.
Coverage‑driven verification – Ability to define functional, protocol, and security coverage models and drive them to closure.
Debugging & root‑cause analysis – Strong waveform analysis, assertion debugging, and use of log‑extraction tools to isolate failures.
Version control & CI/CD – Experience with Git and Jenkins/GitLab CI for automated regression runs.
Digital design fundamentals – Understanding of clock‑domain crossing, reset strategies, and low‑power design considerations for high‑speed blocks.
Education – B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
Skills and Qualifications
Experience – 5 to 6 Years of experience

Job Description:
Senior UX Product Designer - Location: Hyderabad India
Department: Product UX Design – IMS Division
Reports to: UX Product Design Manager
About the Role
Broadcom’s Infrastructure Management Division (IMS) delivers industry-leading solutions that empower global enterprises to monitor, manage, and secure their most complex, mission-critical environments. We are looking for a hands-on, high-craft Senior UX Designer to join our Product Design team and take end-to-end ownership of key product areas. If you thrive in technical domains, work AI-natively, and can transform intricate system challenges into intuitive, scalable experiences, this is the role for you.
You will play a key role in modernizing the user experience of a mature product ecosystem, bringing contemporary design thinking to our suite of enterprise solutions. This role is highly collaborative; you will act as an embedded partner to Product Managers, Engineers, and Researchers to translate ambiguous briefs into clear, defensible designs. Your work will have a direct impact on users at some of the largest organizations in the world, making high-stakes systems feel intuitive and impactful.
Required Qualifications
Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design (IxD), Industrial Design, Cognitive Science, Graphic Design or related field.
Experience: 8+ years in UX/Product Design, ideally in enterprise, infrastructure management, or complex SaaS environments.
Figma & Design Systems: Expert-level Figma proficiency and a proven ability to build and maintain scalable design systems.
AI Fluency: Active, practical use of AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) as part of day-to-day design workflows.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with complex, data-rich products or infrastructure management tools.

Role Summary
The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.

Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.
Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics.
The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI solutions from opportunity discovery to deployment and scale.

Role Overview

Paytm is looking to hire an Enterprise GTM Lead to own the go to market charter for Paytm’s AI Inference and Agentic AI products across enterprise clients.
This is a managerial role that will lead business managers and client onboarding managers, and will work closely with enterprise sales teams to drive pipeline, deal conversion, onboarding, and client success.
The role sits at the center of Paytm’s enterprise AI charter and involves shaping GTM strategy, enabling sales teams, supporting client pitches, structuring commercials, and ensuring strong post sale execution.
The candidate will be responsible for building a repeatable enterprise sales motion for Paytm AI agents, including Pi Commerce and future AI products.
The role requires strong commercial judgment, enterprise stakeholder management, execution discipline, and ability to work across sales, product, technology, finance, and marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise GTM Strategy and Business Ownership
Own the enterprise GTM strategy for Paytm AI agents across existing and new enterprise clients.
Build and execute sales enablement, pipeline generation, deal conversion, onboarding, and account expansion plans.
Work with leadership to define target segments, priority accounts, industry plays, and product positioning.
Translate business goals into clear GTM plans, sales motions, commercial models, and execution cadences.
Track the full enterprise funnel across sales channels and drive corrective action where performance deviates from plan.

Accompany sales teams in key client pitches, discovery discussions, solutioning sessions, and commercial negotiations.
Build reusable sales assets including pitch decks, case studies, proposals, demo scripts, pricing notes, and competitive positioning.
Conduct regular training sessions for enterprise sales teams on Pi Commerce and other Paytm AI agents.
Ensure enterprise sales teams are consistently updated on new product launches, feature upgrades, pricing changes, and GTM priorities.

Commercial Strategy, Pricing, and Deal Support
Own pricing strategy and commercial structuring for enterprise AI agent deployments in partnership with business, finance, and sales teams.
Support custom pricing, proposal creation, margin analysis, and negotiation strategy for strategic enterprise deals.
Drive enterprise level invoicing discipline in coordination with finance operations and central finance teams.
Support vendor negotiations and third party commercial discussions wherever required for enterprise deployments.

Pipeline Generation and B2B Marketing
Drive enterprise pipeline generation initiatives across industry events, account based outreach, webinars, client workshops, ecosystem partnerships, and targeted campaigns.
Partner with sales and marketing teams to create strong B2B marketing programs for Paytm AI agents.
Build client engagement programs to nurture warm accounts, enrich leads, and improve conversion from interest to qualified opportunities.
Identify high potential enterprise use cases and convert them into focused GTM plays by industry and function.
Track campaign and pipeline performance, and improve channel productivity through structured reviews.

Product Feedback and Client Success

Ensure major product upgrades, launches, and new capabilities are communicated clearly to clients and sales teams.
Work with client onboarding managers to ensure smooth deployment, adoption, and early value realization.
Support account expansion by identifying new use cases, cross sell opportunities, and adoption gaps within existing clients.

Set clear goals, review cadences, dashboards, and operating rhythms for the enterprise AI GTM charter.

jobs.title: Head of Go-To-Market (GTM) - Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a powerhouse Head of Go-To-Market (GTM) / Growth to own the entire
commercial launch and expansion strategy for our product. This isn't a traditional, siloed
marketing or sales role—this is a unified, high-impact position designed for a strategic leader
who views marketing, launch mechanics, demand generation, and sales enablement as a
single, continuous motion.
As a product goes live, you will literally be the person who takes the product to market. If you
possess a rare blend of sharp marketing instincts and a commercial sales mindset, this role is
built for you.

Key Responsibilities
Your mission is simple yet challenging: bridge the gap between product readiness and market
dominance.
 The Launch Mastermind: Own the end-to-end launch strategy for our product. You will
define the positioning, messaging, and rollout phases to ensure maximum impact on day
one.
 Unified GTM Execution: Treat marketing, demand gen, and sales enablement not as
separate departments, but as a single, cohesive engine.
 Demand Generation: Design, execute, and scale data-driven inbound and outbound
campaigns that build a robust, high-converting pipeline.
 Sales Enablement: Arm the sales team with the exact tools, collateral, competitive
intelligence, and playbook they need to close deals faster.
 Cross-Functional Leadership: Work hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering, and
Executive leadership to align market feedback with product roadmaps.

What We Are Looking For
 The Sales & Marketing Contour: You don't just sit in a marketing silo or a sales bullpen.
You deeply understand the psychology of the buyer (Marketing) and the mechanics of
closing a deal (Sales).
 Launch Experience: You have a proven track record of successfully launching new
products or entering new markets from scratch, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
 Data-Driven Builder: You are comfortable working with analytics, attribution models, and
CRM data to optimize the funnel continually.
 Strategic & Hands-on: At the GM level, you can chart the 12-month strategy but aren't
afraid to roll up your sleeves to write a launch brief or review a sales deck.

Qualifications & Requirements
 Experience: 10+ years of experience in Growth, Marketing, or Business Development, with
at least 3–5 years leading integrated GTM strategies.
 Industry Fit: Experience in B2B SaaS, tech, or high-growth product companies is highly
preferred.
 Location: Must be based in or willing to relocate to the Delhi/Noida region for this on-site
position.
 Education: Bachelor’s or Masters degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (MBA
from a tier-1 institute is a plus, but proven execution matters more).

Why Join Us?
You will have total ownership of a live product's market trajectory. This is a high-visibility, high-
impact role at the senior level where your success directly dictates the company's growth curve.

Job Title
Talent Acquisition Intern – Non-Tech Recruitment

About the Role
As a Talent Acquisition Intern (Non-Tech), you will play an active role in driving talent identification and engagement across Paytm’s business, sales, operations, and corporate functions. Working closely with recruiters and business stakeholders, you will help source, screen, and coordinate candidates to fuel Paytm’s fast-paced growth.
This role is ideal for a proactive, energetic individual with strong communication skills, high learning agility, and an interest in modern, technology-enabled hiring practices. You will gain hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment operations and candidate management in a high-volume fintech ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
Candidate Sourcing: Leverage job boards, social channels, campus databases, and internal platforms to source qualified candidates for business, sales, and enabling function roles.
Screening & Assessment: Conduct initial resume screening and phone evaluations to assess candidate suitability, communication skills, and role alignment.
Interview Coordination: Manage end-to-end scheduling of interviews, candidate communications, and logistics to ensure a seamless candidate experience.
Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate candidate data and application stages across the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and internal recruitment trackers.
Market Research: Perform basic market mapping and talent research to support recruiter search strategies for specialized non-tech profiles.
Process Automation & AI Adoption: Utilize modern sourcing tools, AI prompts, and automated communication platforms to speed up top-of-funnel hiring workflows.

Required Qualifications
Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related fields preferred).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to engage candidates professionally.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail when managing multiple calendars and candidate pipelines.
High learning agility, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides).
Preferred Qualifications
Prior internship experience in HR, recruitment, candidate sourcing, or talent coordination.
Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and professional networking platforms like LinkedIn.
Interest in fintech, internet platforms, or high-growth technology environments.

AI Expectations
Sourcing & Search: Practical use of modern search methodologies and basic AI tools/prompts to quickly discover candidate profiles and boolean search strings.
Communication: Utilizing AI tools for drafting personalized candidate outreach messages, interview invitations, and follow-ups.
Productivity: Leveraging AI-driven tools and automation to summarize profiles, reduce administrative turnaround time, and improve daily recruitment throughput.

Ideal Candidate
Demonstrates Ownership & Bias for Action by taking initiative on daily sourcing and coordination tasks.
Exhibits Learning Agility with an eagerness to absorb recruiting best practices and stay open to new tools and ideas.
Displays Speed of Execution and adaptability in managing tight hiring schedules and candidate communication.
Strong focus on Candidate Experience and professional ethics.

jobs.title: Lead-Affiliate Marketing
jobs.description:
Role: Affiliate & B2B Customer Acquisition – Paytm Money (PML)

About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading payments Super App, offering consumers and merchants a wide range of financial services. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm’s mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial inclusion.

Paytm Money is the wealth-tech arm of Paytm, enabling users to invest in mutual funds, equities, and derivatives seamlessly. Owned by One97 Communications, founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma, the company is headquartered in Noida and backed by leading global investors.

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Affiliate Marketing leader to build and scale the affiliate and partnerships growth channel for Paytm Money. This role will own the end-to-end affiliate charter across mutual funds, equities, and derivatives, driving high-quality user acquisition through publishers, partners, and performance networks. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in affiliate ecosystems—especially within broking, fintech, or wealth platforms—and will focus on scaling this channel efficiently with strong ROI and quality metrics.

Key Responsibilities
Affiliate Strategy & Channel Ownership: Own and drive the affiliate marketing strategy across all investment products.
 Build a scalable affiliate engine leveraging networks, direct publishers, and strategic partnerships. Manage budgets, payouts, and ROI.
Partner Acquisition & Ecosystem Building: Onboard and manage affiliate partners including content platforms, fintech aggregators, influencers, and broker comparison platforms. Build strong publisher relationships and unlock new partnerships.
User Acquisition & Quality Control: Drive high-quality acquisition (demat accounts, SIPs, active traders) while monitoring traffic quality, conversion rates, and fraud. Ensure alignment with long-term LTV and retention
 Campaign Management & Optimization: Launch and optimize campaigns across partners. Improve creatives, messaging, and landing pages. 
Continuously refine commission structures and incentives.
 Data & Performance Analytics: Track performance using attribution tools. Monitor CAC, conversion, activation, and ROI. Identify funnel gaps and optimize continuously.
Product & Growth Collaboration: Work with Product and Growth teams to improve landing pages and onboarding journeys. Align campaigns with launches and offers.
 Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to regulatory guidelines in financial services. Monitor and prevent fraudulent traffic. Maintain transparency in partner engagements.
 Stakeholder Management & Leadership: Collaborate with internal teams and present insights to leadership. Build and scale the affiliate function.

Key KRAs / Success Metrics
User acquisition via affiliates (demat accounts, SIP registrations, traders), CPA and ROI, conversion rates (click to KYC to activation), activation metrics (first trade, SIP setup), traffic quality and fraud control, and overall contribution of affiliate channel to growth.

Qualifications & Experience:
8–12+ years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, or performance marketing. Strong background in broking, fintech, or wealth platforms. Proven track record of scaling affiliate channels.

The Senior Manager/Manager – TPRM Governance will lead the strategic design, operationalization, and ongoing oversight of the enterprise-wide Third-Party Risk Management framework.

The person will champion the TPRM framework as aligned to applicable compliances across regulations and statutory mandates—while serving as the primary bridge between cross-functional business units, executive leadership, internal and external stakeholders.

TPRM Framework & Policy Governance

Establish robust governance mechanisms and the end-to-end design for formulating, executing, and enhancing TPRM control frameworks, policies, and standard operating procedures.

Ensure enterprise-wide adoption of third-party risk methodologies, aligning with applicable regulatory requirements.

Drive a data-driven risk-based approach to 3rd party evaluation, exception identification, and reporting.

Design, consolidate, and present executive TPRM dashboards, trend analyses, and exception reports directly to the Risk Management Committee, Board of Directors, and Senior leadership.

Third-Party Risk Assessment

Perform inherent and residual risk assessments, monitor SLA adherence, performance metrics, and control effectiveness across the vendor lifecycle.

Lead and oversee continuous vendor risk evaluations across multiple domains, including financial health, information security, operational resilience, legal, compliance, and reputational risk.

Maintain and govern a centralized, risk-tiered vendor inventory categorizing third parties based on service nature, data access, regulatory criticality, and concentration risk.

Define periodic due diligence and monitoring frequencies aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory standards.

Lead the ongoing monitoring strategy for critical third parties, utilizing SLA performance tracking, continuous financial health reviews, threat intelligence feeds, and regulatory sanction screening.

Manage and orchestrate structured, periodic vendor risk questionnaire assessments and remediation programs as defined under the TPRM framework.

Track vendor incidents, operational control failures, and risk events to drive remediation, while maintaining up-to-date policies, SOPs, risk registers, and governance reporting.

Vendor & Operational Oversight: Demonstrated expertise in 3rd Party due diligence, SLA governance, regulatory compliances, and audit support for key third parties

The Collections team is responsible for managing overdue accounts, driving recovery performance, monitoring collection agencies and in-house teams, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and the Code of Conduct. The team focuses on achieving collection targets, improving recovery efficiency, and minimizing credit losses across assigned territories.

About the Role:
The Zonal Collection Manager will be responsible for driving collection performance across the assigned zone, managing regional and branch-level collection teams, and ensuring the achievement of business and recovery targets. The role requires strong leadership, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and expertise in managing collection agencies and field operations while maintaining regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive and achieve zonal collection targets across assigned products, branches, and delinquency buckets.
Develop and implement effective collection strategies to improve recovery rates, reduce roll-forwards, and control delinquencies.
Lead, manage, and monitor regional collection managers, branch teams, field executives, and collection agencies.
Review collection performance through regular MIS, productivity reports, and portfolio analysis, and take corrective actions wherever required.
Monitor collection agency performance, ensure optimal resource utilization, and drive accountability for assigned targets.
Ensure strict adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the Code of Conduct.
Identify and control fraudulent practices, operational risks, and process gaps across collection operations.
Work closely with business, credit, risk, legal, and operations teams to resolve collection challenges and improve recovery outcomes.
Manage escalations related to overdue accounts, customer grievances, and field collection activities.
Ensure effective allocation of collection resources across branches and territories based on portfolio size, delinquency levels, and business requirements.
Drive employee productivity, performance reviews, capability building, and continuous improvement across the zonal team.
Prepare and present periodic collection performance updates, recovery forecasts, and action plans to senior management.

Skills and Competencies:
Strong expertise in collections, recovery management, and delinquency control.
Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to manage large, geographically distributed teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in collection MIS and performance tracking.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of collection processes, agency management, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Ability to drive results, manage escalations, and deliver targets in a high-performance environment.
Strong planning, execution, and decision-making capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and collection management systems.
A proactive approach to process improvement, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation.

Education and Experience:
Education: Graduate in any discipline. Postgraduate qualifications will be an added advantage.

Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in collections and recovery management, preferably in banking, NBFCs, fintech, or financial services.
Prior experience in managing zonal or multi-location collection operations, large teams, and collection agencies is preferred.

Compensation:
Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, expertise, and suitability for the role.

Oracle is seeking an engineering director to build and lead a new Systems Firmware team in Bengaluru. You will hire the founding engineers, establish the team’s technical direction and culture, and take responsibility for outcomes that directly affect the reliability and serviceability of our server fleet.
The team’s initial mission is to resolve BMC and BIOS firmware issues in production. Working closely with US engineering teams, infrastructure operations, hardware teams, and external partners, you will lead complex investigations, drive lasting fixes, and improve the diagnostics, testing, and release practices that prevent problems from recurring. The team will participate in on-call rotations during India daytime hours, complementing US coverage through coordinated response and clear technical handoffs.
You will start with four senior engineers and provide close technical leadership while building the practices and partnerships needed for the team to succeed. You will set priorities, develop your engineers, and balance immediate fleet needs with longer-term improvements in firmware quality, security, and operational efficiency.
You will also shape the team’s roadmap and future capability. As additional hiring is approved, our intent is to expand its responsibilities into firmware development and delivery for new server and GPU platforms. This includes working with original design manufacturers and joint design manufacturers (ODM/JDMs), particularly Taiwan-based partners, on platform requirements, firmware integration, bring-up, validation, and production readiness.
This role calls for a leader with deep systems firmware expertise, sound operational judgment, and a record of building strong engineering teams. You should be comfortable guiding difficult technical investigations, holding partners accountable for delivery, and translating lessons from production into better engineering decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead the Bangalore Systems Firmware team. Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineers working on BMC firmware and BIOS. Establish clear ownership, coach technical leaders, and create an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Lead resolution of complex firmware issues. Guide incident triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions across firmware, hardware, and software boundaries. Prioritize work by customer impact and ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.
As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.
Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.
You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.
As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.
This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.
Key Responsibilities
Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.
Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.
Required qualifications
Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
11 years of software development experience; or
A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.
Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes.
Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support.
Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance.
Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.
Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms.
Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I²C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI.
Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features.
Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation.
Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation.
Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response.
Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
Product development and technical ownership
Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.
Investigation, performance, and quality
Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes.
Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components.
Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads.
Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks.
Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks.
Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces.
Engineering execution and collaboration
Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance.
Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones.
Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives.
Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability.
Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team.
Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems.
As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality.
AI-assisted engineering
Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful.
Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software.

jobs.title: Revenue Analyst 3-Fin
jobs.description:
Oracle’s Global Finance Information Center (GFIC) in Bangalore is a strategic shared-services finance center supporting Oracle Finance. Within GFIC, the Accounts Receivables Center of Excellence manages global invoice-delivery operations and supports Oracle’s response to the evolving global e-invoicing and e-reporting landscape.
Job Summary
The Global E-Invoicing Business Analyst – IC3 will support the design, implementation, and rollout of e-invoicing and e-reporting capabilities across multiple countries.
This role serves as a bridge between country-specific regulatory requirements and the teams responsible for delivering scalable global solutions, including Tax, Finance, IT, Legal/Compliance, local teams, and external e-invoicing service providers.
The Business Analyst will take end-to-end ownership of assigned country requirements—from regulatory discovery and requirements definition through data mapping, testing, go-live, and stabilization—while promoting reuse of global standards and solution components.
Location: Bangalore, India
Level: IC3
Key Responsibilities
Analyze country-specific e-invoicing and e-reporting requirements, including invoice formats, mandatory data elements, validation rules, and submission, clearance, or reporting models.
Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear functional and system requirements, documenting assumptions, decisions, gaps, dependencies, and required outcomes.
Map e-invoice requirements to ERP, billing, tax, customer, vendor, and other relevant source-system data; identify gaps and coordinate their resolution.
Partner with Tax, Finance, Legal/Compliance, IT, local teams, and external service providers to support solution design, integration, and implementation.
Coordinate end-to-end country rollout activities spanning discovery, design, mapping, testing, readiness assessment, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.
Develop and support test scenarios, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), invoice-data validation, defect resolution, and end-to-end testing across standard and exception scenarios.
Track implementation milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and open issues; provide timely stakeholder updates and escalate blockers appropriately.
Maintain standardized implementation documentation and promote reuse of global requirements, templates, mappings, and solution components while accommodating legitimate country-specific requirements.
Qualifications & Skills
Mandatory
Experience analyzing and translating business and/or regulatory requirements into functional and system requirements.
Experience with data analysis and field mapping across enterprise systems or data sources.
Experience supporting end-to-end implementations or rollouts, including requirements, testing, readiness, go-live, and stabilization activities.
Experience developing or supporting test scenarios, UAT, data validation, and defect resolution.
Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders, including business, Finance/Tax, technology teams, local teams, and/or external providers.
Ability to manage implementation risks, dependencies, milestones, open issues, and documentation.
Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, communication, and documentation capabilities.
Good-to-Have
Prior exposure to e-invoicing and/or e-reporting implementations.
Understanding of country-specific electronic invoicing models such as submission, clearance, and reporting.
Experience working across ERP, billing, tax, customer, or vendor data environments.
Experience supporting multi-country or global implementations.
Exposure to Finance, Accounts Receivable, invoice-delivery, tax compliance, or related processes.
Experience working with external e-invoicing or technology service providers.
Self-Assessment Questions
Do I have hands-on experience translating complex business or regulatory requirements into clear functional or system requirements?
Have I performed detailed data or field mapping across multiple enterprise systems or data sources?
Have I supported an implementation through requirements, testing, readiness, go-live, and stabilization?
Am I comfortable developing test scenarios, supporting UAT, validating data, and coordinating defect resolution?
Have I successfully coordinated work across multiple business, technology, and external stakeholders while managing risks and dependencies?

This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS & GCP to build at scale.
Job Description
We are seeking a highly specialized Infrastructure Engineer Specialist to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on WAF configuration management and building robust DevSecOps automation frameworks. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments.
Basic Requirements
Key Responsibilities
1. WAF Configuration & Lifecycle Management
Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
Optimization & Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
2. DevSecOps Automation Frameworks
Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.
Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs.
Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments.
Policy as Code (PaC): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production
Required Qualifications
Experience: 10+ years in Infrastructure Engineering or DevSecOps, with a significant track record in high-traffic environments.
Primary Tech Stack: Extensive experience in WAF configuration management (e.g., F5, Signal Sciences, CloudFront WAF) and Nginx/Kubernetes Ingress Controllers.
Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in building DevSecOps automation frameworks. Expert-level skill in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python or Go).
Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy-as-code principles, and cloud-native security orchestration.
Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency in developing custom WAF rules (iRules, ModSecurity).
Experience with GitOps workflows for infrastructure security.
Certifications: Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) or advanced security automation credentials.

Position Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Principal Observability & Event Management Engineer to champion enterprise-wide initiatives that improve monitoring effectiveness, reduce alert noise, and accelerate incident response.
In this dual-impact role, you will act as both a strategic leader and a hands-on technical expert. You will define the enterprise standards for multi-domain monitoring (infrastructure, cloud, application, network, batch, and mainframe) while actively designing and configuring our Event Management platforms—specifically Oracle Unified Assurance (Assure1) and IBM Netcool. The ideal candidate will leverage data insights, machine learning, and automation to transform massive "event storms" into high-fidelity, actionable signals.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Governance
Drive Enterprise Initiatives: Own and lead cross-functional, enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving monitoring effectiveness, optimizing alert quality, and reducing incident volumes.
Define Standards: Establish corporate standards, approaches, and best practices for alert optimization across infrastructure, application, batch, network, and mainframe environments.
Culture & Mentorship: Mentor, guide, and evangelize a strong observability and optimization mindset across engineering and operations teams.
Continuous Improvement: Identify systemic gaps in monitoring design and lead long-term, architectural improvements to eliminate redundant or low-value alerts.
Platform Engineering & Administration
Infrastructure Design: Implement, maintain, and scale Oracle Assure1 / Unified Assurance servers and architectures for high-availability (HA) enterprise environments.
Event Correlation & Enrichment: Develop advanced Object-Server configurations, triggers, and correlation rules to distinguish isolated anomalies from critical root causes.
Multi-Vendor Integration: Integrate multi-vendor telemetry, logs, faults, and data from disparate monitoring domains into a single, unified Event Management UI.
Operations & Backend Support: Manage backend databases (e.g., MySQL, OpenSearch), maintain platform availability, and troubleshoot complex backend issues.
Automation, AIOps & Incident Response
Incident Automation: Write robust automation scripts and workflows to bridge monitoring tools with ITSM platforms (such as ServiceNow) to accelerate incident response times.
AIOps & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, topological discovery, and data-driven approaches to enhance event correlation, suppress noise, and automate self-healing or ticket generation.

Total Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in enterprise Event Management, Fault Management, Service Level Management, or production environments.
Initiative Leadership: 3+ years of proven experience leading large-scale, cross-functional improvements in monitoring effectiveness, alert optimization, or incident reduction.
Technical Expertise
Platform Expertise: Hands-on, deep technical experience with Oracle Unified Assurance / Assure1 and/or IBM Netcool suites (OMNIbus, Netcool Impact, ITM).
OS & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Linux Administration (RHEL) and expert-level scripting skills (Python, Bash, Perl, or Shell) for building event parsers and API integrations.
Databases & APIs: Solid understanding of backend database management, SQL queries, REST APIs, and tool customization using rule files and OpenSearch.

jobs.description:

As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle.
You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment.
You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions.
In this role you will work with various Engineering and Quality Reliability Assurance Groups to provide technical support, expertise, consultation and training. You should expect to support customers both internal and external to Micron on an on-going basis.
Responsibilities And Tasks
Manage Reliability evaluations for deviation management
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)
Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability
Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring
Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report
Digital & AI Tool Usage
Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI platforms, and other generative AI solutions) to enhance engineering effectiveness, automate routine tasks, analyze large datasets, and improve decision quality.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, and improve knowledge sharing within the organization.
Provide Expertise, Consultation and Training
Communicate Globally with NAND, Firmware, BUs and Engineering Groups for priority management
Provide training to engineers and technicians within and outside of the group
Maintain knowledge base (lessons learned) within the group for each SSD market segment
Stay abreast of Quality and Reliability issues of Micron NAND components
Provide consultation for audits, RMA, and customer issues
Education
Required: Master's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field

Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree and strong academic performance, relevant internships, research projects, or semiconductor-related experience may also be considered.
Experience
Exposure through coursework, academic research, internships, co-op programs, or project work in one or more of the following areas is preferred: Solid State Drive (SSD) products and storage technologies, Non-Volatile Memory (NAND, NOR, UFS, eMMC, SSD) technologies, Semiconductor device engineering, Semiconductor process integration engineering, Semiconductor quality and reliability engineering
Experience applying engineering principles to solve complex technical problems through academic, research, or internship projects.
Demonstrated ability to effectively utilize Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to improve productivity, automate routine tasks, accelerate data analysis, and enhance technical documentation.
Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted tools in daily engineering activities while exercising sound technical judgment, critical thinking, and responsible data handling practices.
Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a fast-paced semiconductor product development environment.

Fundamental knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing and wafer fabrication processes

Basic understanding of Solid State Drive (SSD) architecture and operation
Familiarity with storage interface standards such as SATA, PCIe, and NVMe through coursework, projects, or internships

Title and Summary
Lead Software Engineer
Position Overview
The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard’s Services organization are building industry-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients.
We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Lead Software Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements—such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability—ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams in building scalable services, APIs, and analytical capabilities that power our platform, leveraging technologies like Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. You will collaborate closely with your immediate team and partner with other development teams across programs to align on shared goals, define cross-cutting initiatives, and deliver cohesive, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also mentor engineers, work across global time zones, and champion engineering excellence through best practices in software development, observability, and continuous delivery.
Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle—from ideation and design to implementation and testing—fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.
We are seeking passionate and talented technologists who share our vision of empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Join us and help shape the future growth of our team.
Who is Mastercard?
Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you.
Position Responsibilities:
At Mastercard Services, you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands-on engineer for BE&O’s next-generation experimentation and analytics platform. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead through technical influence, architectural judgment, and execution excellence to help modernize our platform and deliver scalable, secure, cloud-native capabilities for global business users.
Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, data-intensive software solutions that enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decisioning for Mastercard clients.
Define and drive technical strategy for modernization initiatives, including evolution of legacy systems toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and service-oriented architectures.
Lead system design across multiple levels of detail, including platform architecture, high-level design, detailed technical design, integration patterns, non-functional requirements, and implementation approach.
Serve as a hands-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle.
Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks.
Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
Coordinate and lead technical execution across globally distributed engineering teams, ensuring alignment across regions, time zones, dependencies, design decisions, and delivery milestones.
Drive architecture and design reviews, code reviews, technical decision-making, and engineering tradeoff discussions to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, observable, performant, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Title and Summary
AI Principal Architect
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
• Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
• Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
• Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
• Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
• Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
• Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
• Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
• Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
• Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
• Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
• Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.
All About You
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
• Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
• Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
• Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
• Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
• A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
• The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
• Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
• Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
• Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Work closely with architects to define and design complex protocol bridges. Define and implement range-based access control for secured memory and register paths across HBW and LBW. Own privilege qualification and policy propagation across AXI-Lite, APB, IOSF-SB, and HBW request paths. Design and validate parity/ECC generation and checking for request, response, and data channels. Design counters, sticky status, snapshots, and firmware-visible CSRs that make performance and failure analysis practical. Integrate trigger, monitor, and logging hooks needed for bring-up, stress triage, and post-silicon correlation. Work with architecture, validation, firmware, and post-silicon teams to ensure telemetry and debug signals are useful, stable, and diagnosable. Balance observability depth against area, timing, bandwidth, and survivability constraints. Support root-cause analysis of bandwidth loss, latency outliers, protocol stalls, and intermittent field or lab issues using hardware observability features.

Experience with RAS concepts such as fault containment, poison, interrupt generation, logging, and recovery-oriented design.
