jobs.description:
Job Description
Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Lead
Location: Pune, India
Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk.
About Zendesk
At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy.
The Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Observability & Monitoring Lead with 6+ years of industry experience to spearhead our SRE and observability strategy. You will be responsible for maturing our monitoring ecosystem, driving operational excellence, and reducing system downtime through proactive detection and incident management. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, ensuring that observability data directly translates into improved reliability, SLA compliance, and reduced MTTR.You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes.
What You’ll Do
Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation).
Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection.
Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations.
Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto-
Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics
Incident Reduction: Develop and execute strategies to systematically reduce the volume of high-priority incidents through trend analysis and proactive stability improvements.
Incident Automation: Lead the engineering of automated response workflows and self-healing capabilities to minimize manual intervention and accelerate resolution times.
Strategy & Architecture: Design and coordinate with engineering teams for comprehensive observability strategies, including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems.

Process Automation: Drive the automation of incident reporting, alert correlation rules, and "alert fatigue" reduction. Transform raw telemetry data into actionable executive insights.
SRE Leadership: Responsible for managing the L1 SRE Engineers who will be handling the automated monitoring incidents in day to day operations.
Governance & Leadership: Manage governance calls, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews, and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with domain team leads to define SLOs/SLIs, align on capacity planning, and ensure documentation (Runbooks/HLD/LLD) is maintained to "single point of failure" (SPOF) standards.
What You Bring
Experience: 6+ years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications.
Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools.
Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets.
Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python.
Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS
ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews.
Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives.
Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages.
Nice to Have
Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance.
Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems.
Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog).

Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows.
Part of an on-call rotation with follow-the-sun support.

Zendesk
Position Overview
Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. You will oversee end-to-end delivery excellence, manage key client relationships, lead a diverse team of talented professionals, and ensure our India operations support global business objectives while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery and client satisfaction.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Job Title. - Salesforce Devops - SRE
Department - Employee Services Technology & Operations – CIO RUN Function
Experience Level - 4 – 8 Years
Location - Pune, India (Hybrid)
Shift Pattern - APAC and EMEA Shift
Reporting Manager - Yashwant Sinha
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Devops engineer with 5+ years of technical expertise to join our team within the CIO RUN function. In this role, you will bridge engineering, operations, and business systems—driving system stability, proactive detection, and rapid incident mitigation while leading administration, enhancement, and process optimization across our Salesforce and Quote to Cash (Q2C) platform ecosystems.
You will be responsible for hands-on configuration of observability platforms, triaging system alerts and user reports, managing incident response workflows, enforcing end-to-end ITIL lifecycles (Incident, Problem, and Change Management), and configuring Salesforce applications (custom objects, validation rules, flows, profiles/permissions, and Q2C workflows) to support evolving administrative and business requirements.
Primary Platforms: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Core Sales and Salesforce CPQ / Q2C. Zuora Billing knowledge is a plus. Over time, you may also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications in the Salesforce value stream.
Key Responsibilities
Partner and collaborate with end users to understand administrative needs, resolve issues and meet business requirements.
Handle both end user tickets and monitoring tickets from ITIL perspective with end to end ownership maintaining required response and resolution SLA targets.
Liaise with the problem manager to identify repeated incidents and engage with level 2 or domain teams for permanent fixes.
Able to manage high impact major incidents P1/P2 and able to perform initial level troubleshooting and triaging.
Develop and mentor others around application customization via custom objects, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, etc
Implement, own and optimize internal processes to improve efficiency.
Document procedures, policies, and systems in Runbooks, SOPs and KEDBs/KB Articles.
Manage and own system administration and help streamline business functionality including: profiles/permissions, role hierarchy, security models, application customization, reports and dashboards, etc
In future , also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications relating to Salesforce value streams.
Detailed Roles & Responsibilities
Core Sales & ITCRM Support Responsibilities :-
User & Access Administration: Manage end-to-end user administration, including logins, MFA troubleshooting, password resets, license assignments, profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing settings across Core Sales and Salesforce environments.
Visibility & UI Administration: Administer and adjust field-level security, custom fields, page layouts, record types, list views, report access, and button/tab visibility to support smooth end-user workflows.
Light Data & Config Operations: Execute routine data fixes, picklist updates, public group management, delegated approver setups, and light operational configuration updates.
Triage & Routing: Actively monitor and triage the ITCRM support queue and incoming requests, accurately categorizing issues, resolving L1/L2 admin queries, and routing non-admin requests (such as CPQ incidents or complex integrations) to appropriate domain teams.
ITIL-Based Incident & Request Handling: Own and drive ITIL-aligned Incident and Service Request lifecycles for Core Sales, meeting defined SLA targets for response and resolution times while maintaining clean documentation and knowledge base updates.
Salesforce & Quote to Cash (Q2C) Administration:-
Partner and collaborate with business stakeholders and end users to understand administrative needs, gather requirements, and resolve system issues.
Design, configure, and customize Salesforce applications using custom objects, validation rules, workflows, Flows, and Process Builder.
Manage system administration and streamline business functionality, including user profiles/permissions, role hierarchies, security models, reports, and dashboards.
Implement, own, and optimize internal Quote to Cash (Q2C) processes to drive operational efficiency across revenue and billing systems.
Triage & Incident Management:-
Actively triage incoming system alerts and user-reported issues, minimizing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR).
Participate in incident swarming and real-time operational response utilizing modern collaboration and ITSM tools such as Incident.io, Datadog, Jira, and Slack.
Oversee the lifecycle of monitoring tickets, maintaining strict adherence to SLA compliance and response metrics.
Problem & Change Management:-
Assist problem manager to conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and facilitate Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) to eliminate recurring incidents for Salesforce CPQ & Core Salesforce.
Maintain and expand the Known Error Database (KEDB) and runbook documentation to mitigate Single Point of Failure (SPOF) risks across operational workflows.
Assist change manager in reviewing and governing change requests, verifying risk assessments and rollback plans to maintain operational continuity.
Tooling & Integration Management:-
Monitor, troubleshoot, and support bi-directional SaaS integrations and data pipelines (e.g., Salesforce-to-Zuora, Workato, AWS Lambda, and EHC/Zendesk platforms).
Ensure seamless data flow across ticketing and incident management ecosystems, collaborating with engineering leads to resolve integration breaks.
Required Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, System Engineering, NOC or Global Command Centre environments.
Observability & Systems Analysis: Hands-on experience handling telemetry-triggered incidents (APM, metrics, tracing in Datadog/Dynatrace) combined with strong business systems analysis capability in enterprise SaaS applications.
ITIL Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks, specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management integration.
Cloud & Architecture: Technical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), API integrations, payload troubleshooting, and database querying via SQL.
Salesforce & Q2C Expertise: Demonstrated experience administering Salesforce platforms, managing Quote to Cash (Q2C) workflows, configuring security models/permissions, and building declarative automations (Flows, validation rules)
Operational Drive: Proven track record in reducing alert fatigue, managing complex system environments, and maintaining composure during high-priority outage events.
Nice to Have
ITIL 4 Foundation certification or specialized certifications in Incident/Problem Management.
Prior experience in service-based or consulting environments with broad, multi-client operational exposure.
Background in a global technology company supporting enterprise-grade, business-critical SaaS systems and distributed topologies.
AWS , Salesforce and Integration/Middleware knowledge will be an addon.
Zuora Billing knowledge (subscriptions, amendments, charges, invoicing)
Salesforce Admin / CPQ / Platform certification.

Enterprise Account Executive - North & East India
Join us at Zendesk, where we're on a mission to power exceptional service for every person on the planet. We're accelerating our ambition by building products rooted in the belief that behind every interaction is an opportunity to make a human connection.

Directly drive top-line revenue growth by acquiring new Enterprise customers and developing strategies to penetrate top tier accounts.

Manage and nurture key customer relationships to ensure maximum satisfaction and retention, fostering long-term strategic partnerships.

Create quarterly territory plans, developing strategies and actionable tactics to increase our market share in the Enterprise sector.

Collaborate effectively with internal teams and leadership to optimize sales strategies and drive sales execution.
Negotiate and close complex deals, leveraging a consultative approach, utilizing your exceptional communication skills to present compelling business cases and value propositions.

BA/BS degree or equivalent experience required.

Authoring documentation: Write help articles, release notes, and examples that enable customers to use and configure Alteryx products.

About Yugabyte
At Yugabyte, we are on a mission to become the default transactional database for enterprises building cloud-native applications. YugabyteDB is our PostgreSQL compatible distributed database for cloud-native apps. Resilient, scalable, and flexible, it runs on any cloud and enables developers to become instantly productive using well-known APIs.We are looking for talented and driven people to join us on our ambitious mission and help us build a lasting and impactful company.The transactional database market is estimated to grow to $150B by 2030. YugabyteDB is cloud-native by design, has on-demand horizontal scalability, and supports geographical distribution of data using built-in replication. This means that we are well-positioned to meet market demand for geo-distributed, high-scale, high-performance workloads.
Yugabyte offers a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical excellence, with opportunities to impact a cutting-edge distributed SQL database used by global enterprises. As a member of the DST team, you’ll help meet growing demand for high-scale, high-performance, globally distributed transactional workloads — instrumental to our product’s success.
Role Overview
As a Staff Engineer on the Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST) team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the core distributed storage, replication, and transaction foundations of YugabyteDB.
You will work on some of the most challenging problems in distributed systems — including consistency, durability, fault tolerance, performance, and scalability — while collaborating closely with query layer, platform, and cloud teams. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in low-level systems work and want to shape the future of a globally distributed database.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, testing, and delivery of core storage and replication features in YugabyteDB.
Write high-quality C/C++ code with comprehensive automated tests; actively participate in design discussions and code reviews.
Troubleshoot and resolve correctness, stability, and performance issues in complex distributed storage and transactional subsystems.
Improve database scalability and throughput as cluster sizes, data volumes, and transaction rates continue to grow.
Build and streamline database management operations, including:
Horizontal cluster scale-out
Incremental and point-in-time backups
Online schema and index operations
Rolling upgrades and blue-green deployments
Identify and implement performance improvements across the storage engine, transaction processing, and replication layers.
Contribute to the open-source YugabyteDB project, helping evolve its storage architecture and operational reliability.
Mentor and technically influence other engineers in distributed systems design, performance engineering, and systems-level debugging.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in systems programming using C/C++.
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science (or related field), or equivalent practical experience.
Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including:
Replication and consensus
Transactions and consistency models
Fault tolerance and recovery
Experience working on storage engines, databases, or other infrastructure-level systems.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, distributed team environment
Preferred Skills
Hands-on experience with distributed storage systems, transactional engines, or consensus protocols.
Familiarity with LSM-tree based storage engines, WALs, snapshots, or compaction strategies.
Experience with PostgreSQL internals or other relational database engines is a strong plus.
Prior contributions to open-source systems or database projects.

An overview of this role
This role is not a typical infrastructure operations role. As Manager, Engineering, Git & Gitaly Operations, you'll lead the team responsible for the infrastructure layer underneath Git at GitLab: the open source Git project itself, Gitaly, GitLab's Git storage and remote procedure call layer, and the services that make Git perform at enterprise scale.
Git and Gitaly are core to GitLab. If they go sideways in production, they affect everything downstream, including continuous integration, code review, and deployments. This role starts with genuine subject matter expertise in Git technologies and extends to reliable operation across GitLab's deployment models: Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.
You'll build and develop a team with deep platform expertise and strong operational judgment. You'll partner across engineering groups to shape how Git and Gitaly operations evolve as the platform grows.
What you’ll do
Build and lead a team with deep platform expertise in Git and Gitaly, hiring and developing engineers who can operate this infrastructure layer with strong operational judgment.
Own production reliability for Git and Gitaly across GitLab's full deployment footprint.
Drive incident management, root cause investigation, and postmortems with the technical depth to distinguish a Git internals problem from a generic infrastructure problem.
Design and operate Git and Gitaly service models that work across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS, with a clear view of which elements are common and which must differ between them.
Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives.
Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks.
Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.
Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.
What you’ll bring
Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git and Gitaly support repository operations across self-managed, dedicated, and SaaS environments.
Hands-on subject matter expertise in Git internals, including how the protocol, object model, and storage layer behave under load and at scale, not only familiarity with Git usage.
Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, failure handling, and horizontal scalability.
Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible path from adjacent experience to it.
Experience with elastic storage and compute, and consumption-based system design for variable, unpredictable load.
People management experience, ideally leading site reliability engineering-style or platform operations teams.
Direct experience with Gitaly, libgit2, JGit, or another Git implementation's internals is advantageous.
Experience operating cloud-agnostic infrastructure across multiple hyperscalers or on-premises environments is advantageous.
About the team
The Git & Gitaly Operations team owns the Git infrastructure layer that powers GitLab and works at the intersection of Git internals, distributed systems, storage, and production operations.
We expect the Git & Gitaly Operations team to go deep on one of GitLab's most critical platforms. The work requires technical depth, strong operational discipline, and the ability to solve complex reliability and scaling challenges in Git and Gitaly.

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.
In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.
What you'll do
Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.
Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.
Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.
Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.
What you'll bring
Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.
A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.
Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.
The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.
Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.
Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.
Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.
Nice to have:  Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.
About the team
The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.
Why you’ll love this role
Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.
User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.
What you’ll do
Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.

Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.

Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.
Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.
You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.
Some of our projects include:
Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
Improving service accounts and secure automation
Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)
What you'll do
Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.
What you'll bring
Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.
Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. 
Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.
Some examples of the projects you could work on:
Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab
Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)
Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants
Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale
Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response
Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)
Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure
What You’ll Do
Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.
Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.
Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.
Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.
Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.
Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.
What You’ll Bring
Production-Scale Experience: Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.
Terraform & IaC Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.
Kubernetes in Production: Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.
Programming & Code Analysis: Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.

Architecture & Incident Response: Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.
Customer-Focused Collaboration: Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication.
GitLab Platform Proficiency: Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.

Our goal is to eliminate manual operations across the entire lifecycle of customer environments, including provisioning, upgrades, security, and monitoring, so customers can focus on unlocking the full potential of The One DevOps Platform without managing the underlying infrastructure. We build scalable, automated systems that ensure each GitLab Dedicated instance is secure, consistent, and production-ready—whether we're managing 10 environments or hundreds.

Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.
Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.

Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.
Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.
Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or  Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.

Distinguished AI Engineer
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
Team Description:
The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models. The team is also delivering capabilities on top of the platform to optimize the software development life-cycle to dramatically enhance developer productivity and model-development life cycle to improve time-to-market of machine learning models.
In this role, you will:
Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, evals engine, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Devise novel context generation techniques that optimize cost / quality trade-offs.
Design and implement capabilities for automated monitoring, anomaly detection and RCA for multi-turn and headless agentic applications.
You will collaborate with lines of businesses to design and implement high value agentic applications
Finally you will coach and evangelize, mentoring Staff, Principal and Senior engineers, authoring technical design documents and blogs and representing Capital One at Tier1 AI conferences.
The Ideal Candidate:
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.
You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java

10+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
4+ years of experience architecting, designing, developing, integrating, delivering, and supporting complex AI systems
6+ years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang

Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers

jobs.title: Staff Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
Are you a customer-centric professional with a strong technical aptitude and exceptional communication skills, eager to take on the challenges of managing relationships with clients in a dynamic environment? If so, you would want to join our team as a Staff Technical Account Manager to play a crucial role in driving customer success and adoption of Nutanix products, while working in a collaborative, supportive culture alongside experienced professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence.
About the Team
The Staff Technical Account Manager will be joining the TAM team at Nutanix India. This team is dedicated to providing exceptional support and service to customers across the APAC region, fostering a strong customer-centric culture characterized by collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect. The mission of the team is to drive customer success and maximize the value of Nutanix products, ensuring that clients realize their full potential and return on investment through proactive engagement and expert guidance.
This role reports to the Service Delivery Leader – India and is primarily on-site, with the expectation of being based in Mumbai to support customer requirements and facilitate effective engagement with customers located in the region. Travel outside Mumbai is not a primary requirement for this role; however, occasional domestic travel may be necessary to support customer engagements, face-to-face meetings, or organizational requirements. The role primarily involves on-site service delivery at customer locations, with the flexibility to accommodate evolving customer needs and preferences.
Your Role
Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the customer’s Nutanix environment, including license consumption and activation, asset refresh opportunities, capacity utilization, software versions, support cases, and feature adoption.
Drive product adoption, platform optimization, and customer experience by identifying opportunities to enhance value realization, recommending relevant features and use cases, improving capacity utilization, and sharing best practices based on usage maturity and business objectives.
Proactively collaborate with Support and Engineering teams to drive timely resolution of critical technical issues, ensuring appropriate prioritisation, visibility, escalation, and stakeholder alignment.
Assess customer enablement needs and coordinate tailored training programs, workshops, and boot camps to strengthen technical proficiency and maximize product adoption.
Proactively identify software lifecycle and upgrade requirements, advising customers on the benefits of adopting the latest supported versions and developing upgrade roadmaps aligned with their business priorities and operational requirements.
Recommend and oversee periodic platform health checks to assess environment stability, performance, resilience, and adherence to Nutanix best practices, driving remediation of identified risks and optimization opportunities.
Orchestrate cross-functional Nutanix expertise, including Professional Services, Consulting, Support, and Solution Architects, to deliver targeted technical deep dives, address complex customer challenges, and support strategic initiatives.
Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, translating platform insights and operational metrics into actionable recommendations that improve customer outcomes, strengthen adoption, and maximize the value of their Nutanix investment.
This role is fully on-site, requiring work from the customer’s office (in Mumbai) five days a week to enable close collaboration with customer teams. Your manager will provide additional guidance on team-specific expectations and working norms.
What You Will Bring
10–14 years of relevant professional experience in technical, customer-facing roles such as Technical Account Management, Systems Engineering, or Technical Support, preferably within enterprise technology environments.
Strong technical expertise in virtualization, cloud computing, and data center technologies, with mandatory hands-on knowledge of the Nutanix technology stack.
In-depth understanding of IT infrastructure components, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and hybrid/multicloud environments.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric mindset and the ability to engage effectively with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.
Proven experience in technical account management, strategic customer engagement, and building trusted, long-term customer relationships.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams, including Support, Engineering, Professional Services, and Solution Architects, to drive customer success and resolve complex technical challenges.
Strong consultative engagement skills, with the ability to understand customer business objectives, identify technical and operational challenges, and recommend solutions that drive product adoption, platform optimization, and business value.
Ability to proactively manage customer expectations, identify risks and opportunities, influence stakeholders, and drive strategic account initiatives.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or a related technical discipline; a postgraduate or advanced degree is an added advantage.
Work Arrangement
This role is fully on-site, requiring work from the customer’s office in Mumbai five days a week to enable close collaboration with customer teams. Your manager will provide additional guidance on team-specific expectations and working norms.

About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company that enables financial access and commerce through assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services. NCR Atleos serves financial and public-sector organizations in more than 100 countries and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.
The opportunity
As an Application Security Compliance Lead, you will help ensure that NCR Atleos software products and development practices meet applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements. Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for assessments, and help demonstrate that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.
A major focus is organization-level PCI Software Security Framework (SSF) activities: support product teams to achieve and retain PCI Secure Software Standard listings and maintain validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance expertise with software development and application security knowledge.
What you will do
Govern the Secure SDLC. Maintain and improve practices aligned with the PCI Secure SLC Standard.
Enable PCI SSF validation. Guide teams through external assessment, self-assessment, annual attestation and periodic revalidation activities.
Interpret requirements. Translate security, privacy, legal and industry requirements into clear, proportionate guidance.
Assess readiness and close gaps. Coordinate reviews, evidence, gap analysis, remediation and resolution of findings.
Engage and influence. Partner with engineering, Legal, risk, compliance and security teams, QSAs and the PCI SSC.
Build capability. Create training and reusable guidance; monitor developments and communicate material changes.
Drive continual improvement. Use industry changes, stakeholder feedback, internal audits, assessment outcomes, recurring findings, and incidents to strengthen controls and processes.
What you will bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Typically, 7+ years of relevant experience in application security, software security assurance, secure software development, technology risk, privacy, compliance, or audit.
Practical experience developing, operating, governing or assessing a Secure SDLC.
Experience interpreting security or compliance requirements and supporting assessments, evidence collection, gap analysis and remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management, security testing, and risk-based decision-making.
Technical understanding of cloud services, source-code management, and CI/CD practices sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Ability to convert complex requirements into pragmatic guidance and make evidence-based recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a globally distributed team.
Comfortable using AI assistants, such as Copilot, responsibly in day-to-day work to improve personal productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
A bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience and qualifications.
Desirable experience and capabilities
Direct experience of PCI SSF validation or a comparable software security assurance framework.
Knowledge of payment-card security, GDPR requirements, NIST CSF and OWASP standards and guidance.
Experience delivering application security or compliance-related training.
Knowledge of security and governance for AI-enabled software development and products.
A relevant certification, such as CISSP, CSSLP, CIPP, CIPT or CIPM.
How you will succeed
Teams receive clear, timely, and actionable compliance guidance.
PCI SSF validation activities are well planned, appropriately evidenced, and progressed effectively.
Compliance gaps and findings are clearly owned, prioritized, tracked, and resolved.
Secure SDLC requirements remain practical, current, and consistently understood.
Assessment and incident lessons lead to sustainable improvements and strong stakeholder relationships.
Evidence we value
In your application, we would particularly welcome examples of how you have interpreted a security standard, prepared a product or organization for assessment, resolved a significant compliance gap, or influenced an engineering team to adopt a more effective security practice.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Are you looking for an exciting new chance to build on your experience working on business-led change initiatives? Arm is changing the future of computing across multiple sectors from mobile clients and automotive through to Hyperscalers and embedded devices. And we're doing this together with our broad ecosystem of partners and for the benefit of everyone!
You will be part of Arm’s Enterprise IT Business Applications Architecture practice and work across the portfolio of projects to provide architectural guidance and solutions to business challenges that are aligned to strategy and EIT roadmaps. You will also be responsible for technical leadership and direction to development and delivery teams, ensuring delivery of your designs is adequately stewarded and also collaborating across teams to find opportunities for new technologies.
Responsibilities:
Interpret Business Needs
Collaborate with senior leaders to identify future technology innovations and evolutions that have potential to address business ambitions
Develop solutions designs (HLD) and roadmaps aligned to the Domain target
Maintain mapping between Capabilities, Applications and Data
Assess and Apply Technology
Be creative in the use of existing technologies
Work with members of the technical communities to develop and establish reference patterns for Platforms and Solutions
Look ahead for opportunities with new technologies and applications
Technical leadership

Ownership of solution pattern and approach, responsible for sign-off on High-Level designs and ensuring alignment to target and roadmaps

Guide and mentor teams on architecture principles, governance, and standard practices
Drive innovation by researching and evaluating emerging technologies that align with business needs

At least 8 years of experience in a Solution Architect role.
Strong experience with Salesforce, SAP, and integration platforms (e.g., Mulesoft, event-driven architectures, MS Power Platform, Automation Anywhere).

Expertise in cloud services (multi-provider, AI, cloud-native development).
Experience with DevSecOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.
Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term needs and define multiple solution options.
Familiarity with Business Analysis, Programme Management, and application development methodologies.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies
Demonstrable experience in project governance, leadership, and architecture team development.

jobs.description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Develop and execute comprehensive test plans in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external customers
Define and assess with product engineering details of required prototype
Evaluate and propose most suitable prototype manufacturing process
Design, develop, operate & maintain complex test equipment and automated data acquisition systems, using programming applications such as LabVIEW, FlexLogger, DIAdem, and DeltaV.
Build and integrate custom test systems using National Instruments (NI) hardware and electromechanical components
Analyze experimental results and prepare clear, data-driven engineering reports including conclusions and recommendations
Create, document, and implement engineering best practices
Interpret industry standards that pertain to HPBV testing and coordinate testing associated with certification.
Provide technical input and direction to the design and evaluation of new product concepts, including conceptualization, design review, and testing of complex products.
Lead future development of lab space specific to Isolation Valve testing.
Drive efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory
Mentor and support other engineers while promoting best practices and continuous learning
Work effectively in a global and local team with the ability to work independently in local test facility to drive projects forward.
Leverage expertise in valve test methods and lead continuous improvement and implementation of test technologies across the global labs
Perform additional duties or special projects as assigned by the Engineering Manager
Who You Are:
You take on new opportunities and challenging assignments with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. You apply knowledge of business and engineering drivers to advance work and achieve meaningful results. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives while fostering an inclusive and respectful environment. You consistently deliver on commitments by holding yourself accountable for quality, safety, and performance outcomes.
For This Role, You Will Need:
Proven competency and experience with data acquisition systems and instrumentation of mechanical systems
Strong analytical, problem solving, critical thinking and decision-making skills
Demonstrated commitment to safety and risk management in planning process
Ability to apply fundamental knowledge of mathematics and physical sciences to real-world applications supporting the development of products, test equipment, test procedures, and measurement techniques.
Background in machine design, material selection and manufacturing methods
Working experience in CAD software, such as Inventor, AutoCAD, Solidwork.
Experience with pressure retaining materials, material coatings, and wear mechanisms
Background in machine design, material selection and manufacturing methods
Hands on experience with design/certification standards like EN 12516, ASME standards, API 609, AWWA, ISO15848, API 607, TSx, SIL etc.
New product designs, development, hands on experience with design verification tools such as 6σ, GD&T, DFMEA, QFD, DFM/A and engineering calculations
Strong communication skills
Must be well organized, detail oriented and capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously
Willingness to work outside traditional work hours to interact with supporting locations globally
Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
Minimum Educational Requirements:
Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering discipline
English fluent – verbal and writing, any additional language is a plus
Minimum Work Experience Required:
Min. of 8 years related experience with min. of 5 years in the area of industrial valves
Experience in matrix organization with skip level reporting
Experience working with remote/global teams
Our Culture & Commitment to You:
At Emerson, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and stronger business outcomes. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute.
We invest in professional growth, encourage continuous learning, and provide opportunities to work on meaningful engineering challenges that impact global industries. Our collaborative culture promotes knowledge sharing, innovation, accountability, and a commitment to safety and operational excellence.
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals across the world, contribute to cutting-edge product development, and help shape the future of valve testing and evaluation technologies.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian India
Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear.
Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere.
Your future team: KubePlat Team
The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products.
What we own:
Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments.
Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts.
Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices.
Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on.
Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads.
Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day.
AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features.
We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale.
As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch.
What you'll do
Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters.
Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources.
Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP).
Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation.

jobs.description:

These breakthroughs are ushering in the Era of Smart Everything. And we’re powering it all with the world’s most advanced technologies for chip design and software security. If you share our passion for innovation, we want to meet you.
Our Silicon Design & Verification business is all about building high-performance silicon chips—faster. We’re the world’s leading provider of solutions for designing and verifying advanced silicon chips. And we design the next-generation processes and models needed to manufacture those chips. We enable our customers to optimize chips for power, cost, and performance—eliminating months off their project schedules.
You Are:
You are a highly skilled and passionate engineer with a talent for tackling complex problems and a strong desire to advance cutting-edge technology. With over 3 to 5 years of experience in Physical Implementation RTL-GDS, you bring deep expertise in autonomously diagnosing and resolving synthesis and place-and-route (PnR) challenges. Proficient in scripting languages like Tcl, Unix, and Perl, you possess an in-depth knowledge of Synopsys implementation tools and methodologies, especially Fusion Compiler.
Your strong communication abilities enable you to engage effectively with both customers and internal teams, ensuring precise and attentive fulfilment of their needs. Driven, self-starting, and highly collaborative, you excel in environments where you can advocate for customers and represent the product. Drive global customer adoption of Synopsys Implementation products by providing expert technical guidance and support throughout the RTL-to-GDS flow.
Diagnose and resolve synthesis and place-and-route challenges, leveraging in-depth knowledge of customer designs and Synopsys tools.
Engage in technical campaigns—such as benchmarks, deployments, and new solution enablement—to fuel Synopsys solution adoption and improve usability.
Act as a customer advocate, collaborating with R&D to influence product roadmap and future technologies based on real-world feedback.
Author technical articles for the Knowledge Base, providing self-help guidance for common customer challenges.
Roll out new product methodologies to customers through training sessions and technical support engagements.

Deliver comprehensive support and effective technical solutions that elevate customer satisfaction and project success.
Drive innovation by tackling advanced design challenges and collaborating with R&D to enhance product performance.
Promote Synopsys implementation tools, expanding market presence and accelerating solution adoption.
Ensure seamless EDA transitions for customers, optimizing outcomes in power, cost, and performance.
Influence the development of next-generation processes and models for silicon chip manufacturing.
Empower engineering teams through technical mentorship and knowledge sharing.

Expertise in implementation methodologies, with deep hands-on experience in Synopsys Fusion Compiler.
Thorough understanding of RTL-to-GDS flows and methodologies, including synthesis, place & route, and timing analysis.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Tcl, Unix shell, Perl, and Python.
Experience in low-power flows, design planning, and static timing analysis (STA).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; prior customer-facing experience is a plus.

Domain knowledge in multiple chip tape-outs, preferably at 7nm or lower nodes across foundries.

Customer-focused problem solver with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
Strong communicator adept at translating complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
Innovative and resourceful, thriving in fast-paced, high-impact environments.
Self-starter who excels at independent and team-based work.
Committed to diversity, inclusion, and continuous learning.

jobs.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You are an early-career engineer ready to make your mark in semiconductor design. You have spent your academic years drawn to digital design that requires proof, not just simulation. When you see a spec, you think about corner cases and what could break. You have written Verilog or SystemVerilog, debugged logic that did not behave as expected, and you are comfortable in a Unix terminal. Formal verification might be new to you, but the rigor makes sense. You learn by doing, ask questions when stuck, and you do not mind being the person who finds the bug everyone else missed.
What You'll Be Doing
Learn the latest formal verification methodology from experts and apply your learnings to live projects.
Work with a team of seasoned FV engineers and execute validation as per defined plans.
Support quality improvements and contribute insights that help enhance verification tool capabilities.
Write and refine assertions in SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to capture design intent and uncover edge-case failures.
Script verification flows using Python, Perl, or Tcl to automate repetitive tasks and improve team productivity in Unix/Linux environments.
The Impact You Will Have
Help catch critical design bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months and millions to fix in silicon.
Contribute to the quality and reliability of Synopsys IP and EDA tools that power semiconductor development across the industry.
Accelerate verification closure on complex designs by applying formal methods that simulation alone cannot cover.
Strengthen the formal verification methodology at Synopsys by bringing fresh perspectives and identifying gaps in existing flows.
What You'll Need
Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline. (2026 Fresh Masters Grad Expected).
0 to 2 years of experience in digital design, verification, or related semiconductor work (internships, projects, and coursework count).
Strong understanding of computer architecture and digital design fundamentals including state machines, pipelining, and timing.
Hands-on experience with hardware description languages, Verilog or SystemVerilog preferred.
Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, Perl, or Tcl, and comfort working in Unix or Linux environments.
Solid academic performance with relevant coursework or project work in VLSI, digital design, or verification.
Experience with formal verification tools, assertion languages, or model checking is a strong plus.
Who You Are
You can look at a block diagram or RTL code and start asking the right questions about what could go wrong, not just what is supposed to work.
You are comfortable learning new tools and methodologies on the job without needing everything explained upfront, you read documentation, try things, and ask targeted questions when you are stuck.
You communicate clearly when you find something, whether it is a bug, a gap in coverage, or a script that is not working the way it should.
You are detail-oriented enough to track down a single-bit logic error in a complex design without losing sight of what the block is supposed to do.
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join a focused team at Synopsys dedicated to advancing formal verification methodologies and delivering proven IP and EDA solutions. You will collaborate with experienced formal verification engineers and design experts who are committed to pushing the boundaries of what formal methods can achieve. The team values rigorous thinking, continuous learning, and clear communication, creating an environment where your growth is supported.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half-fixed bothers you.
You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.
Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.
At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.
What You'll Be Doing
Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi-FPGA partitioning and hardware-software co-verification
Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real-world usage patterns
Support pre-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution
The Impact You Will Have
Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self-sufficient with the toolchain
Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective
What You'll Need
Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
Hands-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware-software integration
Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files
Who You Are
You can take a vague customer complaint like 'the compile is failing' and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R&D can act on it
You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre-sales evaluation through post-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.

jobs.description:

You work well with people in different disciplines and locations without needing to be the loudest person in the room.
