jobs.description: About the role and team At Uber, AI agents are increasingly writing, reviewing, testing, and debugging code in production. They deliver high-quality results efficiently, without wasting tokens, only when they understand Uber's codebases. The AI Context Engineering team builds the context foundation that every software-development AI agent at Uber relies on: AI Context Graph: a unified graph of services, ownership, domain entities, and business flows Code Graph: a graph representation of Uber's monorepos built for agents to consume AI-Generated Documentation: documentation that stays fresh as code changes Agentic Memory: a memory layer that lets agents learn across sessions As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of this platform end to end. You'll take them from prototype to production at monorepo scale, and work with partner teams to integrate foundational context products with the agents running in production for workflows such as root-cause analysis, code authoring, test planning, and library upgrades, etc What will you do Context Graph and Ontology: Enrich the graph with new entity types, such as data streams, metrics, and observability signals, and link them to code so agents can reason across systems. Code Graph Infrastructure: Build and scale code graphs across multiple monorepos and microrepos, covering symbols, call edges, dependencies, and links between code and tests. Add incremental updates, versioned (historical) graphs, and function-level embeddings, and serve the graphs to agents with low latency through local and remote interfaces. AI-Generated Documentation: Extend automated documentation from backend services to mobile (screens, UI components), libraries, and data pipelines. Use refresh strategies that keep context current as code changes. Agentic Memory: Design the memory layer that lets agents persist and reuse decisions, past fixes, and team preferences across sessions. Standards and Governance: Define and roll out standards for agent instruction files (AGENTS.md), including structure, content, and token budget, and generate them systematically across modules. Context Quality Evaluation: Build continuous evals that measure the accuracy and freshness of every context product, and run A/B experiments that prove the impact on agent outcomes. Tooling and Integration: Build MCP servers, skills, and tools that deliver context to agents. Partner with AI Platform, Developer Experience, and product teams to integrate them into production workflows. Technical Leadership: Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, and turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped, measurable projects What will you need Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience building production systems, with a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Programming: Strong in Go, Java, or Python, writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code. LLMs and Agentic Systems: Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents, including prompt and context design, tool use, and retrieval, and a good sense of what context makes agents succeed or fail. Code Understanding: Experience with static analysis, ASTs, parsers such as tree-sitter, or build and dependency systems in large codebases. Data at Scale: Experience building reliable data pipelines and working with graph or other large-scale data stores. Emerging Protocols: Familiarity with MCP and agent-to-agent protocols and how to apply them. Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and a habit of measuring outcomes, not just shipping features. Success Metrics More agentic workflows use curated context in production, with a measured improvement in each workflow's business metric, such as accuracy, cost, latency, or CI time. Agents provide higher-quality, better-grounded answers while using fewer tokens and tool calls than when they rediscover context from scratch. Context coverage grows across languages, repos, and entity types, with measurable accuracy and freshness. Bonus Points If you have Graph Databases: Experience with Neo4j or similar graph databases, including query optimization and schema design. Embeddings and RAG: Experience with embedding generation, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines. Evaluation: Experience designing LLM evals, LLM-as-judge methods, or A/B experiments for AI systems. Developer Platforms: Experience in developer tooling, CI, or monorepo infrastructure. Observability: Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse, or similar tools for monitoring AI systems. Ready to Ride? jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description: Overview: Analyst, Cockpit Reporting & AI-Enabled Solutions. Digital Planning Transformation | Global Finance Cockpit Team Why this role exists. Cockpit is the single reporting platform behind the organization's financial planning: 7,000+ users, 175,000+ views every month, with all Operating Units converging onto one standard. The dashboards are largely built. What we're building now is different. We want reporting that maintains itself: dashboards that validate their own numbers, documentation that writes itself, insights that reach people without someone spending a Tuesday assembling them by hand. That's where we intend to be in two years. We are not there yet, and we're hiring the person who helps us get there. Generative AI is already part of how this team works. It isn't a pilot or a side project. But we care far more about someone who can tell when a model is confidently wrong than someone who has collected prompting tricks. What you'll actually do. Build reporting people rely on (the core of the job)Sit with Operating Units and Finance teams to understand what they actually need, which is usually not what they first asked for. Build financial performance dashboards with real drill-down, following our standard frameworks Improve what already exists: faster, clearer, more consistent Watch how people really consume the data, from analysts to senior leaders, and redesign around what you see. Apply our data security and FP&A reporting standards. We'll teach you these, and you'll follow them carefully Make the work smarter (this part grows as you do)Use AI in daily delivery: drafting documentation, writing and debugging calculations and SQL, accelerating requirements analysis Build and refine prompts for the things we do repeatedly (validation, documentation, quality checks) and improve them based on whether the output actually got better Catch AI's mistakes before a business user does: invented logic, results that don't reconcile, errors that fail silently Find the manual, repetitive parts of our reporting cycle and propose how to automate them Grow into shaping our AI validation and quality frameworks alongside the teamwork with people. Partner with S&T so business requirements survive the translation into Cockpit Help train and support Cockpit usersTake on high-priority projects as they come upWhat we need from you Genuinely required0 to 2 years of experience in analytics, reporting, data or engineering. Internships, academic work and personal projects all count. Hands-on with at least one BI or data tool. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, or a data-engineering background built on SQL, Python and pipelines. We don't need a Tableau expert. We build them. Most people here are productive in Tableau within a few months. What we need is someone who has already built something real with data and can walk us through the decisions they made and why. You use generative AI for real work, not just chat. Show us one concrete thing you built, automated or solved faster because of it.Basic SQL. You can read a query, understand a join, and trace where a number came from. You check whether a number makes sense before you publish it. This matters more than any tool on this list. Decent English, written and spoken. Comfort with things being unfinished. Our tooling changes every few months. That's the job, not a defect in it.Helpful, but not expected Python, Databricks, or any cloud data platform APIs, automation tools, or anything you've built with AI beyond a chat window. Finance or FP&A background, or familiarity with P&L and performance reporting. Data modeling fundamentals (grain, joins, single source of truth)Not requiredTableau certification. Prior finance work experience. Having done this exact job before. If you're strong on judgment and genuinely fluent with AI, apply. We'll teach you the rest. What you'll be in 18 months. You'll understand how a global company actually plans and measures itself, and you'll have built reporting that thousands of people use to make real decisions. You'll be fluent in Tableau, working well past dashboard-building, and helping define how an AI-enabled reporting function operates. Very few people anywhere have done that yet. This role sits where finance, data and AI meet, and that intersection is where the interesting careers are being built right now. How we'll assess you1. A dashboard you build on your own time. We'll send you a dataset and a short brief. Build something you'd be comfortable putting in front of a finance team. Use whatever tool you're strongest in: Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Python, or something else. We are not testing which software you know.2. A conversation about what you built. You'll walk us through your reasoning: the design choices, what the data let you say and what it didn't, and where you weren't sure. Then we'll ask you to make a couple of changes to it live, with us. That's not a trap. It's the closest thing to how this job actually feels when a stakeholder changes their mind mid-review.3. A conversation about AI on real work. How you use it day to day, and how you decide whether to trust what it hands you. Using AI on the exercise is fine and expected. Just be ready to explain what you used it for and how you verified it. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Tableau dashboards, reports, and scorecards. Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into BI solutions. Write complex SQL queries and scripts to extract, transform, and validate data. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and business insights. Optimize Tableau workbooks and SQL queries for performance and scalability. Develop and maintain data models, data sources, and metadata documentation. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions. Work closely with business teams, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting requirements. Automate recurring reporting processes and improve operational efficiency. Troubleshoot data discrepancies and resolve dashboard-related issues. Participate in testing, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in Tableau dashboard development and SQL programming. Strong expertise in Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server/Cloud, and Tableau Prep. Advanced SQL skills with experience in writing complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning. Experience working with large datasets and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar. Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and data modeling. Experience gathering business requirements and working directly with stakeholders. Knowledge of KPI development, data visualization best practices, and dashboard design principles. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments. Exposure to FP&A, Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, or Operations reporting domains.

If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Description **Primary Focus**: End-to-end Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Delta Lake \& Lakebase Optimizations, Secure Lakehouse Management, Production Migrations, and Complex Pipeline Debugging. **Role Overview** We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer (Band 4C) to drive the design, development, optimization, and production deployment of our Finance1 Databrics platform. In this role, you will lead end-to-end data pipeline engineering, design scalable dimensional and lakehouse data models, manage end-to-end production migrations, and troubleshoot complex production issues. You will be responsible for query performance tuning, maintaining Delta table optimizations, enforcing strict data governance via Unity Catalog, and ensuring zero-downtime, high-availability data delivery across environments. **Key Responsibilities** Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade data models (Dimensional/Star Schema) alongside comprehensive Source-to-Target Mappings (STTM) and Seed Data Management. Production Debugging \& Operational Support: Troubleshoot and resolve complex production pipeline failures, memory leaks, Spark driver/worker OOM (Out Of Memory) issues, data skewness, schema drift, and performance bottlenecks. Performance Tuning \& Optimization: Perform execution plan analysis, query tuning, and compute optimization across Serverless/Classic SQL Warehouses, Delta table layout optimizations (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, Compaction), and caching strategies. Governance \& Security: Implement and enforce enterprise-grade data security, column/row-level access controls, data masking, and audit lineage using Databricks Unity Catalog. CI/CD \& Lakehouse Automation: Implement automated deployment pipelines for Databricks assets using Git, Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), and DevOps practices. **Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills** Experience: 6 to 10 years of core Data Engineering experience with strong, hands-on expertise on the Databricks Lakehouse platform. Production \& Debugging Expertise: Proven track record of managing production data pipelines, debugging complex distributed systems, analyzing Spark UI/DAG logs, and resolving operational outages. Migration Experience: Hands-on experience executing complex production migrations, data cutovers, schema evolution handling, and historical data loads. Core Technical Stack: PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake internals, Databricks SQL Warehouses, Lakebase, and Unity Catalog. Data Modeling \& STTM: Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling alongside detailed STTM creation. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations. Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents. Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence. Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations. Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations. Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. About the Team: The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems. Key Responsibilities: Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack. Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture. Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes. Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization. Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies. Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling. Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware. Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance. Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements. Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms. Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements. Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust. Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior. Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools. Preferred Qualifications: Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8. Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent. Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms. Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling. Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions. Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects. Why Join This Team? This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span: Agentic AI & LLMs AI frameworks inference runtimes Linux server architecture silicon You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose-driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay — a company you can be proud to be with. eBay’s Ads teams build the production systems that help buyers discover relevant inventory and help sellers grow their businesses. These systems span multiple applied ML domains, including sponsored search, item recommendations, seller guidance experiences, ranking, retrieval, personalization, and GenAI-powered capabilities. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will help build the platforms, services, APIs, data pipelines, and MLOps capabilities that bring cutting edge AI models into production at eBay scale. You will engineer the data pipelines that feed our models, build the infrastructure to train and serve them, and develop the APIs that deliver personalized experiences to millions of users. You will partner closely with Applied Researchers, Product Managers, and cross-org Engineering teams to turn prototypes into robust, scalable, low-latency systems for millions of customers. This is a shared hiring role across Ads teams. Final team placement will be determined after offers based on each candidate’s experience, strengths, and fit with the needs of Ads Recommendations, Ads Search, and Ads Guidance. What you will accomplish: Design, build, and operate scalable backend and ML systems supporting sponsored experiences, ranking, retrieval, and personalization. Develop and own the MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD), training, validation, and monitoring of all production-grade models. Engineer robust data pipelines using big data technologies to process vast datasets for model training and feature engineering. Implement and optimize both traditional ML models and state-of-the-art Generative AI models (including LLMs) for low-latency serving and high-throughput environments. Collaborate closely with Applied Researchers to translate novel algorithms and research prototypes into hardened, production-ready code. Champion software engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and documentation, within the machine learning team. Monitor system performance, identify and resolve production issues, and continuously improve the reliability and efficiency of our ML services. Mentor other team members through code reviews, technical guidance, architecture design, and pair programming. What you will bring: MS in Computer Science or related area with 7+ years of relevant work experience (or BS/BA with 9+ years) in in ML / AI / Data Engineering. Extensive experience in big data distributed processing frameworks, e.g. Apache Hadoop, Spark, Flink. Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch from a production perspective. Experience with serving frameworks (TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe, NVIDIA Triton) and libraries for LLM operations (LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers) preferred. Proven ability to build and manage CI/CD pipelines for ML models, including proficiency with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with using cloud services, big data pipelines and databases, e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure. Proven ability to design and build scalable, distributed systems and expose their functionality through well-designed RESTful or gRPC APIs. A masterful understanding of the challenges and requirements of running machine learning in a live, 24/7 production environment, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role About the Role At Kyndryl, we deploy AI innovation where it creates the greatest real-world impact. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will collaborate directly with customers to solve complex challenges, shaping solutions that redefine industries. You will be empowered to work at speed, supported by a global AI ecosystem, and play a pivotal role in delivering outcomes that matter. This position operates within our triad delivery model, where engineering, consulting, and product expertise come together to drive transformative results for customers. This is not traditional consulting or pure software engineering; it is a hybrid role designed for the complexities of real-world AI deployment, with accountability for outcomes not just code. You will blend deep engineering expertise with consultative engagement to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business value. Operating in dynamic environments and working closely with customer teams - often on-site - you will scope, prototype, and deploy solutions at pace. Technologies include Generative AI, Agentic AI architectures, and multi-agent ecosystems, with insights continually fed back into Kyndryl’s platforms and frameworks to accelerate future deployments. If you are motivated by solving complex problems, excel in direct customer engagement, and aspire to shape the future of enterprise AI, this role is designed for you. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one. 2. Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks. 3. Ownership, Deployment & Partnership: Own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. Working as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes. 4. Optimisation: Troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability. 5. Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks. 6. Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development. 7. Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl’s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Skills & Experience 3-6 years of relevant IT experience in which at least 1 years of working experience in Agentic AI Frameworks, Orchestration, Deployment and 2 years on GenAI solutions Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python; experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. Open-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories. T-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting. Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions. Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark. Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures. Performance & Security: Knowledge of system-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems. Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences. Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required. Education: Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Experience : Experience in Observability and evaluation platforms – e.g. Langsmith Why join us? You will become part of a team that values pace, autonomy, and tangible impact. At Kyndryl, you will have full visibility of the delivery lifecycle, with opportunities to lead engagements and shape strategic direction. Our triad delivery model means you will work alongside experts in engineering, product, and consulting, fostering continuous learning and innovation. Career progression is clearly defined, from Junior to Principal levels, with pathways to influence the evolution of our AI platforms. You will contribute directly to platform development and see the results of your work in real-world applications. If you are seeking an environment where your ideas are valued and execution drives results, this is the place to make a difference. If you want to work where innovation meets execution, apply now. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Not demos, but agents that provision infrastructure, investigate incidents, answer the questions engineers would otherwise file a ticket for, and take action safely on production systems? Experience working in large, regulated, or compliance-conscious enterprise environments. #LI-VGA1 What’s in it For You? jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: Location: India Development Center (IDC) The Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel (UEK) team develops and maintains the Linux kernel at the heart of Oracle Linux. We build performance, reliability, and security improvements for demanding enterprise and cloud workloads. Our engineers tackle complex kernel challenges across hardware platforms, partnering with teams across software, firmware, and infrastructure. Join us to solve deep systems problems and help deliver a dependable foundation for Cloud Infrastructure at scale. We are seeking a Linux Kernel Engineer to help develop, maintain, and secure the kernel software that supports our infrastructure. In this role, you will investigate complex systems issues, review and deliver kernel changes, and collaborate with engineers across regions to improve reliability, performance, and security. Key responsibilities Develop, debug, test, and maintain Linux kernel code and patches. Review kernel changes for correctness, maintainability, performance, and regression risk. Assess security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, and backport, validate, and deliver fixes. Investigate kernel crashes, performance bottlenecks, and production issues using debugging and tracing tools. Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to prioritize issues and deliver timely resolutions. Contribute to follow-the-sun operational support through clear documentation and effective handoffs across regions. Improve testing, automation, and engineering workflows to support a growing kernel workload. Required qualifications Strong proficiency in C and practical experience developing or maintaining Linux kernel software. Solid understanding of operating system fundamentals, including memory management, concurrency, synchronization, and process scheduling. Experience diagnosing complex systems issues using crash dumps, logs, tracing, and debugging tools. Familiarity with kernel patch review, backporting, testing, and regression analysis. Experience using Git and collaborating on large codebases. Ability to independently own engineering tasks, communicate technical findings clearly, and work effectively with distributed teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience of 6+ years. Preferred qualifications Contributions to the upstream Linux kernel or other systems software projects. Experience with enterprise Linux distributions and kernel maintenance across multiple versions. Experience assessing and remediating kernel CVEs. Knowledge of virtualization, networking, storage, or device drivers. Experience supporting production infrastructure and building automated kernel validation tools. What success looks like You deliver well-tested kernel changes, resolve complex issues, and help maintain timely security patching. Your work strengthens kernel reliability and supports effective collaboration and operational coverage across regions. Key Responsibilities Owns complex system modules and fleet automation workflows; defines integration contracts across software, firmware, and hardware. Leads deep-dive investigations into incidents and hard faults; creates durable fixes and preventive controls. Designs performance, reliability, and fault-tolerance improvements for drivers, services, and provisioning pipelines at scale. Elevates code quality through reviews, patterns, and tooling; sets standards for observability, security, and compliance. Guides platform bring-up and diagnostics; collaborates with silicon, board, and firmware partners to validate end-to-end behavior. Designs and implements firmware components integrating diverse interfaces and protocols. Diagnoses cross-domain issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and bootloaders using logic analyzers, JTAG, and emulators. Participates in schematic and board reviews; leads initial board and device bring-up. Develops and debugs advanced features—including RAS, high-speed I/O, and chipset/SoC services—across ARM, AMD, Intel, and custom ASIC/FPGA platforms. Systems Software Development: Design, develop, and maintain complex system software modules for managing, monitoring, and provisioning kernel and operating system software for computer servers, storage, networking, and GPU subsystems in hyperscale environment. Utilizes advanced knowledge to design, develop, and deploy software layers and tooling to automate hardware provisioning and onboarding of servers to large-scale fleet. Play a significant role in platform bring-up, firmware updates, platform-level diagnostics, and complex cross-layer debugging. Diagnose and resolve complex issues across software, firmware, and hardware layers, working in DevOps and incident response paradigms to maintain reliability and availability. Software Development and Coding: Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Implements comprehensive software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team. Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues. Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements). Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. Development Operations - System Maintenance: Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion. Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . As a Mechanical Engineer, you’ll leverage your strong foundation in physics, mathematics, and materials science to process and resolve mechanical problems, design and implement custom mechanical tooling and associated processes, and enable the handling, assembly, and disassembly of parts, components, sub-assemblies, and final assemblies throughout the product life cycle. You'll be responsible for designing, developing, and modifying mechanical engineering layouts, schematics, and specifications. You will oversee manufacturing and installation processes, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations- and you'll coordinate the procurement and assembly of mechanical components and equipment for design projects, identifying sources of critical parts and subsystems to resolve technical issues. Key Responsibilities Own the full design lifecycle of mechanical assemblies: concept, feasibility, detailed design, prototype, test, qualification and release to manufacturing. Design precision mechanisms such as lens and mirror mounts, kinematic mounts, flexures, alignment stages and optical benches. Do engineering calculations and analysis, including tolerance stack-ups, stress and deflection, thermal expansion, stiffness, vibration and natural frequency. Run FEA (structural, thermal, modal) to validate designs and guide trade-offs. Apply GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and create complete 3D models, detailed drawings and BOMs. Write test plans and qualification protocols, run testing, analyze data and drive root cause and corrective actions. Lead design reviews (PDR/CDR) and maintain design documentation, DFMEA and design verification reports. Apply DFM/DFA principles and work with suppliers on manufacturability, cost and lead time. Deliver work on schedule and to quality and cost targets, and communicate status and risks clearly. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (Master’s preferred). 5+ years of mechanical design experience. Strong SPM (Special Purpose Machine) design background, from concept to detailed design. Strong engineering fundamentals and calculation skills: mechanics, strength of materials, machine design, heat transfer. Proficiency in 3D CAD and PLM tools. Working knowledge of FEA tools (ANSYS or equivalent). Sound knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, materials and manufacturing processes (machining, sheet metal, surface treatments). Proven ownership of design testing and qualification. Preferred Qualifications Experience in semiconductor capital equipment, metrology, inspection or optical systems. Knowledge of optical alignment, opto-mechanical tolerancing and thermal/vibration stability. Exposure to cleanroom and vacuum compatible design and materials. Familiarity with motion systems, precision stages and actuators. Experience with DFMEA, DOE and statistical data analysis. Behavioral Competencies Professionalism: high integrity, accountable and dependable. Commitment to delivery: consistently meets schedules and quality targets. Ownership: takes full responsibility for subsystem outcomes. Analytical thinking: makes decisions from data and calculations. Collaboration: communicates well across functions and with suppliers. Continuous learning: keeps up with new tools, materials and methods. Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Yes, 10% of the Time Relocation Eligible: Yes Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: The application open date is Oct 28, 2026 and the closing date is Nov 6, 2026 Minimum qualifications: Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science and Engineering, Machine Intelligence and Data Science, AI or a related technical field. Experience in one or more areas of Machine Learning (e.g., Large Language Models, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Computer Vision, etc.). Experience programming in Python, Java. Preferred qualifications: Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program and returning to the program after completion of the internship. Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab. Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals. Experience with one or more of AI/ML frameworks. Experience with security-related research, systems, or technologies. Ability to design and execute on research agendas. About the job Research happens across Google everyday, in many different teams. Our research has already impacted user-facing services across Google including Search, Maps, and Google Now, and is central to the success of Google Cloud and our computing, storage, and networking infrastructure. Research Interns work with Research Scientists and Software Engineers to discover, invent, and build at scale. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, Research Interns work on challenges in artificial intelligence, machine perception, data mining, machine learning, natural language understanding, privacy, computer architecture, networking, operating systems, storage and data management, and more. You are also expected to contribute to the wider research community by publishing papers. Team Specifications: Google’s Core Organization builds the foundational systems, technical frameworks, and platforms that power Google products worldwide. Within Core, our overarching mission is simple yet profound: to make Google work better for everyone at scale. Within Core, the Privacy, Safety, and Security (PSS) organization is dedicated to keeping everyone safe at scale—protecting billions of users, safeguarding their data, and securing Alphabet and the broader internet ecosystem. We operate on the principle that products must be secure by default and private by design. Our research teams bridge the gap between theoretical computer science and planetary-scale engineering. We bring together researchers and engineers across cryptography, adversarial machine learning, privacy-preserving computation, systems security, and trustworthy AI. As a Research Scientist in Core PSS, you will pursue foundational and applied scientific breakthroughs—investigating emergent threat vectors, developing next-generation privacy and safety primitives, and creating mathematical and empirical guarantees that redefine digital safety. You will collaborate closely with core engineering hubs to translate novel proofs-of-concept into production deployments safeguarding billions of global users, while maintaining active contributions to the scientific community through first-tier publications, open-source initiatives, and academic partnershipsGoogle is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another. Responsibilities Participate in research to develop solutions for problems. Research, conceive, and develop AI/ML solutions to accelerate. Contribute to deeper understanding of limitations of AI/ML architectures, trade-offs and optimizations. Lay down the next steps for adoption of the research into next generation product development. jobs.description: Applied AI Platform Engineer II - SAP Fiori + ABAP Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale. Key Responsibilities: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations. Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support. Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved. Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. Required Qualifications: § A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems. Responsibilities: Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with Python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.title: AI Engineer - SAP S/4HANA
jobs.description: AI Engineer - SAP S/4HANA POSITION PURPOSE: We are seeking an AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI and agentic architectures within the SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ecosystem. This role designs, builds, and deploys AI agents, Joule extensions, and LLM-driven solutions that make SAP business processes conversational, autonomous, and intelligently automated. You will leverage foundation models (Claude, GPT, Gemini), SAP Joule, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol to create solutions that reason, plan, and act across SAP workflows — interoperating with external agent ecosystems while adhering to Clean Core principles and Responsible AI governance. YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Design and build AI agents that autonomously orchestrate SAP S/4HANA business processes using multi-step reasoning, tool use via A2A and MCP protocols limiting human interaction to the bare minimum. Develop SAP Joule extensions using Joule Studio — creating custom skills, domain-specific agents, and conversational interfaces for natural language interaction with SAP data and transactions. Integrate and orchestrate foundation models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) via SAP Generative AI Hub — managing prompt engineering, model routing, guardrails, and agentic orchestration for production-grade deployments. Implement MCP-based tool-use patterns giving AI agents secure access to SAP systems — wrapping released APIs and OData services as MCP-consumable tools via the Integration Suite MCP Gateway. Build A2A-compliant multi-agent architectures enabling bidirectional communication between Joule, custom BTP agents, and external platforms. Establish prompt engineering standards, evaluation frameworks, and Responsible AI guardrails (hallucination mitigation, grounding validation, PII handling, audit trails). Explore and pilot emerging SAP AI capabilities (Joule Studio 2.0, SAP AI Agent Hub, ABAP AI agentic features) and provide adoption recommendations. Collaborate with SAP Lead Developers and Solution Architects to ensure AI solutions align with Clean Core architecture and the broader S/4HANA landscape. Mentor development teams on generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic design patterns, and AI-augmented workflows. WHO YOU ARE: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred). 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on Generative AI application development and/or agentic AI architectures. Deep hands-on experience with LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) — including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, and multi-turn reasoning. Proven experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or SAP-native orchestration — with strong understanding of MCP and A2A protocols. Working knowledge of SAP BTP AI services — Generative AI Hub, AI Core, Joule Studio, SAP Build, and Integration Suite. Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, data models, released APIs, and business processes in at least one functional domain (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Order-to-Cash). Strong understanding of AI safety and governance — hallucination mitigation, content moderation, agent access control, and observability. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate business processes into agentic workflows and demonstrate AI value to non-technical stakeholders. Growth mindset with passion for rapid prototyping and staying current with AI advancements and the SAP AI roadmap. Ever feel burnt out by bureaucracy? Us too. That's why we're changing the way we work- for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO).
