jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system. Key job responsibilities Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation. Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews. Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly. Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time. Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures. Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs. Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked. Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity. A day in the life You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup. About the team We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Do you want to shape how people stay connected across calls, text, and email? Alexa Connections is building a trusted communication agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, then acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel natural. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you'll design and deliver the software systems behind a context-aware assistant that grows more helpful over time. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding customer problems, through system design and implementation, to deployment and operations — building privacy-first solutions that serve tens of millions of daily communication events. Key job responsibilities Design and implement software services that model each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of relationships and communication patterns used to power context-aware assistance. Build and operate scalable backend systems that integrate large language models and agentic reasoning to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect across calls, text, and email. Collaborate with scientists, product managers, and peer engineering teams to translate research advances in personalization and memory into reliable, production-grade features. Contribute to the full software development lifecycle — scoping, design, code review, testing, deployment, and operational support — while coaching teammates through constructive code reviews and documentation. Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, and continuously improve system reliability, maintainability, and performance. A day in the life Your morning might start with a design review for a new personalization feature, working through tradeoffs in scalability and data privacy with senior engineers and applied scientists. After lunch you could be writing and testing code for a service that ranks a customer's most relevant contacts, then pairing with a teammate on a code review. You'll regularly join standups with product managers and scientists to align on priorities, and you'll rotate through on-call responsibilities to keep the systems you build running smoothly. About the team The Alexa Connections team is growing, so you'll join early and help shape its engineering culture from the ground up. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and scientists who are invested in your growth, with mentorship and the chance to own meaningful problems. Our mission is to make communication effortless and trustworthy for customers worldwide, and we're focused on building intelligent, privacy-first systems that redefine how people stay in touch. Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. You will: Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses : tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients , and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. Integrate and serve LLMs , both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store. Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area. Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps : deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). Experience implementing AI guardrails , red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. #LI-PG1

jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust . Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama.cpp, and ONNX Runtime ; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. Own the full delivery path : CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. Bonus Points Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama.cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings , and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. #LI-VB1

jobs.description: : ZS is a place where passion changes lives. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS. : Lead – Governance, Risk & Compliance ZS is looking for a skilled and driven Lead– Governance, Risk & Compliance to join its Governance, Risk, and Compliance team. The consultant will serve as a hands-on Technology Risk Assessment subject-matter expert for applications, products, platforms, AI solutions, tools, cloud services, third-party technologies, and emerging technologies. Independently lead and deliver Application Security Governance, AI Risk Assessment, project-risk and material-change assessments for internal, client-facing, cloud-hosted, client-hosted, third-party and AI-enabled solutions. Determine assessment scope and applicable control requirements based on business criticality, data classification, external exposure, hosting model, technology stack, user population, regulatory and contractual obligations, AI usage, third-party dependencies and change magnitude. Develop a detailed understanding of product functionality, user journeys, architecture, data flows, trust boundaries, integrations, deployment models, administrative access and operational dependencies to identify credible risk scenarios. Assess solutions across ideation, architecture, design, development, testing, release, production operations, material change, migration and decommissioning. Participate in architecture reviews, design governance, stage gates, release-readiness reviews and production-readiness reviews, and provide documented risk recommendations. Evaluate inherent risk, control design and operating effectiveness, residual risk, compensating controls, remediation plans, exceptions and closure evidence using the approved risk methodology. Conduct review sessions with product owners, architects, engineers, developers, data scientists, security, privacy, legal, compliance, procurement and operations teams. Produce clear and defensible assessment reports documenting scope, assumptions, system context, evidence reviewed, risk scenarios, findings, ratings, residual risk, actions, dependencies and approval recommendations. Oversee high and critical remediation items, including accountable owners, target dates, interim safeguards, escalation, risk acceptance and closure validation. Support material incidents and risk escalations, identify root causes and recurring control weaknesses, and recommend program-level improvements. Develop management reporting covering assessment coverage, material findings, overdue actions, exceptions, recurring issues, trends and remediation performance. Contribute to policies, standards, procedures, control libraries, evidence standards, assessment playbooks, training, automation and continuous improvement. Secure SDLC and DevSecOps, including architecture review, threat modelling, SAST, DAST, API testing, software composition analysis, secrets management, penetration testing, CI/CD security, infrastructure as code and remediation validation. Modern architectures, including microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, containers, Kubernetes, serverless computing, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, mobile, data and analytics platforms and low-code/no-code solutions. Identity and access management, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, environment segregation, third-party integrations, incident response, availability, backup, recovery, resilience and secure decommissioning. Technical evidence, including architecture and data-flow diagrams, API specifications, threat models, cloud configurations, pipelines, test reports, vulnerability reports, deployment workflows, operating records and control demonstrations. Assess AI and machine-learning solutions across data sourcing, model selection, training or fine-tuning, validation, hosting, access, integrations, third-party dependencies, deployment, monitoring, human oversight, suspension and retirement. Evaluate generative AI, foundation and open-source models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, copilots, AI APIs, vector databases, plugins, tools and Model Context Protocol integrations. Assess risks including prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, sensitive-data disclosure, model or data poisoning, hallucination, bias, toxicity, privacy leakage, excessive agency, weak tool permissions, supply-chain exposure, model theft and unsafe actions. Review data provenance, lawful use, consent, quality, representativeness, lineage, retention, intellectual property, training and inference-data protection, residency and cross-border requirements. Evaluate accuracy, robustness, explainability, benchmark selection, performance thresholds, validation independence, human approval, action limits, memory, identity propagation, kill switches, rollback and fail-safe behaviour. Define or review monitoring for model and data drift, anomalous behaviour, harmful outputs, performance degradation, incidents, complaints and regulatory or use-case changes. ISO/IEC 27001 and 27005, ISO 31000, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53/30, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SP 800-218), SOC 2, CIS Controls and Cloud Security Alliance guidance, including the Cloud Controls Matrix. OWASP Top 10, Application Security Verification Standard, API Security Top 10, Software Assurance Maturity Model, OWASP guidance for LLM applications. NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, AIUC‑1, responsible AI principles and applicable AI regulatory expectations, including the EU AI Act where relevant. Experience reviewing the work of other assessors and challenging scope, evidence, control conclusions, findings, ratings, remediation and closure decisions. Ability to distinguish control design effectiveness from operating effectiveness and determine whether evidence is complete, current, relevant, reliable and sufficient. Strong analytical, facilitation, stakeholder-management, technical-writing and executive-communication skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgement and manage concurrent priorities. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. 3 years of experience in a Data Engineering, Data Infrastructure, or Data Analytics role. Experience with data engineering and writing software in Python or SQL. Experience in managing and maintaining data projects from conception to production. Experience building and maintaining data pipelines tailored for ML, AI, or advanced analytics workloads. Preferred qualifications: Experience supporting AI/ML initiatives and with Generative AI technologies, LLM integrations, RAG, Fine-tuning of models and vector databases. Experience building and productionizing end-to-end data pipelines using ETL tools. Experience with advanced data modeling and schema design for analytics. Expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub) and AI infrastructure (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery ML). Familiarity with the consumer electronics industry or supply chain data. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. About the job The Data and Analytics Services (DAS) team is a data hub for the Platforms and Devices (P&D) organization. Our mission is to empower the devices organization with timely, accurate, and actionable data. We build and manage the centralized data warehouse, creating data pipelines and scalable analytics solutions on Google Cloud Platform. By partnering closely with business stakeholders, we translate complex data needs into tangible technical solutions that drive decision-making, product strategy, and operational efficiency via data driven insights. We are committed to upholding data quality, governance, and best practices, ensuring that data is a reliable and transformative asset for all Platforms and Devices. As a Data Engineer in the DAS team, you will play a significant role in designing and building the next generation of our data infrastructure. You will be responsible for architecting, implementing, and optimizing complex and scalable data pipelines, moving beyond basic development to own key components of our data warehouse. With your technical expertise, you will handle massive datasets, write efficient SQL and Python code, and collaborate effectively with executive stakeholders and other engineers. You will not only build innovative data foundations, and AI-driven insights solutions, but also help define the standards and best practices that elevate the entire team, driving data quality and AI-readiness initiatives. The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world. Responsibilities Lead the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines and Extract, Transform, and Load/Extract, Load and Transform (ETL/ELT) processes for the centralized data warehouse. Architect and optimize SQL queries for data transformation, analytics, and reporting. Develop and manage data foundations and models specifically designed to support Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) initiatives and the generation of AI-motivated insights. Develop and maintain data infrastructure to support the data foundations. Partner with executive business stakeholders, data scientists, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) teams to understand requirements, architect data solutions. Collaborate with other data engineers to deliver data solutions and promote technical growth within the team. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses. AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries. Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS. Key job responsibilities Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales A day in the life As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree or equivalent Experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent 10+ years of experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience working with or having knowledge of cloud computing and existing cloud technologies Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning Experience in making data driven business decisions Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description: DESCRIPTION The Cross-Border (XB) Science & Analytics team is at the heart of Amazon's international marketplace expansion, powering science-driven solutions that enable customers across 20+ countries to discover and purchase products seamlessly across borders. Our work directly impacts millions in annualized business value through ML models, algorithms, and data-driven systems that solve some of Amazon's most complex cross-border challenges. We are a lean, high-impact team of scientists working across various programs spanning search ranking, demand forecasting, pricing optimization, product recommendations, language understanding, and generative AI. We partner closely with product, engineering, and business teams across Amazon's global retail organization to take science from ideation to production at scale. Key job responsibilities We are looking for a passionate and technically strong Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms that directly improve the cross-border shopping experience for millions of Amazon customers worldwide. You will work on challenging, ambiguous problems—from improving search relevance across languages to building ML-powered pricing and recommendation systems—with significant autonomy and end-to-end ownership. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will publish your research internally and externally, collaborate with world-class scientists and engineers, and see your work go live across Amazon's global marketplaces. A day in the life Research & Experimentation Analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, formulate hypotheses, and design experiments Develop and iterate on ML models (deep learning, NLP, ranking, causal inference) to improve cross-border product discovery, relevance, and conversion Design and run A/B experiments on live traffic to measure model impact against business and customer metrics Building & Shipping Write production-quality code (Python, Java/Scala) and work with SDEs to deploy models into real-time and batch inference pipelines Build end-to-end ML pipelines—from data ingestion and feature engineering to training, evaluation, and online serving Own model monitoring, performance debugging, and iterative improvements post-launch Collaboration & Communication Participate in weekly science syncs, design reviews, and cross-functional standups with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders Translate business problems into well-defined science problems, and communicate results and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences Contribute to technical documentation—architecture wikis, experiment write-ups, and model cards Growth & Community Present at internal ML paper reading sessions and science forums Stay current with state-of-the-art research (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, KDD) and bring new ideas to the team Mentor junior scientists and interns; participate in hiring interviews and debriefs Publish findings in top-tier venues and file patents where applicable BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of building models for business application experience PhD, or Master's degree Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience using Unix/Linux Experience in professional software development Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Lead - Cloud DevOps
jobs.description: Job Title - Cloud DevOps Lead – Specialist - ACS SONG Management Level: Level 9 - Specialist Location: Kochi Must-have skills: Cloud operations leadership; installation, configuration and management of Linux systems; public cloud administration; incident and problem management Good-to-have skills: Terraform/CloudFormation, Docker/Kubernetes, monitoring and observability tools, scripting/automation, AI adoption and AI-assisted operations, JIRA/Confluence Experience: 5–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or team-lead role Educational Qualification: Graduation Job Summary As a Cloud DevOps Lead, you will provide technical leadership for an e-commerce platform running across on-premises and cloud infrastructure. You will own platform reliability, operational readiness, and technical delivery; lead the resolution of complex incidents and problems; govern production changes; and drive automation, observability, security, performance, and cost improvements. You will guide engineers, coordinate with application, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders, and act as a trusted, client-facing technical advisor by identifying improvement opportunities and presenting clear, value-focused proposals that strengthen reliability, efficiency, security, and cost effectiveness. Roles and Responsibilities Lead day-to-day cloud operations and provide technical direction, task prioritization, coaching, and escalation support to the operations team. Build trusted client relationships through regular technical discussions, service reviews, and advisory sessions; understand business priorities and translate them into practical cloud and operational improvement opportunities. Develop and present evidence-based technical improvement proposals, including the current-state assessment, recommended solution, expected business and operational benefits, risks, effort, cost considerations, and implementation roadmap; incorporate client feedback and support decisions through execution. Own platform availability, reliability, performance, capacity, security, and operational readiness across on-premises and public-cloud environments. Lead major incident response, coordinate technical recovery, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure timely root-cause analysis and preventive actions. Govern problem, change, release, service-request, and configuration-management activities in line with service-level agreements and operational controls. Review system architecture, deployment designs, operational procedures, and technical changes to ensure scalability, resilience, supportability, and compliance. Define and improve monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, runbooks, and service health indicators to enable proactive issue detection and resolution. Drive automation of provisioning, deployment, maintenance, recovery, and routine support activities using infrastructure-as-code and scripting practices. Analyze operational trends, recurring incidents, capacity risks, and service metrics; maintain an improvement backlog and track actions to closure. Partner with application, DevOps, cloud, network, database, security, and vendor teams to resolve cross-platform issues and deliver technical improvements. Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, disaster-recovery procedures, and audit evidence; conduct knowledge-sharing and readiness reviews. Support effort estimation, technical planning, resource coordination, and stakeholder reporting for operational and transformation initiatives. Participate in the on-call rotation and ensure effective shift handovers, escalation paths, and operational coverage. Professional and Technical Skills 5–8 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure operations, including hands-on technical leadership of production support teams. Expertise in installing, configuring, patching, troubleshooting, and administering Linux and Windows systems. Strong experience operating services on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including compute, network, storage, identity, backup, and monitoring services. Strong knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, performance tuning, security hardening, access controls, and cloud cost optimization. Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or equivalent tools. Experience administering and troubleshooting Java application servers such as JBoss, WebLogic, or Tomcat, including application, system, and garbage-collection log analysis. Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent technologies. Working knowledge of containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift. Experience with logging and messaging platforms such as Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana and Kafka. Good working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis. Strong understanding of IT service-management practices covering incident, problem, change, release, configuration, knowledge, and service-level management. Demonstrated ability to lead troubleshooting, make sound technical decisions under pressure, mentor engineers, conduct technical reviews, and manage escalations. Demonstrated client-facing consulting skills, including requirements discovery, facilitation of technical workshops and service reviews, management of expectations, and confident presentation of technical improvement proposals to client stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues, risks, and recommendations for business and technical stakeholders. Experience developing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, quality, and consistency. Ability to evaluate and adopt enterprise-approved AI tools for cloud operations, including AI-assisted monitoring, incident analysis, knowledge management, automation, and continuous improvement, while following security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards. Experience with JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or equivalent service-management and collaboration tools. Experience working in Agile, DevOps, and site reliability engineering environments. Relevant cloud, Linux, Kubernetes, ITIL, or DevOps certifications are an advantage. A customer-focused, process-driven approach with strong ownership, analytical thinking, and continuous-improvement skills. Implement policies for security, throttling, validation, and observability enable consistent API governance across teams. Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive fixes to improve stability over time. 7) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer) Build integration agents that can: o Draft interface specifications and mapping proposals from requirements and standards. o Generate initial mapping logic and routing templates, then validate against enterprise patterns. o Recommend remediation steps grounded in runbooks, prior incidents, and observed runtime signals. jobs.title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineering Lead Project Role Description : Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives. Must have skills : SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Good to have skills : NA Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As an SAP SD Order Management Consultant, you will hold design authority and delivery accountability for the process area, leading multiple workstreams personally hands-on on the hardest design and configuration for Order Management within the Commercial / Order to Cash tower of the DRS SAP programme. The role exists to own sales order processing, the point at which a commercial commitment becomes a supply chain obligation and where defects are customer-visible within hours. You carry delivery risk for the process area and are expected to enter a drifting workstream, establish an evidenced position and reset the plan. You remain hands-on: the most difficult design and configuration work is yours, as is the review gate before work leaves the process area. Quality, defect trend and release readiness sit with you, together with the AI standard and the technical development of the Managers you lead. Techincal development is your responsibility, hold the client leadership relationship for the process area, and remain close enough to the detail to test the evidence behind a status report. Roles & Responsibilities: Scope & Decision Rights: Hold design authority for the process area and remain hands-on. The hardest design calls are taken by you personally, and you prove the pattern before the team builds to it. You approve decisions that carry downstream cost, hold the review gate on work leaving the process area, set the quality gates Managers deliver to, and own the delivery risk position reported to programme governance. Sales Document Configuration: Configure sales document types, item categories, schedule line categories, copy control, incompletion procedures and order reason handling to match the agreed order-to-cash design. Availability & Scheduling: Configure the availability check call and delivery scheduling behaviour, and work with the ATP team on confirmation logic, backorder treatment and promised-date accuracy. Order Intake Channels: Support order intake through EDI and IDoc (ORDERS, ORDRSP, ORDCHG), Fiori apps and interfaces own inbound order error handling and reprocessing. Order Exception Handling: Analyse and clear blocked, incomplete and stuck orders, including delivery blocks, billing blocks and credit blocks raised by Finance. Integration & Dependencies: Manage dependencies into ATP for confirmation, Inventory and EWM for delivery, Pricing for order value and Billing downstream. Credit Management blocks originate in the Finance tower diagnose and route them rather than reconfiguring them. Solution & Delivery Governance: Own solution design and delivery quality across the process area: set the design standards, approve decisions carrying downstream cost, and hold accountability for delivery risk, defect trend and release readiness across workstreams. Delivery Recovery Leadership: Lead recovery of stressed workstreams, including order intake interfaces failing or orders stalling before delivery creation at volume: establish an evidenced position, re-plan, reallocate, remove the structural cause and report a defensible trajectory to programme leadership. AI-Native Delivery Standards & Joule Governance: Define how AI is applied across the process area, including AI-assisted order-to-cash design review, exception pattern detection across intake channels and automated regression coverage govern the accelerator library, set validation and IP controls, and report productivity and quality outcomes. Set the standard for SAP Joule for Consultants use and the governance of its grounding content, and decide where a Joule agent is warranted against standard configuration, holding the specification and acceptance standard with the AI and AIDLC tower. Mentoring & Capability Building: Develop the workstreams: Run design reviews as teaching, pair on configuration they have not done before, and codify the resulting patterns so the capability outlives the individual. Set the technical standard across the process area and own succession for its scarce skills. Executive & Client Engagement: Represent the process area in client leadership and programme governance forums, defend design decisions, and negotiate scope and timeline against capacity Professional & Technical Skills: Must-Have Skills SD Order Configuration: Design authority over sales document types, item and schedule line categories, copy control and incompletion in SAP S/4HANA or ECC. Document Flow & Delivery Scheduling: Recognised design authority in order to delivery document flow, delivery scheduling, route and shipping point determination. Availability Check Behaviour: Comprehensive command of availability check configuration and how it interacts with confirmation and backorder processing. Interface Order Processing: Extensive experience with IDoc or API based order intake, including monitoring, error handling and reprocessing at volume. Exception Resolution: Proven capability to clear high-volume order exception queues without breaking downstream commitments. Pricing Awareness: Comprehensive command of the condition technique sufficient to diagnose order value discrepancies. Hands-On Technical Depth: Current, hands-on command of the primary skill. This is a working design authority role, not an oversight role: the hardest configuration in the process area is expected to be done by the post-holder. Hands-On Currency: Hands-on configuration or design-level build work on the primary skill within the last 24 months. Advisory, pre-sales, governance or oversight-only experience during that period does not satisfy this requirement. Where recent experience is advisory, a technical validation forms part of selection. Technical Mentoring & Capability Building: Demonstrated development of Managers and senior engineers through design review, pairing and codified patterns, evidenced by capability the team retained rather than output the individual delivered. AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership: Demonstrated definition of AI standards across an SAP delivery team or tower, including validation controls, accelerator ownership and measured productivity outcomes. SAP Joule for Consultants & Agent Governance: Working use of SAP Joule for Consultants and the capability to set how a team uses it, covering grounding content curation and client-confidentiality controls, together with the judgement to determine where a Joule agent is warranted against standard configuration. Evidence of AI Adoption: Demonstrable record of raising delivery productivity through AI or equivalent means: AI assistant adoption, delivery accelerators, reference architectures or codified playbooks built for reuse across teams, with measurable effect on throughput or quality. Good to Have Skills SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition order management scope items Fiori order management apps and situation handling Order integration through SAP Integration Suite (CPI) Advanced order fulfilment and allocation scenarios Additional Information: A 15-year full-time education is required, as stated in the approved demand record. Minimum 15 years of experience on the primary skill, as specified in the approved demand record. Hands-on configuration or design-level build work on the primary skill within the last 24 months. Solution and delivery leadership across multiple full lifecycle SAP programmes, including at least one recovery or high-pressure delivery situation. Evidenced record of setting AI-enabled or equivalent delivery productivity standards for a team or tower. 15 years full time education

The role exists to connect the shop floor to SAP, where integration must remain resilient while production continues and plant connectivity is not guaranteed. AI-Assisted Engineering & Joule: Apply AI assistants to interpret integration logs and tag data, generate test messages and draft dashboard query logic, validating every generated output against system behaviour before transport. Knowledge Transfer: Document reusable configuration patterns, support analysts joining the workstream, and escalate blockers promptly. Collaboration: Work with functional leads, test teams and downstream modules, reporting item status in terms of delivery impact. Plant Connectivity & OPC: Practical experience with SAP Plant Connectivity and OPC UA or DA tag integration with control systems. ERP Integration: Working expertise in production order, confirmation and goods movement integration between ERP and shop-floor systems. Resilience & Buffering: Practical experience designing message buffering, retry and reconciliation for an environment where connectivity is not guaranteed. Plant-Floor Working: Capability to work with plant operations and troubleshoot at the line as well as remotely. AI-Assisted Delivery: Evidenced use of AI coding and analysis assistants in live SAP delivery, demonstrable through the specific outputs produced and the validation applied. SAP Joule for Consultants: Working use of SAP Joule for Consultants in configuration and troubleshooting, including verification of the guidance returned against actual system behaviour. Where prior Joule exposure is absent, working proficiency is expected within 90 days of joining. Evidence of AI Adoption: Demonstrable adoption of AI in delivery work. This may be evidenced through use of AI coding or analysis assistants, or through equivalent contribution such as reusable accelerators, scripted automation of recurring delivery tasks, or codified patterns adopted by others. Delivery Discipline: Record of meeting sprint commitments on an enterprise SAP programme, with defect and rework rates that withstood review. Ownership & Communication: Capable of working an ambiguous defect to root cause independently and of stating clearly when a committed date is at risk. Good to Have Skills SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC) and the MII migration path SAP ME and manufacturing execution scenarios OEE management and downtime analytics Edge computing, IIoT platforms and OPC UA security Additional Information: A 15-year full-time education is required, as stated in the approved demand record. Minimum 7.5 years of experience on the primary skill, as specified in the approved demand record. Hands-on configuration and build experience across at least one full SAP implementation or major rollout. Specific, evidenced examples of AI-assisted work in a production SAP delivery context. Working proficiency in SAP Joule for Consultants, either held on appointment or achieved within 90 days of joining. 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Network & Svcs Operations Representative
jobs.description: Project Role : Network & Svcs Operations Representative Project Role Description : Configure, integrate and manage the life cycle of telecommunication network elements and associated configuration across Fulfillment and Assurance. Manage back office system data records. Support customer activations and configuration adjustments. Must have skills : SAP Manufacturing Integration & Intelligence (MII) Good to have skills : NA Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As an SAP MII Manufacturing Integration, you will hold design authority and delivery accountability for the process area, leading multiple workstreams through their Managers while remaining personally hands-on on the hardest design and configuration for Manufacturing Execution within the Manufacturing tower of the DRS SAP programme. The role exists to connect the shop floor to SAP, where integration must remain resilient while production continues and plant connectivity is not guaranteed. You carry delivery risk for the process area and are expected to enter a drifting workstream, establish an evidenced position and reset the plan. You remain hands-on: the most difficult design and configuration work is yours, as is the review gate before work leaves the process area. Quality, defect trend and release readiness sit with you, together with the AI standard and the technical development of the Managers you lead. Roles & Responsibilities: Scope & Decision Rights: Hold design authority for the process area and remain hands-on. The hardest design calls are taken by you personally, and you prove the pattern before the team builds to it. You approve decisions that carry downstream cost, hold the review gate on work leaving the process area, set the quality gates Managers deliver to, and own the delivery risk position reported to programme governance. MII Development: Build and maintain MII content: business logic services, query templates, message services, transactions and shop-floor dashboards. Plant Connectivity: Configure Plant Connectivity and tag-level integration with control systems over OPC UA or equivalent, including buffering behaviour when connectivity drops. ERP to Shop Floor Flow: Design and support the data exchange between ERP and the shop floor: production order download, confirmations, goods movements and status feedback, with reconciliation when messages fail. Shop-Floor Visibility: Build dashboards and KPI and OEE reporting that plant operations use in the plant, and keep them fast enough to be trusted during a shift. Integration & Dependencies: Work with Production Planning and Plant Operations for order and confirmation flow, with Inventory for goods movements, and with plant automation teams on the control-system side. Solution & Delivery Governance: Own solution design and delivery quality across the process area: set the design standards, approve decisions carrying downstream cost, and hold accountability for delivery risk, defect trend and release readiness across workstreams. Delivery Recovery Leadership: Lead recovery of stressed workstreams, including shop-floor integration dropping messages or confirmations failing to reach ERP during a running shift: establish an evidenced position, re-plan, reallocate, remove the structural cause and report a defensible trajectory to programme leadership. AI-Native Delivery Standards & Joule Governance: Define how AI is applied across the process area, including AI-assisted manufacturing integration design review, anomaly detection across plant data and reliability analysis govern the accelerator library, set validation and IP controls, and report productivity and quality outcomes. Set the standard for SAP Joule for Consultants use and the governance of its grounding content, and decide where a Joule agent is warranted against standard configuration, holding the specification and acceptance standard with the AI and AIDLC tower. Mentoring & Capability Building: Develop the Managers who lead the workstreams: run design reviews as teaching, pair on configuration they have not done before, and codify the resulting patterns so the capability outlives the individual. Set the technical standard across the process area and own succession for its scarce skills. Executive & Client Engagement: Represent the process area in client leadership and programme governance forums, defend design decisions, and negotiate scope and timeline against capacity. Professional & Technical Skills: Must-Have Skills SAP MII: Recognised design authority in the MII workbench: business logic services, query templates, message services and transaction development. Plant Connectivity & OPC: Extensive experience with SAP Plant Connectivity and OPC UA or DA tag integration with control systems. ERP Integration: Expert-level expertise in production order, confirmation and goods movement integration between ERP and shop-floor systems. Resilience & Buffering: Extensive experience designing message buffering, retry and reconciliation for an environment where connectivity is not guaranteed. Plant-Floor Working: Proven capability to work with plant operations and troubleshoot at the line as well as remotely. Hands-On Technical Depth: Current, hands-on command of the primary skill. This is a working design authority role, not an oversight role: the hardest configuration in the process area is expected to be done by the post-holder. Hands-On Currency: Hands-on configuration or design-level build work on the primary skill within the last 24 months. Advisory, pre-sales, governance or oversight-only experience during that period does not satisfy this requirement. Where recent experience is advisory, a technical validation forms part of selection. Technical Mentoring & Capability Building: Demonstrated development of Managers and senior engineers through design review, pairing and codified patterns, evidenced by capability the team retained rather than output the individual delivered. AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership: Demonstrated definition of AI standards across an SAP delivery team or tower, including validation controls, accelerator ownership and measured productivity outcomes. SAP experience Experience working with conversational AI, LLM-powered assistants, agent-assist solutions, or intelligent automation platforms. Clustering & High Availability Implement, configure, and support Linux clustering technologies, such as: o Red Hat Cluster Suite (Pacemaker/Corosync) o HAProxy / Keepalived o DRBD, fencing agents, failover resources Perform cluster validation, failover testing, quorum configuration, and cluster performance diagnostics. Expertise in Linux clustering technologies (Pacemaker/Corosync, HAProxy, Keepalived, etc.). Ability to troubleshoot hardware, OS, networking, and storage-related issues in a multi-tier environment. Key skills required: Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree 6+ years of experience in Unix/Linux system administration. Hands-on experience with clustering and HA implementations in production. Exposure to virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/KVM) and cloud basics is an advantage. Familiarity with ITIL practices (Incident, Change, Problem). Good to have Certifications such as RHCSA, RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer (LFCE), or equivalent. jobs.description: Senior Manager, Applied AI Engineering Role Overview: As a Senior Manager , Applied AI Engineering , you will set the engineering vision and technical direction for the firm’s enterprise solutions—mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver. Leading across teams and product groups, you will stay hands-on in your craft—shaping architecture, design, and code—while driving the standards and reference architectures that engineers build against. Your leadership will be pivotal in delivering tangible value across Deloitte’s product and AI investments, aligning technical solutions with business and technology strategy, and advancing Applied AI engineering across the organization. You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across software and data engineering, solution architecture, and AI/ML and GenAI, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing —setting vision, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to executives. Key Responsibilities: Craft and articulate a vision for Applied AI engineering across the firm’s enterprise solutions—mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver—in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders across product, engineering, experience, delivery, security, and infrastructure at all organizational levels. Advocate for, develop, and communicate the integrated Applied AI engineering, architecture, and technology strategy and its implementation roadmap to engineering teams and business stakeholders. Ensure the organization is well-informed about objectives, KPIs, maturity, compliance, and progress. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed—keeping an eye on leverage of existing assets and on the inference, token, and cloud cost of what we build, to maximize outcomes and minimize total cost. Define, measure, and drive the achievement of KPIs and NFRs spanning system performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability. Establish and evolve Applied AI engineering, architecture, and AI/ML/GenAI reference architectures, standards, and best practices—including spec- and context-driven development, evaluations, AI agent orchestration, and the AI and Agentic SSDLC that carries work from discovery to production to operations with full automation and quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Remain hands-on with design, architecture, and code—contributing to team and product group velocity and staying engaged with engineers across the SSDLC—while reviewing code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology. As a recognized engineering leader, mentor and develop engineers and emerging engineering leaders, coaching modern Applied AI engineering practices—full-stack and micro-services, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI and agentic systems, data engineering, application-level infrastructure-as-code, and advanced deployment techniques (Blue-Green, Canary, A/B testing) that minimize downtime. Lead by example through thought leadership—showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the organization. Embrace an iterative and incremental approach to Applied AI product engineering, favoring action and rapid learning over extensive upfront planning. Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, ensuring each iteration delivers value and stays aligned with customer and business goals. Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical challenges faced by customers and users, aligning technical solutions with business outcomes. Minimize unnecessary technical complexity and avoid overengineering—features and functionality that do not add value—and drive teams toward peak performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution. Possess deep expertise in modern Applied AI engineering and architecture practices, with a keen ability to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for innovation across the product lifecycle. Continuously enhance the engineering operating model to be lean, adaptable, and responsive—guiding and transforming the organization to embrace lean principles and foster a culture of innovation. Establish and evolve reference architectures, coding standards, and engineering and quality benchmarks that ensure robust, secure, scalable, and reliable/resilient solutions. Ensure appropriate, responsible technology adoption—developing explainable, scalable, reliable, and secure AI and agentic products—and proactively identify technical risks, developing mitigation strategies through proactive problem-solving and contingency planning. Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making across the organization. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms, crafting clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs supported by evidence. Engage stakeholders at all levels—from team members to middle management to executives—building collaborative, constructive relationships and co-creating momentum and value across multiple organizational levels. The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
