jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Industries - BFSI
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive, Industries - BFSI to pioneer Anthropic's enterprise AI adoption across India's banking, financial services, and insurance sector. You will build our presence from the ground up, securing transformative deals with leading banks, NBFCs, insurers, and fintechs, and establishing Anthropic as their trusted AI partner for digital transformation. You will navigate the complex, regulated environment of Indian financial institutions and position Claude as the AI solution that drives both efficiency and innovation while maintaining the highest standards of safety and reliability. As one of our first industry specialists in India, you will shape our BFSI go-to-market strategy and build the playbook for how Anthropic serves financial institutions, working closely with global teams while adapting our approach to local market dynamics. This position is based in Bangalore, Mumbai, or NCR, with travel across India. Key responsibilities Establish Anthropic's enterprise presence across India's BFSI sector, including public and private sector banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, and fintechs Develop BFSI-specific strategies that account for RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data localization needs, and sector compliance standards Build relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs, Chief Risk and Compliance Officers, digital transformation leaders, and innovation heads at India's top financial institutions Create the India BFSI playbook for enterprise AI adoption, documenting successful approaches that can scale across the region Own end-to-end sales cycles for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, often involving board-level decisions Drive strategic expansion within lighthouse accounts that can serve as references for the entire BFSI industry Navigate procurement processes unique to Indian financial institutions, including vendor risk assessments, rate contracts, empanelment procedures, and multi-year agreements Collaborate with system integrators and consulting partners who often influence technology decisions at banks and insurers Co-innovate with customers to develop BFSI use cases, from vernacular customer service and fraud detection to credit underwriting and automated compliance reporting Understand sector-specific challenges such as financial inclusion, legacy core banking modernization, and data security in regulated environments Position AI strategically within the context of Digital India initiatives and financial sector modernization programs Ensure successful deployments that can scale from proof-of-concept to enterprise-wide implementation Partner with global product teams to prioritize features critical for Indian financial institutions, such as multi-language support, data residency, auditability, and integration with local systems Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to navigate India's evolving AI and data protection regulations Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, pricing expectations, and emerging BFSI use cases unique to India Build internal alignment between Anthropic's global strategy and India's market requirements Minimum qualifications 15+ years of enterprise sales experience in the Indian market, with a proven track record of closing large, complex deals, ideally across BFSI sector Deep understanding of how Indian financial institutions operate, including decision-making processes, budget cycles, and stakeholder dynamics Experience selling transformational technology (Cloud, AI/ML, Digital Transformation platforms) to Indian enterprises Established relationships with senior executives across banks, NBFCs, insurers, or fintechs Understanding of the Indian regulatory landscape, including RBI, NSE, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data protection laws, and sector-specific compliance Consultative selling expertise, with the ability to position AI as a strategic business driver rather than just a technology solution Complex deal structuring experience, including multi-year contracts, phased deployments, and outcome-based pricing Technical acumen to engage credibly with CTOs, architects, and data science teams Cross-cultural communication skills to work effectively with both Indian stakeholders and global teams Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to build a market from scratch with limited local resources initially Patient yet persistent approach to long enterprise sales cycles, while maintaining momentum Preferred qualifications Experience selling directly into large Indian banks, insurers, or financial conglomerates Relationships with Indian system integrators such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL, particularly their BFSI practices Familiarity with Indian business groups and conglomerates, and how decisions flow within these complex organizations Track record of first-in-market roles or launching new products in India Domain expertise in areas critical to Indian financial services, such as UPI payments, core banking systems, KYC/AML compliance, Aadhaar integration, or insurance underwriting Knowledge of government initiatives such as Digital India and their impact on financial sector technology adoption Experience navigating public sector bank and PSU sales processes is a plus Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

An architect will be involved in all aspects of the software development life cycle, including requirement gathering, design, development, testing, and deployment. Designing API contracts and integration patterns (REST, event-driven messaging) between services and external systems. jobs.title: FCC Domain SME
jobs.description: Job Description The FCC Leader role focuses on transformation through data, predictive AI, generative AI and AI agents for banking and financial services clients. The ideal candidate brings first- and second-line FCC business expertise and practical AI delivery experience, supported by strong data capabilities, compliance operations experience and third-line assurance knowledge. The role includes client leadership and FCC practice growth within Insights & Data. Key responsibilities Domain Leadership and Practice Growth: Proven expertise in FCC strategy, AI-first solutions, GTM and senior client engagement. A track record of shaping pursuits and growing banking and financial services accounts. Client Transformation and Solution Productization: Demonstrated experience modernizing FCC through predictive models, GenAI and governed agents. Experience productizing reusable solutions and data assets that improve detection, controls and operating efficiency. Thought Leadership: Established capability to develop FCC and AI perspectives, present at industry forums and demonstrate practical solutions to financial services clients. Talent Development: Proven ability to build and mentor FCC consultants, data specialists, AI engineers and data scientists across business design, data mapping, model evaluation and agent delivery. FCC business expertise across the first and second lines Proven expertise in FCC strategy, risk assessments, policies, controls and remediation, including translation of obligations and typologies into business requirements. Deep knowledge of BSA/AML, counter-terrorist financing, KYC, CDD/EDD, beneficial ownership, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting. Broader knowledge of fraud prevention, insider misconduct, trade surveillance, insider trading, and anti-bribery and corruption. Demonstrated experience with first-line customer acceptance, risk identification, controls, escalation and issue ownership; and second-line policy, advisory, oversight, monitoring, testing and effective challenge. Strong understanding of FCC operating models, decision rights and accountabilities, with clear separation of control ownership and independent oversight. FCC data knowledge and mapping Proven expertise in source-to-target and field-level mapping across customer, account, beneficial owner, payment, transaction, screening, case and surveillance data, including identifiers, joins, transformations, reference data, reconciliation and exceptions. Demonstrated ability to map obligations and typologies to controls, scenarios, data attributes and AI features, with traceability through AI outputs, human decisions and retained evidence. Strong knowledge of entity resolution, customer hierarchies, master data, lineage, ownership, business glossaries, semantic models, ontologies and knowledge graphs. Practical experience assessing training, testing and retrieval data quality, representativeness, labeling and leakage, including access, retention, privacy and residency requirements. Job Description cont'd AI strategy and practical model and agent experience Prioritize FCC AI use cases by control effectiveness, value, data readiness, feasibility, risk and adoption needs, supported by business cases and roadmaps. Demonstrable ability to select predictive ML, NLP, GenAI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), graph or agentic approaches for KYC/EDD, adverse media, sanctions, AML, fraud, surveillance and evidence-grounded SAR/STR support, with appropriate human judgment. Proven expertise in defining model inputs, outputs, features, grounding sources, evaluation datasets and acceptance criteria, with practical knowledge of prompt design, retrieval quality and FCC integration. Demonstrated experience designing agent workflows with controlled tool/API access, permissions, orchestration, human approvals, action logs, escalation and stop conditions. AI governance and control effectiveness Practical experience with AI intake, inventory, risk tiering, impact assessment and control mapping, including use case, model, system and agent cards with owners, limitations and approval evidence. Proven expertise in controls for hallucination, unsupported conclusions, bias, explainability, prompt injection, data exposure and excessive agent permissions, including human review and autonomy limits. Demonstrated ability to evaluate detection coverage, precision, recall, false negatives, groundedness, drift, agent completion and policy breaches, balancing false-positive reduction with missed risk and control quality. Experience coordinating independent review, vendor diligence, approvals, change control, incidents, rollback and retirement with Compliance, Model Risk, Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance. Compliance operations transformation Demonstrated experience redesigning onboarding, periodic and event-driven reviews, screening, triage, investigations, case management and reporting, with clear handoffs and quality controls. Proven expertise in translating operational needs into user stories, workflow rules, service levels and acceptance criteria. Practical experience with domain validation, user acceptance testing, training and adoption of FCC data and AI solutions. Demonstrated ability to improve investigation quality, turnaround, backlog aging and cost per case against baselines while maintaining control coverage and documentation. Client delivery and FCC practice growth Lead FCC discovery and solution workshops and communicate recommendations and business cases to senior stakeholders. Manage scope, plans, estimates, dependencies, risks and quality across multidisciplinary FCC, data and AI teams. Commercial experience supporting account growth, proposals, RFPs, demonstrations and engagement shaping within banking and financial services. Established capability to develop reusable FCC assets, coach teams and support adoption from solution design through implementation. Our ideal candidate: Primary skills 15+ years in banking or financial services FCC, advisory or transformation; 5+ years leading workstreams or teams. First- and second-line experience, with deep expertise in at least two FCC domains. Proven delivery of at least 2-3 FCC AI use cases through a controlled pilot or production, with responsibility for business design, model or agent evaluation, governance and measured results. Strong data analysis and source-to-target mapping skills, with working SQL knowledge. Practical knowledge of FCC operations, independent assurance, AI/model risk governance, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, law, computer science, data science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Strong consulting, stakeholder management, executive communication and team leadership skills. Preferred experience Production FCC AI delivery, Python analysis or prototyping, and cloud data/AI experience, including model monitoring, registries or governance platforms. Familiarity with NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, SAS, Quantexa or comparable platforms and their integration with customer, payments, data and case management systems. Consulting, proposal development and reusable solution experience across banking and financial services sectors or jurisdictions. CAMS, CGSS, CFE, CISA or AI governance certification; relevant advanced degree. Success measures for this role Controlled FCC AI adoption; stronger controls and operational quality; reliable data mappings and evidence; delivery performance and client satisfaction; qualified opportunities, reusable assets and team development.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Validate AI-powered features, LLM applications, copilots, chatbots, agents, and conversational experiences across functional and non-functional requirements. Design test strategies for deterministic application behavior and probabilistic AI outputs, covering positive, negative, adversarial, boundary, and edge-case scenarios. Test agent behavior across user personas, multi-step workflows, tool usage, function calling, memory, routing, fallback, and error-recovery paths. Evaluate AI-generated responses across single-turn and multi-turn conversations for factual correctness, grounding, relevance, completeness, coherence, and adherence to instructions. Create and maintain ground-truth, golden, and benchmark datasets for evaluation and regression testing. Define evaluation rubrics, metrics, scoring scales, acceptance thresholds, and detailed rationale for qualitative and quantitative assessments. Perform Human-in-the-Loop reviews and analyze agreement, variance, and recurring quality gaps across evaluators. Build or execute automated AI evaluation and regression suites, integrating quality gates into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Safety and Responsible AI testing: prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, harmful or restricted outputs, sensitive-data leakage, bias checks, and policy compliance. Operational quality validation: latency, availability, throughput, cost, failure handling, observability signals, and production-readiness criteria. jobs.description: Job Summary AI Evaluation & Observability Architect(CoE)- The AI Evaluation & Observability Architect makes AI systems measurable, reliable, and safe to run in production. The role designs the full evaluation lifecycle (offline and online evaluations, ground truth, golden datasets, deterministic and LLM-as-judge scoring) and turns it into enforceable engineering controls: regression gates, observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Evaluation Strategy & Design • Define evaluation strategy per use case: what "good" means, which dimensions matter (accuracy, groundedness, relevance, safety, tone, latency, cost), and how each is measured. Design offline evaluations (pre-release benchmarks, experiment comparison, model/prompt/retrieval variants) and online evaluations (shadow testing, A/B tests, canary releases, user feedback loops, production sampling). • Cover the full AI system stack: LLM calls, RAG/GraphRAGretrieva1, tool use, multi-step agents, and end-to-end workflows. Maintain dataset lifecycle: drift detection, refresh cadence, and protection against test- set leakage and contamination. C. Scoring Methods Design deterministic scoring (exact/fuzzy match, schema and format validation, citation checks, retrieval metrics such as recall@k and MRR, tool-call correctness, latency and cost metrics). Design LLM-as-judge scoring: rubric design, judge prompt engineering, calibration against human labels, bias and consistency checks (position, verbosity, self-preference), and judge-model selection and cost control. Define when to use each method and how to combine them into composite quality scores with confidence intervals. D. jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Department Tech@Lilly Location: Eli Lilly, Bengaluru Position Type Full-Time Level R2-3 Are you passionate about designing and building AI-powered applications that bring together large language models, agentic workflows, and full stack engineering to solve real business problems? Do you thrive working across the stack — AI/LLM integration, backend services, modern frontend frameworks, and cloud deployment — while staying curious about what GenAI can unlock next? If so, Tech@Lilly is looking for an AI Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and scale AI-powered applications and full stack solutions across the enterprise. As an AI Full Stack Engineer, you will design and develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, build Agentic AI workflows leveraging tools, reasoning, memory, and orchestration patterns, and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise knowledge sources. You will work across the full stack — building responsive frontend applications, scalable backend services and APIs, and cloud-native deployments on AWS — while integrating AI services with business applications and ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and production-ready. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, agentic AI workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions built on enterprise knowledge sources. Integrate AI services with business applications and external systems, and continuously evaluate, optimize, and monitor AI application performance and quality. Build responsive, modern frontend applications and scalable backend services and APIs, using reusable components and clean, maintainable code. Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms (preferably AWS), building CI/CD pipelines, containerizing with Docker, and orchestrating workloads with Kubernetes. Design and manage SQL and NoSQL databases, integrate enterprise systems and third-party services, and ensure secure, compliant handling of data. Collaborate closely with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, and implement monitoring, logging, and observability best practices. What You Will Bring Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic AI concepts, with hands-on experience using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. Experience integrating AI models through OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent services, along with working knowledge of vector databases and semantic search. Strong proficiency in Python, with experience building APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks, and a solid understanding of microservices architecture and API design. Practical experience with React and TypeScript, building modern, responsive user interfaces with strong attention to frontend performance and usability. Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and CI/CD implementation using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, or similar tools, along with infrastructure deployment and environment management experience. Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server, with experience in NoSQL and vector databases preferred. How You Will Succeed Delivers production-ready AI applications with high quality and reliability. Independently drives features from design through deployment. Builds reusable and scalable solutions that can support multiple business teams. Improves developer productivity through automation and engineering best practices. Continuously explores and adopts emerging AI capabilities to solve business problems. Basic Qualifications 6-8 years of software engineering experience. At least 1-2 years of practical Generative AI experience. Strong Python + React + Cloud background. Proven deployments to production. Ability to work across the full technology stack independently. Preferred Skills Experience building enterprise AI copilots or intelligent assistants. Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI tool integrations. Experience integrating with collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise tools. Familiarity with AI observability, evaluations, and monitoring frameworks. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. jobs.description: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 11 Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems) Role Summary As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization’s next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously. Responsibilities Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments. State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks. Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability. Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i.e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models. Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure. Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents. Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance. Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability. Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production. Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making. Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment. Technical Leadership & Strategy Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap. Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies. Working closely with the MES Automation Manager, the role translates the Global MES AI and automation strategy into practical solutions and drives the technical adoption of AI within the development team. The job holder coordinates AI-related engineering activities, guides and coaches developers, promotes common AI engineering practices and remains hands-on in prototyping, scripting, integration and solution development. jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities • Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. • Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). • Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. • Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. • Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. • Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications • 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. • Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. • Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). • Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. • Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. • Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. • Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills • Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. • Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. • Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). • Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Scaled AI & Solution Architect
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The Scaled AI & Solution Architect is the senior technical design authority for the Digital Quality (DQ) organisation, which delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer. The role is a global individual contributor position accountable for setting and driving the AI and solution architecture direction across the entire DQ product portfolio, rather than for the delivery of any single product. The incumbent defines the target architecture, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering standards that every DQ solution is built against, so that capability is built once and reused many times rather than rebuilt product by product. The role leads the scaled adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI across the portfolio, translating enterprise AI platforms and emerging technology into GxP-compliant, validated, production-grade capability that measurably improves quality, safety and environmental outcomes at site level. Recognised as an expert within and beyond Digital Quality, the incumbent influences the strategic technology direction of the QSEO business, and partners with Solution Leads, the Platform and Solution Engineering team, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security to ensure architectural coherence, compliance and pace across a complex global portfolio. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Cross-Product Solution Architecture Own the target-state solution architecture for the Digital Quality portfolio, spanning quality management, laboratory, manufacturing quality, and safety, environment and occupational health solutions. Define how products, platforms, data and integrations fit together, and drive convergence of point solutions onto common architecture, avoiding duplicated capability and unmanaged technical debt across the portfolio. Architecture Standards, Patterns and Reusable Components Establish, publish and maintain the architecture standards, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering guardrails that DQ solutions are designed and built against, covering integration, data, identity, AI, validation and cyber security. Make reuse the path of least resistance for delivery teams, and measure adoption, reuse and the resulting delivery efficiency. Scaled AI Enablement Define and drive the AI and agentic AI architecture for the DQ portfolio, including use case patterns such as deviation and incident triage, leading-indicator prediction, automated document and content generation, and conversational access to standards and procedures. Determine where AI capability should be built once as a shared service versus configured per product, and ensure AI is delivered on enterprise platforms with appropriate human oversight, evaluation, model monitoring and lifecycle management. Design Authority and Technical Governance Act as design authority for significant DQ investments, reviewing and approving solution designs at key lifecycle gates and providing architectural assurance on build-versus-buy, platform selection and vendor technical fit. Identify multiple viable options for highly complex problems, set out the trade-offs in cost, risk, compliance and time to value, and make clear recommendations to Digital and business leadership and relevant governance forums. Technical Leadership and Capability Building Provide hands-on architectural leadership to Solution Leads, Product Managers, engineers and vendor teams across the portfolio without direct reporting authority, influencing through expertise, credibility and evidence. Mentor and raise the technical capability of architects and engineers across Digital Quality, and lead architecture and AI Communities of Practice that spread good practice across DQ and the wider Digital organisation. Compliance, Data Integrity and Security by Design Ensure architectural decisions embed GxP computerised system compliance, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements from the outset, in partnership with Quality, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Cyber Security. Define validation-efficient architecture patterns that allow AI and cloud capability to be deployed at pace while remaining inspection-ready. Innovation and Emerging Technology Exercise foresight in evaluating emerging AI, data and platform technologies, and act independently on self-initiated proofs of concept and technical experiments that challenge the status quo and shape the multi-year DQ technology roadmap. Take appropriate, well-governed technical risk, and translate proven experiments into scaled, supportable production capability with a defined adoption path. QUALIFICATIONS Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Engineering, Environmental or Occupational Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in in solution architecture, technical leadership or enterprise software delivery (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including demonstrable accountability for architecture across a portfolio of products rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI or machine learning capability into production, including an understanding of large language model and agentic architecture patterns, retrieval, evaluation and model lifecycle management. Strong experience with cloud, integration and data architecture, and with modern software engineering and Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Experience setting and driving adoption of technical standards across teams that do not report to the incumbent, influencing senior stakeholders through technical credibility. Experience across all stages of the system and application lifecycle, from value analysis and business case through deployment to value realisation and technical debt management. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leaders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation and data integrity expectations (e.g. GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11). Working knowledge of quality, or EHS business processes and the platforms that support them (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority). Experience deploying AI in a regulated context, including responsible AI governance, model risk assessment and human-in-the-loop design. Recognised architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF) or equivalent cloud architecture certification. Track record of external technical contribution — industry forums, working groups, publications or conference speaking. PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to work with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms – Digital Quality Lead. Key internal relationships include Enterprise Architecture, the enterprise AI and Data organization, Cyber Security, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation, Legal and Privacy, and senior business stakeholders across Quality and EHS in Pfizer Global Supply. External: strategic software and AI vendors, cloud and platform providers, implementation and managed service partners, and relevant industry and regulatory technical forums. RESOURCES MANAGED Financial Accountability No direct budget ownership. Influences the architecture and technology decisions underpinning the Digital Quality portfolio representing approximately $10M of annual software, services and transformation investment, and is accountable for identifying reuse and rationalization opportunities that improve return on that investment Supervision Individual contributor with no direct reports. Provides technical direction and design authority to matrixed teams of product, engineering, data, validation and vendor resources across the Digital Quality portfolio, and mentors architects and senior engineers across the organization. Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Information & Business Tech

jobs.title: Lead Gen AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview Job Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior Generative AI Developer to help drive the design, development, and integration of state-of-the-art Generative AI and agentic AI solutions across our enterprise Controls Technology platform. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute deep technical expertise in context engineering, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration, and play a key role in delivering scalable, grounded AI solutions to enhance automation and operational efficiency. This role centers on architecting robust applications and agent systems on top of pre-trained and hosted foundation models — not on training or fine-tuning models. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with AI architects, leads, and stakeholders to design and implement generative and agentic AI solutions that address business challenges. Architect advanced context engineering strategies — context layering, chaining, compression, pruning/offloading, and memory management — to maximize reliability, provenance, and token efficiency in production. Design and implement advanced generative AI methods, including sophisticated prompt engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) . Build and optimize RAG systems , including hybrid search, multi-vector retrieval, and re-ranking pipelines. Design and implement knowledge graphs and Graph RAG architectures to enable multi-hop reasoning, explainability, and traceable, grounded responses for high-value business domains. Architect agentic workflows and multi-agent systems using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and comparable frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, CrewAI), applying orchestration patterns such as supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and peer-to-peer. Design robust agent harnesses — governance, constraints, feedback loops, state/session management, and execution controls that make long-running agent systems reliable and safe. Integrate agents with tools and data via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and orchestrate inter-agent collaboration and task delegation via the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol. Support the integration of GenAI and agentic applications into production environments, ensuring robust deployment, scalability, observability, and maintainability. Contribute to the development and optimization of real-time and streaming AI solutions. Stay current with the latest advances in generative and agentic AI and actively share knowledge with the team. jobs.title: IAM Enterprise Architect (India, Malaysia)
jobs.description: Job Summary This role could be based in India or Malaysia. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. • Standard Chartered’s diverse footprint across 63 of the fastest growing markets in Asia, Africa and the Middle East creates unique opportunities for passionate, motivated, and highly skilled people who want to make a difference. We are changing the way people think about banking. We are changing the way we do business – becoming the digital bank with a human touch. This is your opportunity to be part of a growth story in an industry that is reimagining how customers are getting better, faster experiences and convenience through digital technology. • Our Information & Cyber Security (ICS) team sits within the Transformation, Technology & Operations (TTO) function and is responsible for all mission-critical and enterprise-wide areas of cybersecurity, including identity and access management, global threat intelligence, data protection, malware protection, and application and infrastructure security. These are challenges that impact our clients globally. • Our ICS Portfolio team develops the platforms, drives the processes and builds partnerships on behalf of ICS. We thrive on providing solutions to complex issues, devoting time and energy to designing and delivering new and innovative solutions, and all in an environment that demands being risk-aware, not risk-averse. ICS chooses progress over perfection and aims to always participate with a constructive purpose. The team makes an impact wherever they are based, be it in our offices around the world, our Global Business Solution centres in China, India, Malaysia and Poland, or even from our home. • If tackling complex challenges excites you, then join our ICS Identity & Access Management team where you will get to collaborate and work on solutions across business and functions to drive the transformation and deliver better experiences to our customers. We constantly strive to reduce time-to-market and streamline our processes. We follow agile methodology and work to embed an improvement habit across the bank. • Now you have an opportunity to make a meaningful impact with a diverse and passionate team of creators, innovators, and achievers. With us, you’ll learn, be inspired, and make an impact every day. The success of our work hinges on how we use the unique diversity of our people to realise the effects we seek to achieve: Always on. Always safe. Always Simple. Key Responsibilities • We are seeking an accomplished and highly delivery driven and strategic thinking IAM Enterprise Architect with experience in securing AI identities to join our Threats, Architecture and Controls within the Identity & Access Management organization. • The IAM Enterprise Architect will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, architectural patterns, and control frameworks for managing identities in an AI-drive ecosystem. This includes securing the “Human-to-AI” interface, managing the identities of autonomous AI agents, and ensuring theat AI model training and inference processes adhere to Zero Trust Principles. • The IAM Enterprise Architect will ensure the tactical and strategic plans and solutions are continuously strengthen to respond to the increasing threats and changing sophistication in attack tactics while keeping up with the growth and changes of business. • The IAM Enterprise Architect will bridge the gap between business priorities, cybersecurity policies, and technical delivery teams to deliver next-generation cyber defences against identity threats to protect our Customers. • The successful candidate will provide strong technical security direction for identity access controls and capabilities for securing identities in Enterprise AI Solution, and lead and partner with engineers, architects, compliance teams, and business stakeholders to deliver against the capabilities roadmap, enhance user experience, and align with regulatory and cybersecurity standards. The role demands a strong awareness of the cyber threat landscape and understanding of cyber threat actors and their attack tactics, identity access controls, and AI technologies and capabilities. This individual will drive delivery health, ensure achievement of OKRs, and shape the future of IAM solutions, reporting directly to the Head of IAM Threats Architecture and Controls. Strategy • Design and Develop granular access control capabilities for Large Language Models, Vector Databases, Agentic Agents, and AI training environments, • Architect and implement specialised solutions such as Just-in-Time access, Attribute based Access Control for AI agents, automated secret rotation, and identity-aware gateways for AI workloads. • Define how identity is managed throughout AI lifecycle, from data ingestion, model deployment, agent deployment to human-to-agent/model use case. • Align AI-specific identity threats with framework like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI Risk Management frameworks. • Develop and define a multi-year strategy for identity access controls and capabilities to secure AI, products vision roadmap and KPIs that aligned with the Business Goals • Act as the expert in identity threats in AI and take ownership of the securing AI identity controls and solutions. • Act as a liaison between business and technical teams to ensure business and technical objectives and requirements are well communicated and understood. • Stay relevant on matters such as cyber threat landscape, emerging threats, active threat campaigns and emerging identity access control technologies. • Create and update related IAM policies, standards, controls and solutions documents. • Partner with the Bank Security Architects and Risk Teams to ensure alignment with Enterprise Security approach and Regulatory standards. • Partner with the Bank Analytics and Strategy teams to translate insights into execution roadmaps. • Enable Compliance & Audit Readiness Central audit trail for identity access controls and identity threats detection response controls to aligned with internal and regulatory requirements. • Continuously identify opportunities for cost optimization, increase efficiency and process simplification. Business • Facilitate integration of business priorities and strategic objectives into delivery roadmaps. • Translate technical requirements into business value statements for leadership stakeholders. • Ensure that processes are optimized for transparency, accountability, user experience and continuous improvement. • Partner with business owners to validate outcomes and benefits realization. • Work closely with ICS and Stakeholders to ensure that requirements are in line with the bank’s strategy • Responsible to evolve the craft towards improving automation, simplification and innovative use of latest market trends • Engage with third-party vendors as appropriate for the project Processes • Map, analyse, and optimize end-to-end business processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and user experience. • Identify automation and digital enablement opportunities (e.g., workflow, integration, self-service). • Partner with process owners, operations, and compliance teams to ensure business alignment. • Successful grooming of delivery backlog facilitating planning ceremonies with clear, aligned outcomes. • Stakeholder alignment score (measured via feedback from Product Owners & leadership). People & Talent • Act as the primary liaison between business, cybersecurity, and platform teams. • Communicate product performance, risks, and roadmap to executive stakeholders and governance forums. • Drive stakeholder alignment on adoption plans, investment needs, and decommissioning of legacy platforms. • Create an environment of trust, open communication, and cross-functional alignment across business, technology, and control functions. • Collaborate closely with business units, Scrum Masters, and development teams to ensure successful sprint outcomes. • Provide technical security direction for Identity Access Management for AI to a team of developers and engineers, in partnership with architects Risk Management • Establish and maintain a strong governance framework, covering delivery tracking, escalation management, and executive reporting. • Proactively identify and manage program-level risks, dependencies, and interlocks. • Ensure adherence to ICS governance standards and contribute to shaping internal audit and risk processes. • Ensures the project follows the standards with respect to risk management as applicable to their domain. • Adheres to common practices to mitigate risk in their respective domain. Governance • Embed a strong compliance and regulatory-first mindset into program delivery for IAM initiatives. • Ensure that program decisions and outcomes align with legal, regulatory, and business conduct requirements. • Act as a role model for integrity, ethics, and responsible delivery practices. • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies (e.g., SCB Governance Standards, ESDLC etc.). Regulatory & Business Conduct • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct. • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Key stakeholders See the consolidated list of responsibilities below • Peers in IAM Threats Architecture and Controls, Hive Tech Leads, PMs and SMs ICS wide, Engineering Leads & Enterprise Security Architecture • ICS IAM Leadership Team, ICS CISOs, ICS Delivery Team partners, CPOs • Technology & Architecture & CIOs • Global Head, ICS Identity & Access Management • Global Head, Cyber Security Technology • Global Head, Cyber Security Operations • Global Technology Service Heads (Production Support, Infrastructure, Testing, SRE, Architecture) Other Responsibilities Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in ICS - Identity & Access Management domain. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats). The ideal candidate will embody the following attributes: • Strategic Thinker - connects execution with long-term organizational goals. • Independent Driver - able to lead without heavy oversight. • Regulatory Mindset - embeds compliance and governance discipline in delivery. • Trusted Partner - strong communicator with ability to engage stakeholders up to CIO level. • Delivery-Oriented - relentless focus on achieving OKRs and outcomes. • Collaborative Leader - fosters alignment, removes silos, and builds trust across teams. Skills and Experience • Agile Methodologies • Stakeholder Engagement/Management • Project and Programme Management • Agile Project Management • IT Standards, Procedures & Policies • Change Control • Information Technology (IT) Security Policies • Software Product Business Knowledge • MS Office Suite Skills including SharePoint and Confluence Qualifications • 15+ years of total experience as IT professional with at least 5 years in working on AI solutions and 5 years in designing and implementing Identity Access Management Solutions. • In-depth knowledge of identity protocols such as Oauth2, OIDC, SAML, specifically how they are extended to support non-human identity such as Agent Identity. • In-depth knowledge of management of Agentic Identity such as how to assign, verify, and revoke permissions for autonomous agents. • Deep expertise in Zero Trust Architecture and hands on experience in implementing these for AI solutions. • Implementation experience in designs using Attribute-Based Access Control and Policy as Code. • Familiar with the MITRE ATT&CK and DEFEND Framework and hands on experience in using these framework to design and implement IAM and AI solutions. • Familiar with enterprise directories and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Entra and related IAM technologies • Familiar with emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligences, Agentic AI and Digital Assets from identity threats perspective • Analytical, delivery-oriented mindset with the ability to balance strategy and execution. • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with a focus on influencing without authority. • Skilled at identifying risks, driving remediation, and ensuring compliance with audit/regulatory expectations. • Proficient in creating process and solution design documents • Proficient in stakeholder management and good communication skills. Able to bridge business and technical teams. Able to communicate with senior executives while maintaining alignment with ground-level teams. • Experience working in banking, finance, or other regulated environments. Education • Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Engineering, Banking, Business, or a related field • Relevant Professional Certification – CISSP Certified NIST AI RMF Architect, AAISM, CIAM • Relevant Threat Detection Response and IAM Technologies trainings such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Cortex, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, EntraID, Okta, SailPoint About Standard Chartered We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart. What We Offer Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies. In line with our Fair Pay Charter , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing. Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations. Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum. Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits. A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning. Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description: Working at Atlassian India Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear. Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere. Your future team: KubePlat Team The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products. What we own: Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments. Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts. Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices. Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on. Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads. Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day. AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features. We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale. As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch. What you'll do Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters. Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources. Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP). Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation. Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference. Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers. 10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems. Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs. Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar. Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability. A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills. Nice to have Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments. Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore). Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Responsible AI
jobs.description: Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work â whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI). You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo. Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally. We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture. If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact! At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms. What Youâll Do Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products. Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift. Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers. Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems. Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team. Your background Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production. Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment. Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code. Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems. Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.) Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL). Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity. It's great, but not required, if you have Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness. Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems. Job Summary Meet Cisco s Industrial IoT engineering team to build software for industrial switching, routing, wireless, security, observability, and edge computing. Our products help customers across manufacturing, energy, transportation, and smart cities to securely connect critical infrastructure, gain real-time operational visibility, and build resilient networks. You ll collaborate with engineers across networking, cybersecurity, embedded systems, AI-powered network operations, industrial threat detection, agentic systems, and Small Language Models (SLMs) at the edge, with opportunities to experiment and solve complex engineering problems. We are looking for AI-native software engineers with strong foundations in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Agentic Systems who can turn these capabilities into working software. Your Impact Contribute to AI-powered applications for industrial networking, security, observability, and edge computing. Build AI applications and agents: Develop and evaluate industrial applications and agentic workflows using LLMs, SLMs, machine learning, computer vision, RAG, MCP, and tool calling. Apply AI to industrial networking and security: Develop capabilities for smarter network operations, troubleshooting, observability, anomaly detection, and threat detection. Develop Edge AI: Fine-tune, optimise, and deploy ML models and SLMs on edge platforms, balancing model quality, memory, compute, and latency for reliable on-device inference. Practice AI-first product development: Use coding agents and agentic workflows across design, implementation, debugging, testing, and review. Collaborate with domain and AI engineers to deliver reliable software, validating correctness, performance, and security. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field, with 1-3 years of relevant experience. Strong Python skills and proficiency in another language such as C, C++, Go, or Java, with a sound foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design, and debugging. Hands-on AI/ML or LLM/agent application development using tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face, including model integration and evaluation. Experience using AI coding agents such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools, with the judgment to validate generated code. Familiarity with Networking domain such as TCP/IP or Security protocols experience or Experience in development and validation of peripheral interfaces (e.g. PCI, PCIe, I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, Ethernet) is a plus. Preferred Qualifications ML/DL and LLM foundations, with exposure to SLM adaptation (fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, distillation, quantization) and on-device inference using TensorFlow Lite or llama.cpp under resource constraints. Experience with RAG, MCP, or agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph; familiarity with A2A is a plus. Open-source AI contributions, research, hackathons, or independently developed applications. Who You Are You are deeply interested in bringing AI into real products, particularly at the edge, and using it to make networks smarter, safer, and easier to operate. You enjoy experimenting with models and agents, building working software, and evaluating results. You approach engineering with an AI-native mindset, use coding agents and automation thoughtfully, and take responsibility for correctness, security, and quality. You are curious about industrial systems and eager to learn the networking and platform context your work requires. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Design and maintain automation frameworks, reusable utilities, harnesses, and engineering productivity tools. Design documents Test strategies Automation plans Integration specifications Operational readiness documentation Identify gaps across unit, functional, integration, regression, performance, and exploratory testing and partner with engineering teams to address them. Participate in defect triage, release readiness reviews, environment validation, and delivery risk assessments. Security, Reliability Operations Apply secure coding practices and support vulnerability identification using tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Fortify, or equivalent platforms. Support production readiness through effective logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and issue resolution. Help improve application reliability, observability, and operational excellence. All About You Required Qualifications 6 to 9 years of experience in Full Stack Software Development. Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing and developing microservices. Experience with PCF, Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, or cloud-native platforms. Strong understanding of front-end development principles with hands-on experience in Angular and/or React. Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. Hands-on experience with Java, Spring, JUnit, Rest Assured, JBehave, Cucumber, or equivalent testing frameworks. Strong experience validating APIs, microservices, web services, web applications, databases, and integration workflows. Experience with relational databases such as Oracle and PostgreSQL, including writing optimized and efficient SQL queries. Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs. Understanding of information security concepts, including: X.509 certificates, public key cryptography, JWT (JSON Web Tokens), hashing algorithms, digital signatures. Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, data, and infrastructure layers. Strong passion for engineering excellence, continuous improvement, automation, and building reliable software at scale. Ability to work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment. Good to Have Experience with public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Experience with DevOps practices and tools including Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code. Contributions to open-source projects. Experience in payment technologies, digital identity, authentication, or security-focused solutions. Our Teams Values We work in small, collaborative teams consisting of software engineers and product managers. Customer success is at the core of everything we do. We embrace diversity and inclusion, bringing together individuals from varied backgrounds and experiences. We believe in doing well by doing good through inclusive growth and ethical, environmentally responsible decision-making. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization.
