jobs.description: GSI Service Delivery Program Manager Location: Bangalore, India Job summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Services Program Manager to develop a post-sales enablement and service-delivery quality framework for Rubrik’s Global System Integrator (GSI) partners. Success in this role guarantees consistent and successful service delivery from Rubrik’s largest and most complex GSI partners to ensure customer success, satisfaction, and retention worldwide. Pro-active and assertive development of the partner services relationships is a critical success factor for this role. It is both strategic and tactical and requires clear operational oversight, strong partner advocacy, and an ability to incent and reward top performance from Rubrik SMEs at all levels within the partners’ organizations. The ideal candidate understands how to work effectively with the Partner’s organization in collaboration with Rubrik’s Sales and Service Delivery teams to make Rubrik the preferred vendor for easy enablement and adoption of Rubrik best practices to deliver high value and margin-rich services to their largest and most complex customers. The GSI Services Program Manager is a critical contributor in the Partner Services Operations team within Rubrik’s Global Customer Success organization. Partner Services Operations enables partners to deliver post-sales support and services to their customers using reliable and innovative systems, processes and programs that ensure a high level of Customer Satisfaction with minimal dependence on Rubrik. The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for collaborating with and advocating for partners for the benefit of our mutual customers. Key Responsibilities: Program Leadership & Management: Lead and coordinate a scalable high-growth engine of post-sales support and professional services GSI engineers. Motivate this strategic workforce to achieve high Rubrik standards in product knowledge and service quality. Partner Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with GSI partners and their Rubrik account teams, acting as the primary point of contact for post-sales service issues, escalations, and proactive management of a seamless hand-off from sales to services. Must be able to navigate and present to all management levels within the partner and Rubrik organization. Customer Satisfaction: Maintain strong customer focus to ensure all managed partners are delivering world-class customer services, in collaboration with Rubrik, by measuring and monitoring customer satisfaction. Training & Enablement: Facilitate and track role-based training and certification to GSIs that ensures they are well-equipped to deliver services aligned with Rubrik’s company standards, in partnership with Rubrik University, Rubrik Sales, and Global Customer Success. Process & Quality Improvement: Implement and refine processes for support and professional services delivery, promoting best practices, scalability, and eliminating friction and inefficiencies. Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain program KPIs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and stakeholders. Facilitate Services QBRs to ensure continuous improvement on both sides of the partnership. Analyze program quality metrics to correctly assess and incent high partner performance, while requiring non-performers to improve or exit the program. Partner Advocacy: Comprehensively understand the partners’ go-to-market strategy, global support structure, and service delivery plan; document and present partner’s approach to internal key stakeholders as an advocate for what the partners need from Rubrik to be successful. Support Oversight : Provide oversight on partner’s open support cases and product gaps, to ensure timely resolution and appropriate resourcing and visibility within Rubrik. Facilitate resolution for any customer complaints regarding partner-delivered services. ABOUT YOU: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field; advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical support, or professional services, in a customer-facing role at an enterprise technology solution provider. Strong technical background and aptitude in Networking, Storage, Backup and Recovery, Cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP etc.), and Hypervisors (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Cyber Security experience is desired. Demonstrated experience working with GSIs or large multi-regional channel partners. Quickly understands the business issues, data challenges, and both the commercial and services aspects of strategic partnerships within global service delivery teams. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with excellent communication and presentation ability, specifically to summarize complex product issues into clear executive summaries. Strong project management background, with demonstrated success coordinating multiple programs, workstreams, and people toward common, measurable objectives. Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical skills, including hands-on experience analyzing customer data to facilitate data-driven decisions and to develop executive presentations. Experience with Salesforce, Atlassian, and Tableau reporting and data preferred. Motivated, proactive self-starter with a customer-centric mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes from cross-functional teams, including those outside direct influence. Able to work independently in a fast-paced growth environment. Able to travel to other locations and customer sites on occasion as required. Able to adjust work hours to overlap with USA and EMEA business hours as required. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer – Storage / Backup
jobs.description: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Storage/Backup builds and runs Storage and Backup Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. Key Responsibilities Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. Education & Professional Qualifications Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). Area of Specialisation Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. Strong experience as a Storage/Backup Engineer and/or Architect Deep understanding of Storage systems, data protection software and cloud native storage services undefined Understanding of modern storage and backup technologies (Caching Services, Object Storage, distributed storage, SDS, Continuous Data Protection, Storage-as-a-service, Backup-as-a-service) undefined Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. Desirable: Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. undefined Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Storage and Backup Technologies (SAN, Netapp OnTap, Avamar) undefined Knowledge of cloud cost methodology. Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices Skills/Background Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. Skills API Management, Automation Technology, Backup Servers, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Object Storage, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Storage Services, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Inclusion at GSK: As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. jobs.title: Netapp Architect
jobs.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. Review, approve, and validate storage architecture for infrastructure, cloud, application, and modernization projects. Ensure all NetApp solutions are scalable, highly available, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. Provide architectural leadership for storage modernization, cloud adoption, disaster recovery, ransomware protection, and hybrid cloud initiatives. Develop enterprise storage roadmaps and strategic technology recommendations. Technical Governance Serve as the highest technical authority for all NetApp storage technologies across the enterprise. Establish governance frameworks, engineering standards, operational policies, and architecture review processes. Lead technical design reviews for major infrastructure deployments, migrations, platform upgrades, and technology refresh programs. Validate compliance with enterprise storage standards, security policies, and operational best practices. Technical Review, Root Cause Analysis & Escalation Management Act as the enterprise technical review authority for all NetApp-related incidents, architecture concerns, and production issues. Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and storage health assessments using AutoSupport (ASUP), EMS logs, Active IQ, performance analytics, and diagnostic data. Analyze complex issues involving ONTAP, WAFL, SnapMirror, MetroCluster, NAS, SAN, Object Storage, networking, and storage virtualization. Review and validate technical findings submitted by project SMEs before vendor engagement. Determine issue severity, validate infrastructure configuration, and ensure complete diagnostics are collected prior to escalation. Approve vendor escalation only after confirming that internal technical analysis has been completed and enterprise standards have been followed. Vendor & Engineering Management Serve as the primary enterprise technical interface with NetApp Support, Professional Services, Engineering, and Product Teams. Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and critical incident management with NetApp. Manage vendor escalations through resolution while ensuring effective knowledge transfer to internal engineering teams. Evaluate new NetApp technologies, product releases, architectural enhancements, and strategic roadmap initiatives. Platform Strategy & Lifecycle Management Define lifecycle management strategies for enterprise NetApp infrastructure. Lead storage platform upgrades, technology refresh programs, firmware planning, and capacity management initiatives. Drive continuous improvements in storage performance, availability, operational efficiency, and platform resilience. Lead automation and standardization initiatives using Infrastructure-as-Code and API-driven management. Documentation, Standards & Knowledge Management Develop enterprise architecture standards, governance documentation, technical design guides, operational procedures, and runbooks. Publish troubleshooting methodologies, knowledge base articles, and engineering best practices. Conduct architecture reviews, technical workshops, mentoring sessions, and knowledge transfer programs for engineering teams. Provide technical leadership and guidance to infrastructure SMEs, project architects, and operational support teams. Mandatory Technical Review Process The NetApp Architecture Team serves as the mandatory technical review authority before any vendor engagement. Responsibilities include: Validate production issues and architectural concerns. Review storage architecture, configuration, and infrastructure compliance. Analyze AutoSupport (ASUP), EMS logs, Active IQ reports, alerts, diagnostics, and performance metrics. Perform advanced technical analysis and root cause determination. Identify opportunities for internal resolution. Approve vendor escalation only when a confirmed product defect or vendor intervention is required. Required Technical Skills Enterprise Storage Expert knowledge of NetApp ONTAP architecture and enterprise storage platforms. Deep expertise in NAS, SAN, Object Storage, and Unified Storage architectures. Advanced knowledge of WAFL, Snapshot, SnapMirror, SnapVault, MetroCluster, SnapCenter, FlexClone, Storage Virtual Machines (SVM), and Active IQ. Storage Networking Fibre Channel (FC), FCoE, iSCSI, Ethernet, NVMe/TCP, NVMe/FC, multipathing, and storage networking design. Virtualization & Cloud VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization. Hybrid cloud architectures across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Cloud Volumes ONTAP, Azure NetApp Files, Amazon FSx for ONTAP, and cloud-native storage integrations. Performance & Security Enterprise performance tuning, workload analysis, capacity planning, and storage optimization. Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity (BC), cyber resilience, ransomware protection, immutable snapshots, and storage security best practices. Automation & Engineering Automation using Ansible, PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, Terraform, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies. Experience with monitoring, analytics, AutoSupport (ASUP), EMS, Active IQ, and enterprise observability platforms. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Proven experience leading enterprise architecture, governance, and strategic storage initiatives. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, vendor management, and executive communication skills. NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer (NCIE), NetApp Certified Data Administrator (NCDA), or equivalent certifications preferred. Experience supporting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise environments across multi-site and hybrid cloud deployments. Expert knowledge of NetApp ONTAP architecture NAS (NFS, SMB), SAN (FC, iSCSI), and storage fundamentals SnapMirror, SnapVault, SnapCenter, MetroCluster Storage performance tuning and capacity planning Storage networking (FC, Ethernet, iSCSI, NVMe/TCP) VMware, Hyper-V, Kubernetes/OpenShift Cloud integration (AWS / Azure / GCP) Automation using PowerShell / Python / Ansible / REST APIs Disaster Recovery and Storage Security concepts NetApp Active IQ and AutoSupport Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title And Summary Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) About The Team Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code. Roles And Responsibilities Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value. Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready. Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize. Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not. Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation. Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made. Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus what requires a platform build. Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes. Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today. Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling. All About You Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients. Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built. Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage. Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning. Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon. Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause. Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker. Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped. Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
